name: add-bsd-distribution-facts-branch
negative_constraints: Do not parse /etc/release or other distribution files for BSD systems. The sibling BSD branches use only platform.*.
Do not create a new helper or class for a single OS when a 4-line elif matching the siblings fixes the bug.
Do not rename or reorder the existing FreeBSD and OpenBSD branches. Do not change the fact key names.
Do not mix up the two calls: distribution_release must come from platform.release(), not platform.version().
procedure: Locate Facts.get_distribution_facts in lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py. Find the if/elif chain keyed on self.facts['system'] that already has branches for FreeBSD and OpenBSD.
Reuse the existing BSD branch pattern. Set self.facts['distribution'] to the literal OS name. Set distribution_release from platform.release() and distribution_version from platform.version().

Insert the new elif for the missing OS (e.g. 'NetBSD') next to the sibling BSD branches. Put it before the generic Linux /etc/*-release fallback so it is not swallowed. Keep alphabetical or BSD grouping.
Match the system string exactly to the value of platform.system() on the target OS. NetBSD returns 'NetBSD', case-sensitive.
Leave the fact keys and value sources the same as the sibling branches. Playbooks that check ansible_distribution will then behave the same on all BSDs.
validation: Byte-compile the file: python -m py_compile lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py.
Run the existing unit tests for facts if they exist (tests/units, test/units/module_utils).
Mock platform.system() to return 'NetBSD'. Assert that distribution == 'NetBSD' and that release and version equal the mocked platform.release() and platform.version().
If a NetBSD host is available, run ansible -m setup and check ansible_distribution, ansible_distribution_release and ansible_distribution_version.

name: add-module-validator-text-check
negative_constraints: Do not re-open or re-read the file inside the check. Use the cached `self.text`.
Do not make text-based checks depend on `self.ast`. `self.ast` may be None when parsing fails, but the raw text is still valid.
Do not run module-only checks on docs-only stub files. Respect the `_just_docs()` guard.
Do not loosen the shebang match to accept `/usr/bin/env python` unless that is explicitly requested. Ansible module convention requires the literal `#!/usr/bin/python`.
Do not print output directly from a check. Report only through the `errors` and `warnings` lists so the existing reporting stays consistent.
procedure: Locate ModuleValidator in ansible_testing/modules.py.
Find the `__init__` code that opens the module file, reads it, and passes the content to `ast.parse`.
If a new check needs the raw source and the content is only a local variable (`text`), store it on the instance as `self.text`.
Update `self.length` and the `ast.parse` call to use `self.text`. The file is then read once and every check shares the same content.
Add a private method named `_check_<thing>` next to the other `_find_*` and `_check_*` helpers.
Inside that method, append a short, human-readable message to `self.errors` for hard failures, or to `self.warnings` for advisory issues.
Do not raise or return a value from the check method.
Call the new check from `validate()`.
If the check only applies to real modules, put the call inside the `if not self._just_docs():` block, before the module_utils and main checks.
For the interpreter check specifically, test `self.text.startswith('#!/usr/bin/python')`.
If it fails, append the error 'Interpreter line is not "#!/usr/bin/python"'.
validation: Run the validator against a module with a correct shebang and confirm no new error appears.
Run it against a module with a missing shebang or an `#!/usr/bin/env python` shebang and confirm the interpreter error is reported.
Run it against a docs-only stub and confirm the interpreter check is skipped.
Run it against a file with a syntax error and confirm the validator does not crash (`self.ast` is None while `self.text` is still set).
Run any existing tests or lint for the repository.

name: add-os-release-distribution-fallback-in-facts
negative_constraints: 不要把 'NA' 兜底条目插到具名 os-release 条目之前,否则 Debian、SuSE 的检测会被抢先命中。
不要只改 lib/ 而遗漏 v2/ 下的 facts.py 副本。
不要在没有检查返回值的情况下对 get_file_content 的结果调用 re.search 或 splitlines,因为文件缺失时它返回 None。可选文件(如 update.conf)读取前要先做 None 检查。
不要对 NAME/VERSION 的值保留引号,也不要用全文匹配代替按行的 '^KEY=' 匹配。
procedure: 在 lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 的 Facts 类中找到 OSDIST_LIST 元组,以及 get_distribution_facts 里按 (path, name) 依次检查发行版的循环。
在 OSDIST_LIST 末尾追加一个通用的 ('/etc/os-release', 'NA') 兜底条目。它必须排在 SuSE、Debian 等具名的 os-release 条目之后,这样已知发行版会先命中。

在按发行版名称分支的 if/elif 链中,增加 `elif name == 'NA':` 分支。该分支用 get_file_content(path) 读取文件,并逐行解析:'^NAME=(.*)' 写入 facts['distribution'],'^VERSION=(.*)' 写入 facts['distribution_version']。取到的值要先去掉两侧引号,即 .strip('"')。
如果某个发行版需要额外的 release 信息,在分支内用 lowercased distribution 判断后再读取它自己的专属文件。例如 CoreOS 读 /etc/coreos/update.conf 里的 '^GROUP=(.*)',写入 facts['distribution_release']。
把同样的改动同步到 v2/ansible/module_utils/facts.py。两份 facts.py 并行存在,OSDIST_LIST 和分支逻辑都要保持一致。
沿用文件内已有的写法:get_file_content、re.search 和 facts 字典赋值。不要另引新的解析库。
validation: 运行 test/units 中已有的 facts 相关单元测试,确认 Debian、SuSE、RedHat 等已有检测结果不变。
在 CoreOS 主机或模拟的 /etc/os-release(NAME=CoreOS)上执行 `ansible -m setup`,确认 ansible_distribution、ansible_distribution_version 和 ansible_distribution_release(GROUP)正确。
对比 lib/ 与 v2/ 两份 facts.py 的 diff,确认改动对称。
模拟 /etc/coreos/update.conf 缺失的情况,确认不会抛出异常。

name: add-play-level-keyword-with-batch-failure-threshold
negative_constraints: Do not delete or move unrelated attribute initializations while editing `Play.__init__`. Dropping `self.serial` breaks serial batching, because the slot exists but is never set.
Do not add the key to only one of `__slots__` or `VALID_KEYS`. Both are required.
Do not use integer division (Python 2) for the percentage calculation.
Do not pick a default that changes behavior for plays that omit the keyword.
Do not build a separate bail-out mechanism. Reuse `host_list = None` and `on_no_hosts_remaining()`.
procedure: Locate lib/ansible/playbook/play.py and add the new attribute name to the class `__slots__` list (internal names).
In the same file, add the user-facing YAML name to `VALID_KEYS`. Otherwise the typo check rejects the new keyword.
In `Play.__init__`, read the value with `ds.get('<key>', <default>)` and cast it to its type. Use `int(ds.get('max_fail_pct', 100))`. The default of 100 must keep existing behavior: never bail out.
Put the new line next to the related options (`serial`, `any_errors_fatal`). Leave the existing assignment lines in place, especially `self.serial = int(ds.get('serial', 0))`.
Locate the per-task host loop in lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py (`_run_play`). Find where `any_errors_fatal` sets `host_list = None` before `on_no_hosts_remaining()`.

Add the threshold check at that point: compare failed hosts (`hosts_count - len(host_list)`) with `int(play.max_fail_pct / 100.0 * hosts_count)`. Use float division. If the threshold is exceeded, set `host_list = None` so the existing no-hosts-remaining path stops later serial batches.

Guard the check against `host_list` already being None (for example, `if host_list is not None and ...`). The preceding `any_errors_fatal` branch may have cleared it, and calling `len(None)` would crash.
validation: Run the existing unit tests (test/TestPlayBook.py) to confirm that `serial` plays still work.
Write a playbook with `serial: 1`, `max_fail_pct: 30` and 3 hosts, where 2 hosts fail. Confirm that later batches do not run.
Write a playbook without `max_fail_pct`. Confirm that its behavior is unchanged.
Combine `any_errors_fatal: true` with `max_fail_pct`. Confirm there is no `TypeError` from `len(None)`.
Grep play.py to confirm every `__slots__` entry, including `serial`, is still assigned in `__init__`.

name: add-shared-platform-helper-to-module-utils-basic
negative_constraints: 不要在 basic.py 顶部新增依赖。platform 已经导入,而 basic.py 会随模块一起传到远端执行,只能使用标准库。
不要修改 get_distribution() 已有的行为或返回值,很多模块依赖它。
不要在非 Linux 平台上抛异常,要返回 None,与同类函数保持一致。
不要在每个模块里各写一份发行版检测逻辑。
不要使用 Python 2.4/2.6 不支持的语法,比如 except X as e、with 语句或条件表达式,这些会破坏旧目标机的兼容性。保持与周边代码相同的保守写法。
procedure: 先确认这个 helper 是否有多个模块要用,例如 user、service、setup 这类按发行版分支的模块。这类 helper 应放在 lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py,不要留在单个模块里。
在 basic.py 里找到已有的同类函数 get_distribution(),把新函数紧挨着放在它后面,位置在 load_platform_subclass 之前,让平台检测相关的 helper 集中在一处。
照搬同类函数的结构:先用 platform.system() == 'Linux' 做守卫,再在 try 里调用 platform.linux_distribution()[N]。旧版 Python 没有这个方法时,在 except 里回退到 platform.dist()[N]。非 Linux 平台返回 None。
取对字段下标:[0] 是发行版名,[1] 是版本号。get_distribution 返回名称时还会 capitalize,版本号要原样返回,不做格式化。
写一行 docstring,风格与相邻函数一致,例如 ''' return the distribution version '''。
保持模块级、无参数、无副作用,让模块在 import basic 后就能直接调用。
如果函数原本定义在某个模块里,把那份重复定义删掉,改为使用 basic.py 提供的版本,并在调用方中确认函数名一致。
validation: 运行 python -c 'import ast,sys; ast.parse(open("lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py").read())' 检查语法。
在 Linux 上调用 get_distribution_version(),确认返回非空的版本字符串,并且与 platform.linux_distribution()[1] 一致。
在非 Linux 平台上调用,或 mock platform.system 让它返回其他值,确认返回 None。
mock platform.linux_distribution 让它抛出 AttributeError,确认会回退到 platform.dist()[1]。
对使用该 helper 的模块跑现有测试,或用 ansible -m setup / 对应模块做一次冒烟测试。
运行 grep -rn 'def get_distribution_version' lib/ library/,确认没有残留的重复定义。

name: ansible-action-plugin-falsy-arg-guard
negative_constraints: 不要只把默认值从 '' 改成别的值来修。key 存在但值为 None 时默认值不会生效。
不要改动参数别名的优先级链（groupname > groups > group），那属于行为变更。
不要把 None 隐式转成字符串 'None' 再 split。这样会创建名为 'None' 的组。
不要顺带重构整个 run 方法，保持最小 diff。
procedure: 定位: 在 lib/ansible/runner/action_plugins/ 中找到报错的 action plugin（如 add_host.py 的 ActionModule.run），沿着 traceback 找到对可选参数调用字符串方法（.split/.strip）的那一行。

确认根因: 参数是用嵌套 args.get('groupname', args.get('groups', args.get('group', ''))) 取的，默认值只在 key 不存在时才生效。如果 key 存在但值为 None（YAML 里写了 `groups:` 但没给值，或模板渲染成空值），比较 `!= ''` 会放行，随后 None.split 就会抛出 AttributeError。
修复: 把对哨兵值的比较（`if x != '':`）改成真值判断（`if x:`），让 None 和 '' 都跳过分组逻辑。只改这一处守卫条件，保持原有的取参链和后续逻辑不变。
扫描同文件和同目录其他 action plugin 中同样的 `!= ''` 或 `is not None` 单边判断，评估是否存在同一类问题。只在 issue 范围内修改，其余记录下来即可。
validation: 运行现有单元测试（test/units 下与 inventory、runner 相关的测试），确认没有回归。
手动复现: 写一个 playbook，在 add_host 中设置 `groups:`（空值或 None），确认不再抛 AttributeError，并且主机被加入 inventory，不被分到额外的组。
回归检查: `groups: a,b` 仍会创建或加入组 a 和 b，名称两侧的空白会被 strip。

name: ansible-add-deduplicated-user-warning
negative_constraints: 不要把警告写到 stdout, 否则会污染 playbook 或模块输出。
不要每次触发都重复打印; 必须经过模块级 dict 去重。
不要用 raise 或 AnsibleError 代替警告。警告只提示, 不能改变执行流程或已有行为。
不要复用 deprecations dict, 也不要复用 deprecated 的版本格式, warning 与 deprecation 语义不同。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/utils/__init__.py 中已有的 deprecated(msg, version) 实现, 包括模块级 dict deprecations, textwrap.wrap(…, 79) 和 display(color=..., stderr=True) 的用法。
复用相同模式新增独立的 helper, 例如 warning(msg)。在模块顶部紧挨 deprecations = {} 的位置声明 warnings = {}。
新 helper 的消息格式为 '\n[WARNING]: %s'。先按 79 列 wrap, 再 join 并追加 '\n'。
去重时以格式化后的消息作 key: 只有 new_msg 不在 warnings 中才调用 display, 然后记录 warnings[new_msg] = 1。
调用 display 时传 stderr=True, 颜色要与 deprecated 区分(本例用 'bright purple')。
在调用方用 'from ansible import utils' 引用该 helper, 不要用隐式相对 import 'import utils'。若同文件已有隐式相对导入, 顺手修正。
validation: 运行现有单元测试 (test/ 下的 TestUtils 和 TestPlayBook)。
手动调用两次 utils.warning('x'), 确认只输出一次, 输出到 stderr, 且以 [WARNING]: 开头。
导入 ansible.utils.template, 并触发 legacy 替换路径, 确认没有 ImportError。

name: ansible-apply-file-mode-after-atomic-move
negative_constraints: 不要在 atomic_move 之前对临时文件设置 mode/owner。
不要用 os.chmod 直接绕过 module.set_mode_if_different, 否则会丢失 check_mode 和 changed 语义。
不要改动删除文件分支(del self.files / os.remove)的逻辑。
不要顺带重构 Python2 语法(如 'except IOError, err'), 保持补丁聚焦。
procedure: 定位模块中写文件的路径: 先用 tempfile.mkstemp 生成临时文件, 再调用 module.atomic_move(tmp_path, dest)。例如 lib/ansible/modules/packaging/os/apt_repository.py 的 SourcesList.save。
找出所有对 tmp_path 调用 module.set_mode_if_different 或 set_file_attributes_if_different 的地方。atomic_move 会按目标文件已有的属性或默认 umask 处理权限, 所以 mkstemp 产生的 0600 和事先设在临时文件上的 mode 都可能失效。
删除 atomic_move 之前对 tmp_path 设置 mode 的代码。
在 module.atomic_move(tmp_path, filename) 之后, 读取 module.params['mode'], 对最终目标 filename 调用 module.set_mode_if_different(filename, this_mode, False)。
保留原有的写入逻辑和 IOError -> fail_json 的错误处理不变。只调整 mode 设置的位置和作用对象, 保持改动最小。
validation: 运行现有的 apt_repository 单元/集成测试 (test/integration targets apt_repository), 确认通过。
手动或在集成测试中验证: 指定 mode=0644 新增仓库后, /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.list 的权限为 0644, 而不是 mkstemp 默认的 0600。
用 grep 确认该模块中不再有对 tmp_path 调用 set_mode_if_different 的地方。

name: ansible-atomic-move-guard-metadata-copy
negative_constraints: Do not leave os.stat or os.chmod outside the try block. When they raise EPERM as a non-owner or under sudo, the move must not abort.
Do not swallow every OSError. Only EPERM may be ignored, and other errnos must still reach the existing failure path.
Do not change the copy-vs-move decision for SUDO_USER with a non-root uid. Do not add os.remove of src in that branch.
Do not convert the file to Python 3 syntax while making this fix.
procedure: Locate AnsibleModule.atomic_move in lib/ansible/module_common.py and find the block that copies the existing dest's mode and ownership onto src (the `if os.path.exists(dest):` branch).

Move every call that touches file metadata into the existing try block: os.stat(dest), os.chmod(src, st.st_mode & 07777) and os.chown(src, st.st_uid, st.st_gid). Keep them in that order: stat, then chmod, then chown.
Reuse the existing `except OSError, e:` handler. It tolerates errno.EPERM and re-raises other errors. Do not add a new handler or a new error policy.

In the sudo/non-root branch, where shutil.copy is used instead of shutil.move, add a comment saying the leftover src is cleaned up when the tempdir is removed with 'rm'. Do not add explicit cleanup code.
Keep the Python 2 syntax (`except X, e`, octal `07777`) consistent with the surrounding file.
validation: Run `python -m py_compile lib/ansible/module_common.py` to confirm it still compiles under the Python 2 syntax it uses.
Run an existing module that uses atomic_move, such as copy or template, against a dest owned by another user, as a non-root user. Confirm it succeeds without an EPERM traceback.
Run the existing unit and integration tests for the file and copy modules.

name: ansible-atomic-move-restore-selinux-context-after-rename
negative_constraints: Do not apply context to tmp_dest after os.rename. The path is gone, so the call either fails or does nothing.
Do not edit unrelated method signatures while touching this file. For example, deleting the trailing ':' from 'def selinux_context(self, path):' breaks the whole module with a syntax error.
Do not call set_context_if_different with context=None when SELinux is enabled without first confirming that context was computed on that path.
Do not add Python 3-only syntax. module_common is embedded into remote modules that run on old Pythons.
procedure: Locate AnsibleModule.atomic_move in lib/ansible/module_common.py. This is a legacy Python 2 codebase: it uses 'except X, e' and the octal literal 07777.
Trace how 'context' is assigned on each branch. It comes from selinux_context(dest) when dest exists, or from selinux_default_context(dest) when it does not.
Initialize 'context = None' at the top of atomic_move, next to 'rc = False'. Every later use of the variable then has a binding, so no NameError occurs on any branch.
Keep the existing pre-rename call self.set_context_if_different(tmp_dest, context, False).
After os.rename(tmp_dest, dest), add a guarded block: if self.selinux_enabled(), call self.set_context_if_different(dest, context, False). Add the comment '# rename might not preserve context'.
Pass 'dest' to the post-rename call, not 'tmp_dest'. After the rename, tmp_dest no longer exists.
Reuse the existing helpers selinux_enabled() and set_context_if_different(). Do not call the selinux module directly, and do not add new imports.
Leave the surrounding try/except (shutil.Error, OSError, IOError) and cleanup() flow unchanged.
validation: Byte-compile lib/ansible/module_common.py with the target Python (python -m py_compile) to catch syntax regressions.
Run the existing unit and integration tests for the file, copy, and template modules.
On an SELinux-enabled host, copy a file over an existing dest that has a non-default context.
Confirm with 'ls -Z' that dest keeps the expected context after atomic_move.
Repeat the copy for a new dest and confirm it gets the default context.
Grep the diff to make sure no post-rename operation references tmp_dest.

name: ansible-atomic-move-same-filesystem-staging
negative_constraints: Do not rely on os.rename across directories that may be on different mount points. It raises EXDEV and is not atomic across devices.
Do not create the staging temp file outside dest's directory. That defeats the same-partition guarantee.
Do not leave the .name.pid.time temp file behind on failure.
Do not let a cleanup exception in finally replace the real error. Log it to stderr only.
Do not drop the mode/ownership/selinux copy from the existing dest when restructuring the move.
procedure: Locate the file-replacement helper in lib/ansible/module_common.py, in the AnsibleModule class (formerly atomic_replace).

Keep the existing attribute-copy logic that runs when dest already exists: chmod with st_mode & 07777, chown to the dest uid/gid, and the selinux context via selinux_default_context/set_context_if_different. Apply it to src before moving.

Do not os.rename src directly to dest. src may be on another filesystem, such as a remote tmp dir. Instead, build a temp path in the dest directory: os.path.dirname(dest) + '/.' + basename + '.' + pid + '.' + time.time().
Use shutil.move(src, tmp_dest) to get the file onto dest's partition. This step may copy across devices.
Then call os.rename(tmp_dest, dest). Both paths are now on the same filesystem, so the final step is truly atomic.
Wrap both steps in try/except (shutil.Error, OSError, IOError). On error, call self.fail_json with a message that includes src, dest and the exception.
In a finally block, unlink tmp_dest if it still exists. If cleanup fails, write the error to sys.stderr instead of raising, so the original error is not masked.
Return a boolean success flag: initialize rc = False and set it to True after the rename.
When renaming the API (atomic_replace -> atomic_move), grep every module that calls the old name and update the callers in the same change. Otherwise existing modules break at runtime.
validation: Grep the repo for 'atomic_replace' and confirm no stale callers remain after the rename.

Manually test a copy or template module with the remote tmp dir on a different filesystem than dest, such as tmpfs /tmp versus /etc. The replace should succeed and leave no hidden temp file in dest's directory.
Simulate a failure, such as a read-only dest dir. Confirm that fail_json reports src and dest and that tmp_dest is removed.
Verify that the replaced file keeps the original dest's mode, owner and selinux context.
Run the existing test suite / module tests.

name: ansible-atomic-move-tempfile-error-handling
negative_constraints: Do not use 'except ... as e' or other Python-3-only syntax in module_utils/basic.py. It must stay compatible with old remote Pythons.
Do not catch bare Exception or swallow the error silently. The module must exit through fail_json.
Do not merge this try into the following sudo/shutil.move try block. Each block reports a different failure cause.
Do not change the temp file prefix, suffix or dir semantics. Other code relies on the .ansible_tmp naming in dest_dir.
procedure: Locate AnsibleModule.atomic_move in lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py. Find the fallback branch where os.rename fails and the code computes dest_dir/dest_file, then calls tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(prefix='.ansible_tmp', dir=dest_dir, suffix=dest_file).

Wrap only the NamedTemporaryFile creation in its own try block. Catch (OSError, IOError) and keep the 'except (OSError, IOError), e:' syntax already used in the file. That syntax matches the Python 2.4+ compatible style of module_utils.

In the except branch, call self.fail_json(msg=...). Use a clear message that names dest_dir and says the destination directory is not writable by the current user. Do not let the raw exception escape as a traceback.
Keep the later try block (the one that handles switched_user/sudo and shutil.move) unchanged. Its error handling is separate and must stay intact.
Keep the change minimal and local to this one call site. Use the same indentation and message-formatting style ('%s' % var) as the surrounding code.
validation: Run python -m py_compile lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py, or run the existing unit tests for module_utils.

Manually reproduce: run a file/copy module to a destination whose directory is not writable by the remote user, with cross-device rename forced. Check that the output is a failed JSON with the 'not writable' message, not a traceback.
Check that the normal atomic_move path still works when dest_dir is writable.

name: ansible-audit-percent-format-tuple-in-error-paths
negative_constraints: 不要靠删减占位符来凑参数数量, 那样会丢失诊断信息。
不要在同一个 PR 里批量重写无关文件的错误消息。
procedure: 排查错误路径时, 先确认异常消息的构造本身不会出错: 消息含多个 '%s' 而右侧只有单个变量时, 会抛出 TypeError, 把原本有意义的 AnsibleError 掩盖掉。
修复方式是用元组提供全部参数。参数要选对用户排查有用的上下文, 例如文件名加实际类型或实际值。
如果右侧只有一个参数, 而且这个参数本身可能是元组, 用 (x,) 包裹, 防止被拆开。
validation: 手动触发该错误分支, 确认最终抛出的是预期的 AnsibleError, 消息完整可读。
run existing tests

name: ansible-basic-selinux-context-merge-elif-fix
negative_constraints: 不要在测试中依赖真实 selinux 环境或真实文件系统,统一用 patch 或 MagicMock 隔离。
不要顺带重构 basic.py 的其他逻辑。basic.py 会被嵌入到所有远端模块中,改动应保持最小。
不要只改代码而不补单元测试,也不要只加测试而不修代码。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py 中 AnsibleModule 的 selinux context 合并循环。这段代码遍历 context[i] 与 cur_context[i],逐元素构造 new_context。
逐个检查互斥分支,确认是否误写成连续的 if。分支一是 context[i] 不为 None 且与当前值不同;分支二是 context[i] 为 None。它们应当写成 if/elif。
做最小修复:把第二个 if 改为 elif。不要重写合并逻辑,让 None 只表示继承当前值,显式值只在不同时覆盖。
在 test/units/module_utils/test_basic.py 中通过 basic.MODULE_COMPLEX_ARGS='{}' 构造 AnsibleModule(argument_spec=dict())。
用 MagicMock 替换 selinux 依赖,例如 am.selinux_mls_enabled、am.selinux_default_context、selinux 上下文获取方法,并让返回值采用 'user:role:type:level'.split(':', 3) 形式的列表。
增加测试用例,覆盖三种情况:context 元素为 None 时继承 cur_context;元素不同时覆盖;元素相同时不触发变更。
validation: 运行 nosetests 或 pytest test/units/module_utils/test_basic.py,确认测试通过。
确认新增用例在修复前的 if/if 写法下会失败或暴露问题,在 elif 写法下通过。
保持 Python 2.6/2.7 兼容。该文件使用 __builtin__ 和 0600 八进制写法,并以 ansible.compat.tests 作为导入入口。

name: ansible-callback-color-must-exist-in-stringc-palette
negative_constraints: Do not add a new color (for example 'orange') to the palette just to satisfy one call site. Reuse an existing supported color.
Do not change the printed message string. Users and tests may match on 'no hosts matched or remaining'.
Do not refactor stringc or the callback class structure as part of a color fix.
procedure: Find every color-name argument passed to stringc(...) in lib/ansible/callbacks.py. Searching for stringc( locates them, including in PlaybookRunnerCallbacks methods such as on_no_hosts.
Find the dict or table of supported color names that stringc uses (the color codes mapping in the color/utils module). Treat it as the only source of valid names.
Check that each literal color passed to stringc is a key in that mapping. Names such as 'orange' that are not in the mapping are bugs and can crash the callback or produce wrong output.

Replace each invalid name with the closest existing palette entry that fits the message's meaning. Use red for warning or failure states such as 'no hosts matched or remaining', yellow for changed or skipped, and green for ok.
Keep the change to a one-line edit of the color argument. Do not change the message text or its newline.
validation: Run grep for stringc( and check every color literal against the keys of the color mapping.
Run a playbook whose host pattern matches nothing. Confirm that on_no_hosts prints the message in red without an exception.
Run the existing test suite (for example make tests or nosetests) to confirm nothing regresses.

name: ansible-callback-interface-sync-negative
negative_constraints: 不要假定所有 callback 类都继承自 DefaultRunnerCallbacks。测试中的 stub 是 duck-typed 的,必须单独更新。
procedure: 每当 runner 或 playbook 新增 self.callbacks.on_* 调用时,用 grep 找出所有实现 callback 的类,包括 Default*、Cli*、Playbook* 以及 test/ 中的 stub。
为每个类补齐该方法:基类和测试 stub 中为 no-op,面向用户的类中实现实际输出。
validation: 运行 grep -rn 'def on_' lib/ansible/callbacks.py test/,确认新方法在每个类中都存在。
运行完整测试套件。

name: ansible-config-default-with-tristate-play-override
negative_constraints: Do not keep the hard-coded True default for gather_facts. Otherwise the global setting can never take effect.
Do not use 'if not play.gather_facts' or other truthiness checks. They treat None and False the same; always use 'is None' or 'is False'.
Do not let the global setting override an explicit gather_facts: True/False in a play.
Do not move the early return for 'skip gathering' after host trimming without filtering. In smart mode, cached hosts must not run setup again.
Do not change the existing structure of the SETUP_CACHE key 'module_setup'. Smart mode relies on that key to tell whether facts were already gathered.
procedure: Locate the global setting definition in lib/ansible/constants.py. Next to the related DEFAULT_* entries, add a get_config(p, DEFAULTS, '<ini_key>', 'ANSIBLE_<ENV>', '<default>') call.
If the value is an enum string such as smart/implicit/explicit or never, append .lower() to normalize case. Do not use boolean=True.

In lib/ansible/playbook/play.py, change the play-level field default from a hard-coded True to None, e.g. ds.get('gather_facts', None). This makes the field tri-state, so 'user did not set it' is distinguishable from an explicit True or False.

In the consumer, here PlayBook._do_setup_step in lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py, decide in this order. First compute host_list with _trim_unavailable_hosts. If the play value is None, fall back to C.DEFAULT_GATHERING. If the play value is explicitly True or False, it wins and the global setting is ignored.

Implement smart mode by filtering against the existing cache. Keep only hosts where h not in self.SETUP_CACHE or 'module_setup' not in self.SETUP_CACHE[h]. If the filtered list is empty, return {} immediately and skip callbacks.on_setup and inventory.restrict_to.
Implement never mode, or an explicit False, as an immediate return {}. Make sure inventory.restrict_to receives the filtered host_list.
validation: Run the existing unit tests (test/units) and confirm that playbook and play loading still pass.
Write a playbook with two plays against the same hosts and no gather_facts set. Under the default smart mode, setup should run only for the first play.
Set ANSIBLE_GATHERING=never (also try uppercase NEVER). Confirm that setup does not run, and that a play with gather_facts: True still gathers facts.
With ANSIBLE_GATHERING=implicit, confirm that every play without gather_facts set gathers facts, and that a play with gather_facts: False skips gathering.

name: ansible-config-key-rename-with-deprecated-fallback
negative_constraints: 不要直接删除旧 key 的读取,否则已有的 ansible.cfg 会静默失效。
不要在内层回退调用里重复传入环境变量名,以免优先级混乱、重复查询。
不要只改 lib/ansible 而遗漏 v2/ansible 的平行 constants.py。
不要改变原有的默认路径值或环境变量名。
procedure: 在 lib/ansible/constants.py 中定位目标 DEFAULT_* 常量的 get_config(p, DEFAULTS, '<old_key>', '<ENV>', <default>) 调用。
如果 v2/ansible/constants.py 存在,也定位其中同名常量。这是并行代码树,两处必须同步修改。
把 get_config 的第三个参数(ini key)改成新的一致名称,例如 'inventory'。环境变量名(如 ANSIBLE_HOSTS)保持不变,以免破坏用户环境。
把原来的字面默认值替换成一个嵌套调用:get_config(p, DEFAULTS, '<old_key>', None, <original_default>)。env 参数传 None,让旧 key 只作为 ini 回退。这样优先级为:环境变量 > 新 key > 旧 key > 原始默认值。
保留外层的 shell_expand_path(或 boolean/integer 等转换参数),使它作用在最终解析出的值上。
确认新旧两个 constants 文件中的行完全一致。
validation: 运行现有测试(如 test/units 中涉及 constants/inventory 的部分)。
运行 python -c 'import ansible.constants as C; print(C.DEFAULT_HOST_LIST)',分别在以下四种情况下验证:无配置、ansible.cfg 仅含 hostfile=、仅含 inventory=、设置 ANSIBLE_HOSTS 环境变量。确认优先级正确。
用 grep 检查两个 constants.py 中的目标行是否一致。

name: ansible-config-raw-read-for-percent-templates
negative_constraints: Do not rely on ConfigParser's `%(name)s` interpolation to pass runtime values.
Do not widen the bare `except` into returning partially parsed values. Keep falling back to the default.
procedure: Open lib/ansible/constants.py and inspect `_get_config`. Note the order of lookup: env var first, then `p.get(section, key)`, then the default.
Change the ini read to `p.get(section, key, raw=True)`. Values containing `%` (ssh tokens, strftime formats, Python templates) are then returned verbatim.
Note that an env-var value and the code default are already used as-is. Raw reading of the cfg file keeps all three sources consistent.
Have any consumer that needs runtime substitution do the formatting itself, using named-dict % formatting at the point of use.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Write an ansible.cfg value containing a literal `%h`. Confirm that loading constants raises no error and returns the literal value.

name: ansible-connection-plugin-become-password-separation
negative_constraints: 不要用 connection_info.password 判断或应答 sudo/su 等 become prompt。
不要在子类里把 sudoable 硬编码为 False 再传给基类 exec_command。
不要省略 become_methods 声明,也不要让插件默认接受全部 C.BECOME_METHODS,包括它不支持的 runas。
不要留下 q()、print 等调试调用。
不要改动基类 ConnectionBase 的口令语义来迁就单个插件。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/plugins/connections/<plugin>.py 中 exec_command 的 become/sudo 处理分支。检查哪些地方用了 self._connection_info.password,哪些地方用了 become_pass。
区分两种口令:remote 登录口令是 password,只在建立 ssh 时通过 _send_password 发送;提权口令是 become_pass,用于 become 分支的条件判断,以及回写 stdin 应答提权 prompt。
become 判断条件改为同时检查三项:self._connection_info.become、sudoable、self._connection_info.become_pass。
become prompt 应答改为 stdin.write(self._connection_info.become_pass + '\n')。
检查 super().exec_command 的调用:要把调用方传入的 sudoable 原样透传,不要硬编码 sudoable=False。否则基类的 become 校验会被绕过。
在 Connection 类上声明类属性 become_methods,写成 frozenset(C.BECOME_METHODS).difference([...]),排除该传输不支持的方法(ssh 排除 'runas')。这样基类可以据此拒绝不支持的 become 方法。
检查 _send_password 的调用:由它自己判断是否有 password,不要再用无关的 prompt 变量做门控。
删除调试残留,例如 q(...) 调用。
validation: 运行现有单元测试:test/units 下的 connection 和 plugins 相关测试。
全局搜索 _connection_info.password,确认它只出现在登录认证路径上。
用 ansible -m ping --become -K 测试一个需要 sudo 密码的主机,确认发送的是 become 密码。
测试 become_method=runas 走 ssh 连接,确认基类报出不支持的错误。
grep 确认不存在残留的 q( 调试调用。

name: ansible-connection-plugin-lazy-connect
negative_constraints: 不要在 ConnectionBase.__init__ 或子类构造函数里隐式建立网络连接。
不要把实例状态的首次初始化(例如 ssh.py 的 self._common_args = [])放在 _connect() 中。否则跳过 _connect 或 _connect 提前 return 时会出现 AttributeError, 或者重复调用时状态被重置。
不要移除 _connect() 开头的 _connected 短路判断。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/plugins/connections/__init__.py 中 ConnectionBase.__init__, 删除构造函数末尾的 self._connect() 调用, 让 plugin 实例化与建立连接解耦。
保留 __init__ 中 `if not hasattr(self, '_connected'): self._connected = False` 的初始化, 让调用方(executor/action)能按需调用 _connect()。
检查各具体 connection plugin(ssh/paramiko/local/winrm 等)的 _connect(): 必须以 `if self._connected: return self` 开头, 保证可重复调用(幂等), 并在成功后设置 self._connected = True。
核对 exec_command/put_file/fetch_file 依赖的实例属性。凡是 _connect() 之前就可能被读取的, 都要在 __init__ 里初始化, 不能放在 _connect() 中。
在子类 __init__ 中, 先赋值本类属性, 再调用 super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)。
validation: run existing tests: test/units 下与 plugins/connections 相关的单测。
实例化 Connection(play_context, new_stdin) 时不应触发 ssh/paramiko 连接, 可以 mock subprocess/paramiko 验证没有被调用。
连续调用两次 _connect(), 确认第二次直接返回, 且 _common_args 没有被重复追加或清空。
跑一个基于 ssh 的简单 ad-hoc 命令, 确认按需连接的流程仍然可用。

name: ansible-creates-removes-short-circuit-no-skipped-flag
negative_constraints: 不要在模块的 exit_json 中返回 skipped=True。skipped 是任务执行器(when 条件)层面的语义,模块层返回它会导致回调和统计误报为 skipped。
不要改变 changed=False 的取值,也不要改成 fail_json。文件条件满足时属于正常的幂等早退。
不要修改 stdout 提示文案和 rc=0,下游 playbook 可能依赖它们。
不要顺带重构 HTTP 请求逻辑或其他无关代码。
procedure: 在目标模块的 main() 中定位 creates/removes 早退分支。这类分支形如 `if os.path.exists(creates): module.exit_json(...)` 或 `if not os.path.exists(removes): module.exit_json(...)`,例如 lib/ansible/modules/network/basics/uri.py。
对照参考实现,即 command/shell 模块里的 creates/removes 处理:它们只返回 changed=False 和说明性 stdout(例如 'skipped, since X exists'),不设置 skipped=True。
从每个早退分支的 exit_json 调用中删除 `skipped=True` 参数。保留 changed=False、stdout 文本、stderr 和 rc,保证返回结构与 command/shell 一致。
creates 分支和 removes 分支都要改,保持对称,不要只修一个。
检查 removes 分支里展开后的路径变量(v = os.path.expanduser(removes))是否被实际使用。本次修复保持最小 diff,只记录这一问题,不扩大范围。
validation: 运行现有的 uri 模块单元测试和集成测试(test/integration targets uri),确认全部通过。
手动验证:先 touch 一个文件,再执行带 creates=<该文件> 的 uri 任务。结果中应为 changed=false,不含 skipped 键,且任务统计计入 ok 而不是 skipped。
对 removes 指向不存在的文件做同样验证。
grep 模块中所有 exit_json 调用,确认不再出现 skipped=True。

name: ansible-dict-merge-type-error-message
negative_constraints: 不要在错误消息里用 %s 格式化完整的变量值（旧实现会打印两个完整的值）。
不要因为 combine_vars 已经校验过，就删除 merge_hash 中的校验；递归合并嵌套 dict 时依赖它。
不要改变抛出的异常类型（仍为 errors.AnsibleError），也不要改变函数签名和合并语义。
不要为了一处措辞调整去改 changelog 或文档；该 PR 的维护面只有 code。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/utils/__init__.py 中的 _validate_both_dicts(a, b)。它是 merge_hash 和 combine_vars 共用的类型校验点。
改写 errors.AnsibleError 的消息，统一用小写开头的简短句式，例如 "failed to combine variables, expected dicts but got a '%s' and a '%s'"。
参数使用 type(a).__name__ 和 type(b).__name__。消息中只报告类型名，不插入 a、b 的原始值，以免泄露大段或敏感的变量内容，也避免消息过长、难以阅读。
在 merge_hash 中保留对 _validate_both_dicts 的调用，放在初始化 result 之后、遍历之前。旁边加注释，说明 combine_vars 已经校验过一次，这里仍要校验，因为 merge_hash 会对嵌套 dict 递归调用。
只修改共享 helper，不要在各个调用点分别拼接错误文本，这样所有合并路径的报错保持一致。
validation: 运行现有的 utils 单元测试（如 test/units/TestUtils.py），确认 merge_hash 和 combine_vars 的行为不变。
手动调用 merge_hash({'a': 1}, [1])，确认抛出 AnsibleError，且消息包含 'dict' 和 'list' 类型名，不包含原始值。
用嵌套结构测试递归路径，例如 merge_hash({'a': {'x': 1}}, {'a': 'str'})，确认能触发同样的类型错误。

name: ansible-distribution-fact-ordered-detection
negative_constraints: 不要用 dict 存放 release 路径映射，否则顺序不确定，重复的路径 key 也会被覆盖。
不要在名称校验失败的分支里 break，否则共享文件(os-release)上的后续候选永远不会被检查。
不要在已匹配后继续循环，否则后续条目可能覆盖已经正确的 distribution 值。
不要在这个 bugfix 中顺带重写整个 if-else 结构。只留 TODO，保持改动范围最小。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 中 Facts 类的 release 文件映射表 (OSDIST_DICT/OSDIST_LIST)，以及 get_distribution_facts 里 Linux 分支中遍历该表的循环。
把 dict 映射改为有序的 (path, name) 元组列表。原因有两个：dict 的遍历顺序不确定，而且同一个文件(如 /etc/os-release)要能映射到多个候选发行版(SuSE、Debian)。
把更具体的发行版条目排在通用条目前面。例如 os-release 的 SuSE 条目放在 Debian 条目之前。新发行版(如通过 /etc/lsb-release 识别的 Mandriva)追加到合适的位置。
每个 name 分支用 get_file_content(path) 读取文件，再检查标志字符串。确认匹配后设置 distribution / distribution_version / distribution_release，然后立即 break。
不匹配时不要 break，让循环继续尝试后续条目。这样共享文件的其它候选才有机会被判定。
对于 platform.dist() 已经可信的发行版(如 Fedora)，放进一个可信元组，命中就直接 break，不再被 release 文件覆盖。
新增发行版时，从 release 文件中用正则(如 DISTRIB_RELEASE="(.*)"、DISTRIB_CODENAME="(.*)")提取版本和代号。要先判断正则匹配结果再赋值。
validation: 运行现有的 facts 单元测试和 setup 模块测试，确认没有回归。
构造 /etc/os-release(分别包含 SUSE 和 Debian 内容)和 /etc/lsb-release(DISTRIB_ID=Mandriva 等内容)的样例，mock os.path.exists 和 get_file_content，验证 distribution、distribution_version、distribution_release 的取值。
验证 Fedora、RedHat、Amazon 的检测结果与改动前一致。

name: ansible-distribution-facts-fallback-ordering
negative_constraints: 不要让 NA 或其他泛化兜底条目出现在具体发行版条目之前。
不要在内容检查之外无条件 break，否则会吞掉后续发行版的检测机会。
不要用 Debian 的 PRETTY_NAME 正则覆盖 Ubuntu 的 distribution_release，例如把 'Xenial Xerus' 写成错误的值。
不要为修复单个发行版重排整个列表，只移动必要的条目。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 里 Facts.OSDIST_LIST 中 (path, name) 元组的顺序。再找到 get_distribution_facts 中遍历该列表的 for 循环，以及循环里按 name 分支的 elif 链。
确认匹配规则：循环按顺序取第一个存在的文件，进入对应 name 分支后执行 break 才算命中。没有 break 时会继续检查后面的条目。
把通用兜底条目 ('/etc/os-release', 'NA') 放到列表最后一项。新增或已有的发行版条目（例如 ('/etc/lsb-release', 'Mandriva')）都要排在 NA 前面，这样 NA 只在其他条目都不匹配时才生效。
共享同一文件（如 /etc/os-release）的分支要先检查文件内容，只有确认属于本发行版时才 break。把 break 放进内容匹配的 if 块里，不要放在 if 之外无条件执行。
有些发行版已经能从 python platform/lsb 函数拿到正确信息，比如 os-release 内容含 'Ubuntu' 的 Ubuntu。对这类发行版，在 Debian 分支里先判断 'Ubuntu' 并直接 break，保留已有 facts，不要再用 PRETTY_NAME 的正则改写 distribution_release。
检查改动后各发行版走的分支：Debian/Raspbian 仍能从 PRETTY_NAME 解析出 release；Ubuntu 保留 python 提供的值；Mandriva 能被识别；未知发行版最后才落到 NA。
validation: run existing unit tests for module_utils facts
用 Ubuntu（多个版本）、Debian、Raspbian、Mandriva 和未知发行版的 /etc/os-release 与 /etc/lsb-release 样例，mock get_file_content/os.path.exists，确认 distribution 和 distribution_release 正确。
确认未知发行版在 NA 分支才被处理，已知发行版不会落到 NA。

name: ansible-distro-detection-fallback-ordering
negative_constraints: 不要把 NA 兜底条目放在任何具体发行版条目之前，否则后面的条目永远到不了。
不要在 Debian 分支中仅凭 os-release 存在就设置 distribution_release，Ubuntu 的 os-release 也满足该条件。
不要为 Ubuntu 新增一套重复的 os-release 解析逻辑；Python 内置函数已经给出正确信息，break 让它生效即可。
不要改动与本次误判无关的发行版的匹配逻辑。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 中的 Facts.OSDIST_LIST 元组。它按顺序探测 (path, name) 对，第一个匹配的条目获胜。
检查每个文件探测分支（如 name == 'Debian'、'SuSE'、'Mandriva'）是否会因为文件存在就误命中。共享的文件很容易造成误判，例如 /etc/os-release 和 /etc/lsb-release 在 Ubuntu 上都存在。
把兜底条目 ('/etc/os-release', 'NA') 移到元组末尾，确保所有具体发行版（包括 Mandriva 这类基于 lsb-release 的）都排在它前面。
在共享文件的发行版分支里，先识别会出现在相同文件中的派生发行版并提前 break。例如在 Debian 分支中先检查 'Ubuntu' in data，命中就 break，交给 platform.linux_distribution() 的 Python 结果处理。然后才匹配 'Debian'/'Raspbian'。
只修改顺序和分支内的判别条件，保留其余 OSDIST_LIST 条目和解析正则不变。
validation: run existing tests (unit tests for module_utils facts if present)
用 Ubuntu、Debian、Raspbian、Mandriva 和未知发行版的 /etc/os-release、/etc/lsb-release 样本内容模拟 get_file_content，确认 distribution 和 distribution_release 正确，且只有未知发行版落到 NA。
确认 OSDIST_LIST 元组语法正确（多行收尾括号）且 NA 是最后一项。

name: ansible-docs-underscore-deprecated-vs-symlink-alias
negative_constraints: Do not drop every underscore-prefixed module from the docs. Only symlinked aliases are skipped; deprecated real files must still be documented.
Do not overwrite an existing doc['deprecated'] value from the module's YAML.
Do not decide alias status from the name alone. Use os.path.islink on the resolved path.
Do not weaken the BLACKLIST_MODULES or missing-documentation exit for deprecated modules.
Do not touch the templates or module_docs parsing for this fix. The change is confined to process_module's code surface.
procedure: Open the doc generator at hacking/module_formatter.py and find process_module(). It resolves fname = module_map[module] and then filters out files by extension.
Compute basename = os.path.basename(fname) once. Reuse it for every filename check instead of calling basename repeatedly.
Keep the existing early return for files that do not end in .py.

Add an elif branch for basename.startswith('_'). If os.path.islink(fname) is true, the file is an alias, so return without generating docs. Otherwise set deprecated = True, because an underscore-prefixed real file is a deprecated module.
Let deprecated modules continue through the normal ansible.utils.module_docs.get_docstring() parsing and the missing-doc check.

After the doc dict is filled (now_date, ansible_version, plainexamples), inject a default deprecation notice, but only when deprecated is true and 'deprecated' is not in doc. A module's own DOCUMENTATION deprecated text must take precedence.
If an error message mentions 'CORE' modules, generalize it to 'MODULE MISSING DOCUMENTATION'. Deprecated and non-core modules now take the same path.
validation: Run hacking/module_formatter.py over the module tree and confirm it exits 0.
Confirm the output includes a page for an underscore-prefixed real module, and that the page shows the deprecation banner.
Confirm no page is produced for an underscore-prefixed symlink alias.
Confirm a module whose DOCUMENTATION has its own deprecated text keeps that text unchanged.

name: ansible-dual-tree-module-utils-sync
negative_constraints: 不要让两棵树产生分歧, 除非有意为之并写明原因。
procedure: 修改 lib/ansible/module_utils/ 下的任何文件时, 检查 v2/ansible/module_utils/ 下是否存在同名文件。
如果两个文件的 index 哈希相同, 对两处应用完全相同的补丁。
validation: 执行 diff lib/ansible/module_utils/<file> v2/ansible/module_utils/<file>, 应无差异。

name: ansible-error-message-format-arg-count-fix
negative_constraints: 不要把 AnsibleError 换成其他异常类型, 也不要去掉 type(new_vars) != dict 的校验。
不要顺手修正消息里的拼写 (如 'dictonary')。下游测试或用户可能依赖原文本, 改拼写需要单独的变更。
不要改成 str.format 或 f-string。该代码库是旧版 Python 2 风格, 要保持 % 格式化的一致性。
不要改动 vars_files 的加载顺序和 host-specific setup cache 的逻辑。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/playbook/play.py 中抛出 errors.AnsibleError 的位置, 重点看 _update_vars_files_for_host 里 vars_files 的加载分支 (parse_yaml_from_file 之后的 type(new_vars) != dict 校验)。
核对每个 '%s' 占位符的数量与右侧 % 操作数的数量。占位符有多个时, 右侧必须是元组, 例如 % (filename4, type(new_vars))。
复用作用域里已有的变量 (文件路径变量 filename4、解析结果 new_vars) 补上缺失的参数, 让报错同时给出出错的文件和实际解析到的类型。
用 grep 在 lib/ansible 下查找同类写法 (形如 "%s ... %s" % single_var), 只修复当前任务涉及的那一处。顺带发现的其他问题记录下来, 不要扩大本次改动范围。
改动保持在一行之内: 只修格式参数, 不改异常类型, 不改校验逻辑。

keywords: not enough arguments for format string

validation: 构造一个顶层为 list 的 vars_files YAML 文件, 运行 playbook。预期抛出的是 AnsibleError, 消息里包含文件路径和 <type 'list'>, 而不是 TypeError: not enough arguments for format string。
运行现有的 playbook 单元测试 (如 test/TestPlayBook.py), 确认没有回归。
python -m py_compile lib/ansible/playbook/play.py

name: ansible-expose-connection-option-via-config-constant
negative_constraints: Do not change the effective default path. Users who don't set the option must get byte-identical ssh args.
Do not update only one of the duplicated ControlPath sites.
Do not leave ConfigParser interpolation enabled for values that carry % templates.
Do not use positional %s in the template. Use a named key (directory) so users can place it anywhere or omit it.
Do not override ControlPath when the user's ssh_args already set it explicitly (keep the cp_path_set check).
procedure: Locate the hardcoded value in the connection plugin, e.g. `ControlPath=%s/ansible-ssh-%%h-%%p-%%r` in lib/ansible/runner/connection_plugins/ssh.py.
Find every place that builds the same value. Here there are two branches: the default ControlMaster args, and the branch where the user's ssh_args enable ControlPersist without setting ControlPath.
Add a constant in lib/ansible/constants.py next to related settings such as ANSIBLE_SSH_ARGS.

Define it as `ANSIBLE_SSH_CONTROL_PATH = get_config(p, 'ssh_connection', 'control_path', 'ANSIBLE_SSH_CONTROL_PATH', <default>)`. Use the section name, the key, and an env var named ANSIBLE_<UPPER_KEY>.
Make the default reproduce the previous hardcoded behavior exactly. Use a named placeholder for runtime data, e.g. `%(directory)s/ansible-ssh-%%h-%%p-%%r`.
Escape ssh's own tokens as `%%h`, `%%p` and `%%r` so they survive Python %-formatting.
Make `_get_config` read ini values with `p.get(section, key, raw=True)`. Otherwise ConfigParser interpolation will crash on, or mangle, `%(...)s` and `%%` in user values.
In the plugin, replace each hardcoded occurrence with `C.ANSIBLE_SSH_CONTROL_PATH % dict(directory=self.cp_dir)`. Apply the same expression in both branches so they cannot diverge.
validation: Run the existing unit tests, e.g. `make tests` / `nosetests test/units`.
In a Python shell, import ansible.constants. Check that ANSIBLE_SSH_CONTROL_PATH % {'directory': '/tmp/x'} == '/tmp/x/ansible-ssh-%h-%p-%r'.
Set `control_path = %(directory)s/%%h-%%r` in ansible.cfg and run `ansible -vvvv` against a host. Confirm the ssh command line uses the short path and no ConfigParser InterpolationError is raised.
Set ANSIBLE_SSH_CONTROL_PATH as an env var and confirm it overrides the cfg value.
Grep the rest of constants.py for existing values containing '%'. Ensure the raw=True change doesn't alter how they are parsed.

name: ansible-filter-specific-error-with-nonfatal-display-templating
negative_constraints: Do not catch the generic AnsibleError in template(). Swallow only AnsibleFilterError, so undefined-variable and other real errors still surface.
Do not change the default filter_fatal to False. Real task arguments and conditionals must still fail on filter errors.
Do not make filter errors non-fatal anywhere except display/callback paths such as the task name.
Do not make AnsibleFilterError inherit from Exception directly. It must stay a subclass of AnsibleError so existing handlers keep working.
procedure: Add a dedicated exception subclass in lib/ansible/errors.py, e.g. `class AnsibleFilterError(AnsibleError): pass`. Place it next to the existing AnsibleUndefinedVariable. Because it subclasses AnsibleError, existing `except AnsibleError` handlers still catch it.

In lib/ansible/runner/filter_plugins/core.py, replace `errors.AnsibleError` with `errors.AnsibleFilterError` wherever a filter rejects its input type. One example is `|failed expects a dictionary`. Also check the other filters in the same file, such as success, changed and skipped.

Add a keyword argument `filter_fatal=True` at the end of the signature of `template()` in lib/ansible/utils/template.py. Following the `lookup_fatal` pattern, the default must keep the existing fatal behavior.
Wrap the body of `template()` in try/except AnsibleFilterError. If filter_fatal is True, re-raise. Otherwise, return the original unrendered varname.
Pass `filter_fatal` through the recursive `template()` calls. These include the legacy-replacement branch and the dict/list traversal branches. Without this, nested calls fall back to fatal behavior.

In lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py, find the display-only templating call in `on_task_start(template(..., task.name, ..., lookup_fatal=False))` and add `filter_fatal=False`. A task name can reference registered results that do not exist yet, so display rendering must not abort the play.
validation: Run the existing unit tests: `make tests` or `nosetests test/`.
Write a playbook whose task name is `{{ result|failed }}` and where `result` has not been registered yet. Confirm the play starts and prints the raw name instead of crashing.
Confirm that `when: foo|failed` with a non-dict value still raises AnsibleFilterError.
Run `grep -n 'template(' lib/ansible/utils/template.py` and check that every recursive call passes filter_fatal.

name: ansible-fix-copyright-header-name
negative_constraints: 不要改动邮箱、年份或其他贡献者的行。
不要重排或合并版权行,也不要改写许可证正文。
不要顺带修改代码逻辑或格式,diff 应只有一行注释变更。
不要为纯注释修正添加 changelog 或测试。
procedure: 定位目标文件顶部的 '# (c) YEAR, Name <email>' 版权注释块。例如 lib/ansible/runner/lookup_plugins/password.py。
用邮箱地址或项目内其他文件中的同一作者署名交叉核对正确拼写。例如 [REDACTED_EMAIL] 对应 Javier。
只修改拼错的姓名字符,保留年份、邮箱、行顺序和 GPL 许可证文本不变。
用 git grep 搜索相同的错误拼写(如 'Javie Candeira')是否出现在其他文件。是否一并修复,取决于任务范围是否包含这些文件。
validation: 检查 git diff,确认只有一行注释发生变化。
运行 python -m py_compile 编译被修改的文件,确认没有引入语法问题。
运行 git grep 搜索旧拼写,确认结果符合预期。

name: ansible-improve-undefined-variable-template-error
negative_constraints: Do not change the exception class: callers rely on AnsibleUndefinedVariable vs AnsibleError to decide fail_on_undefined behavior.
Do not broaden the except clause or swallow non-StrictUndefined TypeErrors.
Do not convert this code to Python 3-only syntax (e.g. `except TypeError as te` is fine but f-strings are not) in this legacy module.
Do not add variable-name validation or rewriting logic; the fix is a message hint only.
procedure: Locate template_from_string in lib/ansible/utils/template.py and find the `except TypeError` branch that runs after jinja2.utils.concat(rf).
Keep the existing detection logic: `'StrictUndefined' in str(te)` maps to errors.AnsibleUndefinedVariable. Every other TypeError still goes to errors.AnsibleError.

Change only the message text. Use a sentence-cased, actionable message that says what failed and hints at a likely user cause. For example, a variable name containing invalid characters like '-' gets parsed by Jinja2 as subtraction.
Build long messages from string concatenation or implicit adjacent string literals inside the raise(...) parentheses. That keeps the file's Python 2 style (`except TypeError, te`) intact.
Grep the repository and tests for the old message text ('unable to look up a name or access an attribute in template string'). Update any assertions that match on it.

keywords: unable to look up a name

validation: Run the existing unit tests for utils/template (e.g. test/units/TestUtils.py) and check that they pass.
Manually template a string like '{{ my-var }}' with StrictUndefined. Confirm AnsibleUndefinedVariable is raised and the message includes the new hint.
python -m py_compile lib/ansible/utils/template.py

name: ansible-ini-inventory-group-var-quote-handling
negative_constraints: 不要在加注释时修改正则或 set_variable 的行为。纯文档类改动必须对语义零影响。
不要把引号判断放宽到首尾引号不一致的情况(例如 'abc"), 必须保留 \1 反向引用。
不要把 group vars 的去引号逻辑套用到 host 行变量的解析上, 两者在 ini.py 中走的是不同代码路径。
不要把 split('=', 1) 改成不限次数的 split, 否则含 '=' 的值会被截断。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/inventory/ini.py 中 InventoryParser 解析 [group:vars] 段的逻辑, 找到 line.split('=', 1) 后得到 (k, v) 的分支。
复用现有的匹配写法 re.match(r"^(['\"]).*\1$", v) 来判断值是否被成对的单引号或双引号包裹。反向引用 \1 保证首尾引号类型一致。
复用 re.sub(r"^['\"]|['\"]$", '', v) 去掉首尾引号, 然后调用 group.set_variable(k, ...)。未加引号的值原样传给 group.set_variable(k, v)。
在条件判断和去引号语句上方各加一行简短注释, 说明意图。例如 '# When the value is a single-quoted or double-quoted string' 和 '# Unquote the string', 方便后续维护者理解正则的用途。
改动保持在 group vars 分支内的最小范围。只加注释的变更不改动任何控制流。
validation: 运行现有 inventory 单元测试(如 test/units 下与 inventory/ini 相关的测试), 确认全部通过。
手动构造一个包含 [g:vars] 的 ini 文件, 写入 a='x'、b="y"、c=z、d='mixed" 四个值。确认 a 解析为 x, b 解析为 y, c 解析为 z, d 原样保留。
检查 diff, 确认只新增了注释行, 没有逻辑变化。

name: ansible-inventory-default-group-rename
negative_constraints: 不要只改 Group(name=...) 而遗漏 self.groups 的 key 或 active_group_name。否则 list_hosts('ungrouped') 会找不到分组，或者 host 被挂到旧名字下。
不要同时保留 'undefined' 和 'ungrouped' 两个默认组。
不要在同一个 TestCase 中定义同名测试方法。Python 会静默覆盖，unittest 不会报错。
不要把 INI fixture 的期望结果直接复制到 YAML 测试，每个测试应以各自的 fixture 为准。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/inventory_parser.py 中的 InventoryParser._parse_base_groups。这里创建 'all' 和默认分组。出现在任何 [section] 之前的 host 会落入默认分组。
把默认 Group 的名称改为 'ungrouped'。下面三处要用同一个名字，避免 key、active group 和对象名不一致：Group(name=...)、self.groups 字典的 key、初始 active_group_name。
保持 all.add_child_group(ungrouped) 的父子关系。这样 'all' 仍然包含未分组的 host。
检查 YAML inventory 路径和 INI 路径对 'ungrouped' 的语义是否一致。用 list_hosts('ungrouped') 分别验证两种 fixture。
在 test/TestInventory.py 中检查是否有重名的 test_* 方法。比如 INI 和 YAML 都叫 test_simple_ungrouped 时，后定义的会静默覆盖前一个。给 YAML 版本加上格式前缀，例如 test_yaml_ungrouped。
按 YAML fixture 的真实内容修正被覆盖测试的 expected_hosts。重名测试从来没有真正运行过，它的断言可能本来就是错的，例如 YAML fixture 中只有 jupiter 是未分组的。
validation: 运行 test/TestInventory.py 全部用例。可用 nosetests test/TestInventory.py 或 python -m pytest test/TestInventory.py。
确认 INI 版本的 ungrouped 测试和 test_yaml_ungrouped 都被收集并执行（用 -v 查看测试名）。
grep -rn "'undefined'" lib/ansible 应无残留的默认组名引用。
grep -n 'def test_' test/TestInventory.py | sort | uniq -d 检查重复测试名。

name: ansible-inventory-friendly-error-messages
negative_constraints: Do not let a parse failure fall through into the group loop. Doing so creates bogus groups named 'failed', 'msg', etc., or raises confusing AttributeErrors.
Do not add try/except around parse_json to catch ValueError. It signals failure through the 'failed' key, not through exceptions.
Do not change the inventory data model or the YAML-deprecation error path. Keep the change limited to the error messages.
Do not raise generic Python exceptions. Use errors.AnsibleError so the CLI prints a clean message.
procedure: Locate the branch in Inventory.__init__ (lib/ansible/inventory/__init__.py) that raises when the host_list path does not exist or is not a file. Replace the vague message with an actionable one that names the likely fix, e.g. 'Unable to find an inventory file, specify one with -i ?'.
Locate InventoryScript._parse in lib/ansible/inventory/script.py. The script output (self.data) goes through utils.parse_json.

utils.parse_json does not raise on invalid syntax. It returns a dict containing 'failed' (the same convention used for module results). Check `'failed' in self.raw` right after parsing, before iterating groups.

When that key is present, raise errors.AnsibleError with a message that says the executable inventory script output could not be parsed. This also covers a static inventory file that is accidentally marked executable and gets run as a script.
Keep the existing group/host/vars/children parsing logic unchanged. Only move the setup assignments (all, groups, group) as needed so the guard comes before the loop.

keywords: No valid hosts inventory file found

validation: Run the existing inventory unit tests (test/TestInventory.py) to confirm that valid script and INI inventories still parse.
Manually run ansible with -i pointing to a nonexistent path and confirm the new -i hint appears.

Make a static INI hosts file executable (chmod +x), run ansible against it, and confirm the 'failed to parse executable inventory script results' error appears instead of a traceback or garbage groups.

name: ansible-inventory-host-dedup-registry
negative_constraints: 不要在 group 层面去重后再丢弃第二次出现时的行内变量。必须复用同一个 Host 实例, 让变量和组成员关系都累积。
不要把 hosts 注册表做成模块级或类级全局变量。它应该是实例属性, 作用域限于单个 inventory 文件的解析。
不要因为同名主机第二次出现时端口不同就新建对象。现有行为以第一次出现时的 port 为准。如需改变这一点, 应单独处理。
不要只改代码不改测试。expected 的 group_names 和变量必须同步更新。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/inventory_parser.py 中 InventoryParser.__init__ 和 _parse 内创建 Host(name=..., port=...) 的位置。
在 __init__ 中, 在调用 self._parse() 之前, 与 self.groups = {} 并列增加一个按文件作用域的注册表 self.hosts = {}。
解析出 hostname 之后 (已按 ':' 拆分 port), 先查 self.hosts。如果已存在, 直接复用这个 Host 对象。如果不存在, 才新建 Host, 并写入 self.hosts[hostname]。
保持后续逻辑不变: 行内 k=v 变量解析和 group.add_host(host) 都作用在复用的同一个对象上。这样同一主机在不同组里的变量会合并到一个对象, 它的 groups 也会累积。
在 test/ 下的 inventory fixture 中, 增加把已有主机 (如 rtp_a) 重复放进多个新组 (redundantgroup, redundantgroup2, redundantgroup3) 的条目, 每个组带不同的行内变量 (rga, rgb, rgc)。
更新 TestInventory 中对应主机的 expected vars: 增加新变量, 并在 group_names 中按排序加入新组名。
validation: run existing tests: 用 nosetests 或 python -m unittest 运行 test/TestInventory.py。
确认重复出现的主机在 group_names 中包含所有所属组, 并且按排序输出。
确认每个组行内定义的变量都合并到同一主机上, 原有变量 (a, b, c, d) 没有被覆盖丢失。
确认 list hosts 时不会出现同一主机的重复条目。

name: ansible-inventory-separate-host-vars-loading-from-retrieval
negative_constraints: Do not call the public get_variables while loading or caching vars. It returns the object's merged view and causes self-referential overwrites.
Do not merge host.get_variables() or group.get_variables() back into the vars that are being loaded and assigned to the same object.
Do not remove or change the signature of the public get_variables(hostname, update_cached, vault_password), because external callers depend on it.
Do not break the _vars_per_host cache or the update_cached refresh behavior.
procedure: Open lib/ansible/inventory/__init__.py. Find where Inventory.__init__ merges host_vars/ files and vars plugins into host.vars inside the `for host in self.get_hosts()` loop.

Separate loading from retrieval. Rename the loader that reads files, plugins and the cache to get_host_variables / _get_host_variables. It should only collect vars from host_vars/ files, vars plugins and the InventoryScript per-host data. Keep the _vars_per_host cache and the update_cached semantics.

Keep the public API get_variables(hostname, ...). Its job is retrieval only: return self.get_host(hostname).get_variables(). That method already merges group vars and host vars in the correct precedence.

In the load loop, call get_host_variables when assigning host.vars = utils.combine_vars(host.vars, ...). Do not call get_variables there, because it reads back the already-merged object and the merge goes circular.

In _get_host_variables and _get_group_variables, remove any line that merges host.get_variables() or group.get_variables() again. Those values came from the inventory parser and already live on the object, so merging them during loading double-counts them and breaks precedence.

grep the whole repository for callers of _get_variables, get_variables and _vars_per_host, such as runner, playbook and the vars plugins. Confirm the renamed private method has no remaining callers, and that external callers still get final merged vars through get_variables.
validation: Run the existing inventory unit tests: test/units/TestInventory.py, or run nosetests on test/units.
Build an INI inventory where a group var and a host var share a name. Check that the host var overrides the group var, and that group_vars/ and host_vars/ files keep their expected precedence.
Check that get_variables(host) returns the merged vars, including group vars that came from parent groups.
Check that host_vars files and vars plugins are each merged only once, with no duplication and no lost values.

name: ansible-jinja-filter-explicit-value-arg
negative_constraints: Do not use `*a` as the only positional parameter in filter wrappers, because extra filter args then shift into json.dumps parameter slots.
Do not rename existing filter names or change their default formatting (indent=4, sort_keys=True). Templates depend on that output.
Do not silently catch exceptions inside filters. Let the template layer convert them into AnsibleError.
procedure: In lib/ansible/runner/filter_plugins/core.py, find the filter wrappers that forward star-args to json.dumps or yaml.safe_dump. The bad pattern is `def f(*a, **kw): json.dumps(*a, indent=..., **kw)`.
Change the wrapper signature to `def f(a, *args, **kw)`. This names the piped value `a` explicitly as the first positional argument, so extra Jinja filter arguments cannot be mistaken for it.
Forward the call as `json.dumps(a, indent=4, sort_keys=True, *args, **kw)`. The value stays first, then the fixed formatting kwargs, then `*args` and `**kw`.

Do not register stdlib callables directly in FilterModule.filters(), as `'to_json': json.dumps` did. Add a thin wrapper such as `def to_json(a, *args, **kw): return json.dumps(a, *args, **kw)` and register the wrapper instead.
Apply the same check to sibling filters (to_nice_yaml / to_yaml) that use the `*a` pattern.
validation: Render `{{ var | to_json }}`, `{{ var | to_nice_json }}` and `{{ var | to_nice_json(ensure_ascii=False) }}` through template_from_string, and confirm valid JSON comes back with no traceback.
Run the existing unit tests (test/units, TestUtils template tests).

name: ansible-legacy-play-task-keyword-inheritance
negative_constraints: Do not add the key to VALID_KEYS without also adding it to __slots__, and the reverse is equally broken. Both lists must stay in sync in both Play and Task.
Do not read the play-level value directly in the executor. Use task.<key> so task-level overrides work.
Do not change the default behaviour. The new flag must default to False or an equivalent no-op value.
procedure: Locate lib/ansible/playbook/play.py and lib/ansible/playbook/task.py in the legacy PlayBook implementation.
Add the new attribute to Play.__slots__. Without it, the assignment raises AttributeError.
Add the new attribute to Play.VALID_KEYS. Without it, the play is rejected as having an unknown key.
In Play.__init__, read the value with ds.get('<key>', <default>). Follow the existing gather_facts and serial pattern.
Register the same key in both Task.__slots__ and Task.VALID_KEYS.
In Task.__init__, read ds.get('<key>', play.<key>) next to ignore_errors. This lets the task value override the play value and fall back to it when absent.
If the behaviour must take effect at runtime, consume it in the PlayBook task loop in lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py. Read it from the task object, not from the play.
If the keyword needs a CLI or constructor entry point, add a defaulted kwarg to PlayBook.__init__ and store it on self.
validation: Run the existing tests under test/ (TestPlayBook).
Load a playbook that sets the key at play level and another that sets it at task level. Confirm there is no unknown-key error.
Confirm task.<key> equals the play value when the task does not set it, and equals the task value when it does.

name: ansible-linux-distribution-detection-fallback
negative_constraints: 不要使用不存在的 API,例如 os.path.is_file。正确写法是 os.path.isfile。外层的裸 except 会吞掉 AttributeError,导致识别静默失败、退化为默认值,原 diff 里就有这个隐患。
不要假设 linux_distribution() 识别失败时返回 'NA',应该用真值判断(not distribution)。
不要把具体发行版写死在各个模块里各自识别,应统一在 get_distribution() 中归一化。
不要让新增的 Amazon 分支吞掉其他走 /etc/system-release 的发行版,其他发行版仍应回落到 'OtherLinux'。
不要改变 get_distribution() 在非 Linux 平台上的行为。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py 里的 get_distribution()。所有模块(包括 hostname)都通过这个函数按发行版名分派平台实现类,所以识别逻辑只改这一处。
先确认 platform.linux_distribution()[0] 在目标发行版上的真实返回值。Amazon Linux 上它返回空字符串,不是 'NA'。旧代码里的判断 `distribution == 'NA'` 永远不会成立,这就是 bug 的根因。
把判空条件改成 `if not distribution`,并且同时检查发行版特征文件是否存在,例如 os.path.isfile('/etc/system-release')。
复用 platform.linux_distribution(supported_dists=['system']) 读取 /etc/system-release 并解析出名字。如果名字里包含 'Amazon',就把 distribution 归一化为规范值 'Amazon'。其他情况才回落到 'OtherLinux'。
确认使用发行版名分派的模块(如 hostname 模块里 Strategy/Hostname 子类的 distribution 属性)存在匹配 'Amazon' 的类。如果没有,就新增一个子类,复用最接近的现有策略(Amazon Linux 走 RedHat 风格,即 /etc/sysconfig/network)。
保持函数原有的 try/except 结构和返回值类型不变,只修改分支逻辑。
validation: run existing tests (module_utils/basic 相关单测)
mock platform.linux_distribution 返回 ('', '', ''),并让 os.path.isfile('/etc/system-release') 为 True、带 supported_dists 的调用返回 ('Amazon Linux AMI', ...)。断言 get_distribution() 返回 'Amazon'。
mock /etc/system-release 内容为非 Amazon 时,断言返回 'OtherLinux'。
mock 返回正常发行版名(如 'centos')时,断言行为不变,仍为 'Centos'。
人工检查函数中调用的 os/platform API 名称确实存在,防止被裸 except 掩盖。

name: ansible-lookup-plugin-add-keyvalue-param
negative_constraints: 不要改变不传新参数时的默认行为，默认字符集必须与原硬编码完全一致。
不要绕过 assert(name in paramvals) 的参数名校验。新参数必须先登记进 paramvals。
不要承诺支持引号转义。实现中把 ' 和 " 直接剥除，文档和规则里都要注明不支持引号。
不要在密码文件已存在的读取路径上应用 chars。字符集只用于新生成密码的分支。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/runner/lookup_plugins/<plugin>.py 里的 LookupModule.run。找到 paramvals 默认值字典，以及解析 'name=value' 的循环。这个循环用 assert(name in paramvals) 校验参数名。
在 paramvals 中加入新参数的默认值。默认值要等价于原来硬编码的行为。例如 chars 的默认值写成 ['ascii_letters','digits',".,:-_"]，结果与旧的 ascii_letters + digits + ".,:-_" 一致。
在解析循环中为新参数加一个 elif name == '<param>' 分支，做专门解析。其他参数仍走 else 分支，原样赋值。
列表型参数按逗号拆分。字面逗号用 ',,' 转义：值中出现 ',,' 时，先把 ',' 加入结果列表，再执行 replace(',,', ',') 和 split(',')。
名字到值的解析通过 getattr(string, name, name) 完成。这样 string 模块里的属性名（ascii_letters、digits、punctuation 等）会展开成对应字符集，其余输入按字面使用。需要在文件中加上 import string，原有的 from string import ... 保留，以兼容其他用法。
在 paramvals 读取段把解析结果取出，形如 use_chars = paramvals['chars']。然后替换原来硬编码的位置，例如 chars = ''.join(getattr(string,c,c) for c in use_chars)。
validation: 运行现有的 lookup 插件测试，例如 test/units 中与 password 相关的用例。
手动验证：lookup('password', '/tmp/p chars=digits length=8') 应只生成数字。
验证 chars=ascii_letters,,, 的结果同时包含字母和逗号。
验证 chars=abc 按字面使用这三个字符。
验证不传 chars 时输出的字符集与旧版本一致。

name: ansible-lookup-plugin-keyvalue-params
negative_constraints: Do not parse only params[1]. Options must be order-independent and repeatable.
Do not silently ignore unknown option names.
Do not let raw ValueError or AssertionError escape to the user. Wrap them in AnsibleError.
Do not change the existing defaults (LENGTH=20) or the char set semantics.
procedure: Locate lib/ansible/runner/lookup_plugins/<name>.py and its LookupModule.run().
Keep the existing term layout: split the term on whitespace. params[0] is the path. params[1:] are key=value options.
Replace any hard-coded single-option parsing with a paramvals dict that holds the defaults, e.g. {'length': LENGTH, 'encrypt': None}.
Parse each param with name, value = param.split('=').
Assert that name is in paramvals so unknown keys are rejected.
Coerce types per key, e.g. int() for length.
Wrap the whole parsing loop in try/except (ValueError, AssertionError) and re-raise as errors.AnsibleError.
Add each new option to the __init__ signature (e.g. encrypt=None). Keep **kwargs so constructor calls stay compatible.
Read the final values from paramvals after the loop. Do not scatter the defaults through the code.
validation: Run existing tests (test/ lookup tests if present).
Manually check: 'path', 'path length=10', 'path encrypt=md5_crypt length=8' and 'path length=8 encrypt=md5_crypt' all parse. 'path bogus=1' and 'path length=abc' raise AnsibleError.

name: ansible-low-level-execute-always-return-rc
negative_constraints: 不要让返回字典在不同路径下有不同的键集合。
不要在本次 bugfix 中重构整个 ssh connection 或处理 ipv6 相关的 FIXME。
不要改变 stdout/stderr 的内容格式。
procedure: 定位 ActionBase._low_level_execute_command 的返回点。若 rc is None, 先把 rc 规范化为 0, 再统一返回 dict(rc=rc, stdout=out, stderr=err)。这样调用方读取 result['rc'] 不会抛 KeyError。
检查 connections/ssh.py 中 put_file、fetch_file、exec_command 内的局部变量, 确认 host = self._connection_info.remote_addr 在首次使用之前赋值, 包括 display.vvv 的 host= 参数。
保留原有的 FIXME 注释位置语义, 即这三个方法今后应抽取为共用函数。本次只做最小改动。
close() 中若涉及 ControlMaster 清理, 只在 'ControlMaster' 出现在 self._common_args 时执行。
validation: 运行现有测试套件: test/units 中涉及 action 和 connection 插件的部分。
用 ssh 连接执行 raw 或 copy、fetch 任务, 确认 -vvv 日志中 PUT/FETCH 行显示正确的 host, 且没有 NameError 或 KeyError。

name: ansible-max-fail-pct-serial-batch-denominator
negative_constraints: Do not compute the failure percentage against the total inventory or play host count when serial batching is active. A small batch would then never reach the threshold.
Do not change the max_fail_pct defaulting logic above this block, where it is set to 0 when unset.
Do not alter the non-serial code path or the integer truncation semantics of int(pct/100.0 * count).
Do not mutate play._play_hosts while computing the count.
procedure: In lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py, open PlayBook._run_play (the per-task loop that ends with the comment 'If threshold for max nodes failed is exceeded, bail out').
Find where hosts_count, host_list and play.max_fail_pct are compared. hosts_count is the size of the whole play. host_list is the set of hosts still alive.
Branch on play.serial > 0. When serial is set, use the number of hosts in the current serial batch as the denominator: play_count = len(play._play_hosts).
In the serial branch, set host_list = None when (play_count - len(host_list)) > int(play.max_fail_pct/100.0 * play_count).
Keep the existing non-serial branch unchanged. It still compares against hosts_count.
Leave the existing 'if not host_list' early exit as it is, so the bail-out path stays the same in both branches.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for playbook execution (test/units).
Manual check: a playbook with serial: 2, max_fail_percentage: 49 and 4 hosts, where 1 host in the batch fails. The play should abort for that batch. Before the fix it continued.
Manual check: a playbook without serial should keep the same abort behavior as before.
Check that serial: 0 or unset follows the original hosts_count branch.

name: ansible-module-argument-type-coercion
negative_constraints: Do not reject string input outright. Module arguments often come from key=value command-line strings, so convert them whenever conversion is possible.
Do not split on every '=' when building a dict. Use split('=', 1) so that values containing '=' are preserved.
Do not reimplement boolean parsing. Reuse self.boolean().
Do not type-check parameters that the user did not provide. Defaults are handled by _set_defaults.
Do not merge choices validation and type validation into one method. Keep two methods with single responsibilities.
Do not run the checks when bypass_checks=True.
procedure: Locate AnsibleModule.__init__ in lib/ansible/module_common.py. Find the validation chain inside `if not bypass_checks:`. It runs _check_required_arguments, then the choices check, then the mutually_exclusive and required_together checks.

If the existing method has a misleading name (for example, _check_argument_types actually validates choices), rename it by intent first (for example, to _check_argument_values). Then update its call site so the old name is free for the real type-checking method.

Add a new _check_argument_types method. Iterate self.argument_spec.iteritems(). Skip a parameter when it has no 'type', or when k is not in self.params, so that defaults and missing optional parameters do not trigger errors.

Coerce as far as possible. Use 'str': wrap non-basestring values with str(). Use 'list': split basestring values on ','. Use 'dict': convert basestring values with dict(x.split('=', 1) for x in value.split(',')), splitting only on the first '='. Use 'bool': pass basestring values through the existing self.boolean().
Mark a value as invalid only when it is neither the target type nor a convertible string. Then fail_json with a message that includes the argument name, the actual type, and the required type.
Handle an unknown type value as a developer error. Use fail_json with 'implementation error: unknown type ... requested for ...' so it is distinguishable from a user input error.

Insert the new call into the validation chain after _check_required_arguments and the values check, and before the mutually_exclusive and required_together checks. Write each coerced value back to self.params[k].
validation: Run the existing unit and integration tests, for example `make tests`.
Manually build an AnsibleModule with argument_spec type=list/dict/bool/str. Pass 'a,b', 'k=v,k2=v=x', 'yes', and 5, and verify that each converts to the correct type.
Pass a non-string, non-target type (for example, an int to a list parameter) and verify that fail_json reports the argument name and type.
Pass an undefined type such as 'foo' and verify that the error is reported as an implementation error.
Verify that the choices check still works after the rename.

name: ansible-module-common-distribution-fallback-detection
negative_constraints: 不要写 os.path.is_file。该函数不存在,正确名称是 os.path.isfile。
注意上一条的后果:这里的 bare except 会吞掉 AttributeError,代码会静默回退到 platform.dist(),修复等于没生效。
不要在 try 块里加入可能抛异常的新代码却不单独验证,bare except 会掩盖错误。
不要无条件检查 /etc/system-release。CentOS、Fedora 和 RHEL 也有这个文件,只能在哨兵值 'NA' 的情况下使用。
不要改动返回值的大小写约定。下游模块按 capitalize() 后的名称比较。
不要在模块侧另写一套 distribution 检测,应复用 get_distribution()。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_common.py 中的 get_distribution()。它是模块侧 distribution 判定的唯一入口,保持只在这里修改。
保留现有流程:先在 platform.system() == 'Linux' 分支内调用 platform.linux_distribution()[0].capitalize();抛异常时回退到 platform.dist()[0].capitalize()。
在 linux_distribution() 结果之后、except 之前,增加一个针对'无法识别'哨兵值的分支。对 Amazon Linux 来说,哨兵值是 'NA'。
在该分支里用发行版特有的 release 文件做判定,例如用 os.path.isfile('/etc/system-release') 判定 Amazon。命中后赋一个规范化的首字母大写名,如 'Amazon'。
确认 os 已在 module_common 顶部导入。该代码会被嵌入远端模块执行,不能引入新依赖。
新分支必须嵌套在已识别值检查之内,只在哨兵值出现时生效,不改变 RedHat/Debian/Ubuntu 等已识别发行版的返回值。
validation: 运行 python -c 'import os; os.path.isfile' 之类的检查,或用 pyflakes 检查 module_common.py,确认调用的 os.path 函数确实存在。
mock platform.linux_distribution 返回 ('NA', '', ''),并 mock os.path.isfile('/etc/system-release') 为 True,断言 get_distribution() == 'Amazon'。
mock linux_distribution 返回 ('redhat', ...),断言仍返回 'Redhat',即不受新分支影响。
运行现有测试套件(make tests / nosetests)。

name: ansible-module-common-method-call-not-reference
negative_constraints: Do not change only the try branch and leave the except/fallback branch still returning a bound method.
Do not restructure the distribution detection logic or swap platform APIs in a minimal bugfix.
Do not change the non-Linux behavior, which returns None.
Do not wrap the result in str(), because that would hide the bug and produce '<built-in method ...>' text.
procedure: Locate the helper in lib/ansible/module_common.py (e.g. get_distribution) whose return value appears as '<built-in method ... of str object>' instead of a string.

Inspect every branch, both the try path (platform.linux_distribution()) and the except fallback (platform.dist()), for string methods (capitalize/lower/strip/upper) written as attribute access without the call parentheses.
Add '()' to each such method reference so that each branch returns a str. Fix all parallel branches together, not only the first one.
Keep the existing control flow unchanged: the bare-except fallback and the None return for non-Linux. Change only the expressions that are not being called.
Check other callers or templated module code that consume the value, such as facts or string comparisons. Confirm they now receive a str and no longer apply any workaround for a callable.
validation: Run python -c 'from ansible.module_common import ...' or a module that calls get_distribution(), and assert isinstance(result, str) on Linux.
Simulate the fallback by mocking platform.linux_distribution to raise, then assert that the platform.dist() branch also returns a capitalized str.
Run the existing test suite (make tests / nosetests) to check for regressions.

name: ansible-module-common-safe-edit-guardrails
negative_constraints: Do not leave stray signature edits, such as a missing colon, in unrelated methods.
Do not reference source or temp paths after they have been renamed away.
procedure: Before submitting any change to lib/ansible/module_common.py, review every hunk, including context lines you did not mean to touch.
Treat module_common as shipped verbatim to remote hosts. A single syntax error breaks every module, so keep each change minimal and confined to its function.
For filesystem operations that follow a rename or move, retarget path arguments to the final destination.
Initialize locals that are only assigned on some branches before any conditional logic.
validation: Run python -m py_compile lib/ansible/module_common.py.
Run the existing test suite.
Run a smoke-test module (for example ping and copy) against localhost.

name: ansible-module-docs-octal-mode-clarification
negative_constraints: Do not change module runtime behavior or the argument_spec for mode handling in a documentation-only fix.
Do not make examples use bare 644 without a leading 0. Without the 0 it is parsed as decimal and gives the wrong permissions.
Do not move documentation into separate docs/ files. Module docs are the in-code DOCUMENTATION and EXAMPLES strings.
Do not break the YAML validity of the EXAMPLES string. Comments must start with # at the list indentation level.
procedure: Locate the module source under lib/ansible/modules/<category>/<module>.py. For the file module this is lib/ansible/modules/files/file.py. In this repo the module's docs live inside the code as the DOCUMENTATION, EXAMPLES and RETURN string literals.
Find the EXAMPLES block entry that uses a numeric mode, such as `file: path=... owner=... group=... mode=0644`.

Add a YAML comment line (# ...) directly above that example. It should say that when mode is given as octal numbers, the first digit must always be 0. For example: '# change file ownership, group and mode. When specifying mode using octal numbers, first digit should always be 0.'
Keep the existing example values unchanged. They already show the correct form `mode=0644`, and the comment explains why the leading 0 is there.
If the DOCUMENTATION options section of the same module (or of a shared file-common-args doc fragment) describes mode, check that it does not contradict the comment.
validation: Parse the EXAMPLES string as YAML, for example with python -c 'import yaml, ast' or with ansible-doc <module>, to confirm it is still valid.
Run `ansible-doc file` and confirm the new comment appears in the EXAMPLES output.
Run the repository's module documentation sanity/validate-modules check if available.

name: ansible-module-fail-json-on-invalid-input
negative_constraints: 不要让 Ansible module 以未捕获异常退出。'parsed: false' 加 traceback 属于 bug。
不要在 fail_json 之后继续执行依赖该无效值的代码。
procedure: 从用户报告的 traceback 中定位抛异常的行。通常是对 None 结果的属性访问或下标访问。
沿着数据流向上追溯到产生该值的辅助函数,找到最早可以判定输入无效的位置。
在该位置立即调用 module.fail_json,并在 msg 中带上原始输入,方便用户排查。
保持最小 diff。优先调整已有校验的位置,而不是新增一层校验。
validation: 使用触发崩溃的原始 playbook 任务复现,确认得到可读的失败信息。
运行该 module 的现有测试套件,确认无回归。

name: ansible-module-snippet-replacer
negative_constraints: Do not break old-style modules that use the #<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_COMMON>> marker. Do not break WANT_JSON modules or old key=value modules.
Do not leave the replacement logic duplicated in both the runner and module_common.
Do not strip comments by default in the runner path: use strip_comments=False. Stripping can break shebangs, encoding lines and docstrings.
Do not replace the shlex-safe utf-8 encoding of module_args with unicode. Python versions before 2.7.3 mishandle unicode input to shlex.split.
Do not leave a stale 'from ansible import module_common' import that references the removed constants REPLACER or MODULE_COMMON.
procedure: Locate the shared module boilerplate in lib/ansible/module_common.py, which holds the MODULE_COMMON string and the REPLACER markers. Also locate the inline replacement logic in Runner._copy_module in lib/ansible/runner/__init__.py.

Move the shared code out of the triple-quoted string and into a real Python file, lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py, using git mv so history is preserved. Remove the wrapping MODULE_COMMON = """ and the closing """.
Quote the MODULE_ARGS, MODULE_LANG and MODULE_COMPLEX_ARGS placeholders as strings, for example "<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_ARGS>>". The snippet must stay importable, valid Python.
Recreate lib/ansible/module_common.py as a ModuleReplacer class. It should support the legacy '#<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_COMMON>>' marker, which maps to the 'basic' snippet.

In ModuleReplacer, also support the new style: lines like 'from ansible.module_utils.<name> import *' are each replaced with the contents of module_utils/<name>.py. This lets several snippets, such as EC2 helpers, be shared between modules.

Move module_style detection into ModuleReplacer: new, old, or non_native_want_json via WANT_JSON. Move argument encoding there too: args as repr of utf-8, lang, and complex args JSON. Move syslog facility injection there as well.

In runner/__init__.py, create a module-level instance with module_replacer = ModuleReplacer(strip_comments=False). Make _copy_module delegate to it. Keep only plugin lookup, the AnsibleFileNotFound error, and transfer logic in the runner.
Convert the example modules library/system/ping and library/system/service to the new import style. Leave other modules on the old marker; it must keep working.
validation: Run the existing unit tests, especially the runner and module tests.
Run the ping module and check that it returns pong. Do the same with an old-style module and a WANT_JSON module.
Inspect the generated module payload. It must contain no leftover '<<INCLUDE_' markers or 'from ansible.module_utils' lines, and the args must be substituted.
Grep the codebase for references to module_common.REPLACER or module_common.MODULE_COMMON and update every caller, for example hacking/test-module.

name: ansible-module-utils-wrap-os-errors-with-fail-json
negative_constraints: Do not add broad try blocks around large regions. Keep each failure cause distinct.
Do not use print or sys.exit. Modules must report through fail_json.
Do not add dependencies or Python-3-only constructs to module_utils.
procedure: Find the exact filesystem call in lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py that raises the uncaught OSError or IOError, such as a tempfile, open, rename or chmod call.
Wrap only that call in try/except (OSError, IOError), e: using Python 2.4-compatible syntax.
Turn the error into self.fail_json(msg='...') with a message that tells the user what to do. Include the relevant path variable, such as the dir or dest.
Leave the success path and any existing nested error handling unchanged.
validation: Run the existing tests and a py_compile check.
Trigger the error condition, for example with a permission-denied directory, and confirm that the module returns failed=True with the custom message.

name: ansible-osdist-release-file-precedence
negative_constraints: Do not append the derivative release file after /etc/redhat-release or /etc/system-release. A generic file would match first and the bug would remain.
Do not change the existing RedHat branch logic to special-case Oracle. Add a separate branch for the new name.
Do not omit the break in the new branch. Without it, the loop falls through to the generic entries.
Do not replace or bypass the platform.dist() path globally. Only extend the fallback table.
Do not hardcode the distribution value without checking the file content. Keep the marker-check with the data.split()[0] fallback.
procedure: Locate the OSDIST_LIST tuple in the Facts class in lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py. It is the fallback used when platform.dist() reports an unknown or wrong distro. Each entry is (release-file path, distribution name).
Confirm the misidentification mechanism. Derivative distros such as Oracle Linux also ship /etc/redhat-release, so the first matching entry wins and they are reported as 'RedHat'.
