negative_constraints: 不要在把 host_list 置为 None 之后继续调用 len(host_list) 或对它迭代。
不要用 `host_list = []` 代替 None 来规避崩溃,除非确认下游的 `if not host_list` 和 play 失败语义完全一致。
不要改变 max_fail_pct 的阈值计算公式(int 截断、/100.0)或 any_errors_fatal 的判定语义,只修控制流。
不要用 try/except TypeError 吞掉异常来掩盖问题。
procedure: 在 lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py 的 PlayBook._run_play 任务循环中,定位 `host_list = self._list_available_hosts(play.hosts)` 之后的失败判定逻辑。
检查是否存在这样的顺序:先有一个 if 分支把 host_list 设为 None(sentinel,表示中止 play),后面又有一个独立的 if 对 host_list 调用 len() 或做迭代。这正是 any_errors_fatal 触发时 `len(None)` 抛 TypeError、导致 ansible-playbook 崩溃的根因。
把所有中止条件合并成一个布尔表达式,用 `or` 连接:`(task.any_errors_fatal and len(host_list) < hosts_count) or ((hosts_count - len(host_list)) > int(play.max_fail_pct/100.0 * hosts_count))`。命中时只执行一次 `host_list = None`。
依赖 `or` 的短路求值,并且所有 len(host_list) 的计算都放在赋 None 之前。这样之后的 `if not host_list` 退出分支能统一处理两种中止原因。
更新注释,说明这个分支同时覆盖 max_fail_pct 超阈值和 any_errors_fatal 两种情况。
validation: 构造 playbook:设置 any_errors_fatal: true,让一个任务在部分主机上 fail(或用 fail 模块)。确认 ansible-playbook 正常中止并输出失败汇总,而不是打印 Python Traceback。
构造 max_fail_pct 超阈值的场景,确认行为仍是中止 play。
构造未超阈值且 any_errors_fatal 为 false 的场景,确认剩余主机继续执行后续任务。
运行现有单元测试和集成测试,确认没有回归。

name: backport-v1-fix-to-v2-module-utils
negative_constraints: Do not modify v1 lib/ files when the task is to apply a fix to v2.
Do not blindly cherry-pick. Paths differ (v2/ prefix), and the context may not match.
Do not drop module-replacer placeholders such as <<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_ARGS>> or <<ANSIBLE_VERSION>>. They are substituted at module build time.
procedure: Run `git show <sha>` on the v1 commit to read its full diff. Note which v1 file it touched, for example lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py.
Find the matching v2 file under v2/ansible/... (here v2/ansible/module_utils/basic.py). Locate the same function. In this case it is AnsibleModule.set_mode_if_different.
Port the logic by hand instead of cherry-picking. v2 code may have drifted, so adapt the change to the v2 context while keeping the v1 behavior the same.

Diff the v1 and v2 versions of the touched file. If the v2 file still holds placeholder or stub values that differ from v1 in the same region, align them as part of the port. Example: MODULE_ARGS = "" in v2 versus "<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_ARGS>>" in v1.
Keep the edit scoped to the v2 copy. Do not touch the v1 file, which is already fixed.
Make the commit subject reference the original sha, in the form 'Applying <sha> (<summary>) to v2'.
validation: Run `python -m py_compile v2/ansible/module_utils/basic.py`. This must use Python 2 syntax, for example `except OSError, e`.
Diff the edited v2 function against the v1 function and confirm the logic is equivalent.
Run the existing v2 unit tests for module_utils if they are present.

name: cache-play-hosts-as-play-attribute
negative_constraints: Do not call inventory.list_hosts per task or per handler. Doing so is the performance bug being fixed.
Do not recompute hosts_count inside the task loop. It must be the play-level baseline, otherwise the %fail threshold drifts as hosts fail.
Do not rebuild _play_hosts from play.hosts inside a batch, because that loses the serial restriction. Derive it from on_hosts.
Do not use a mutable default argument in a way that mutates the passed list. The trim helper must return a new list.
Do not drop the inventory.restrict_to / also_restrict_to calls. Runner still depends on the inventory restriction.
procedure: Open lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py (PlayBook class). Find every call to the helper that re-queries inventory, i.e. self.inventory.list_hosts(...) inside _list_available_hosts. It is used in _run_task_internal, _do_setup_step, _run_play and the handler path.
In _run_play, right after on_play_start, call self.inventory.list_hosts(play.hosts) once. Store the result on the play as play._play_hosts.
Reuse that stored value for the 'no hosts matched' early return instead of calling list_hosts a second time.

Replace the inventory-querying helper with a pure filter, _trim_unavailable_hosts(hostlist). It returns only the hosts that are in neither self.stats.failures nor self.stats.dark, and it makes no inventory round trip.
Compute all_hosts = self._trim_unavailable_hosts(play._play_hosts) once. Pass it to play.update_vars_files().
Set hosts_count = len(all_hosts) once at play level, before the serialized batches. Remove the per-task recomputation of hosts_count.
At the start of each serial batch loop, narrow the stored list with play._play_hosts = self._trim_unavailable_hosts(on_hosts). Keep the existing inventory.also_restrict_to(on_hosts) call.

Make the remaining callers filter task.play._play_hosts or play._play_hosts instead of re-listing inventory: _run_task_internal, the setup/gather_facts step, and the handler and post-task host_list checks.
Keep the max_fail_pct and any_errors_fatal comparisons as play-level checks: (hosts_count - len(host_list)) compared against int(max_fail_pct/100.0 * hosts_count).
validation: Run the existing unit tests (test/TestPlayBook.py or the tests under test/units) with nosetests or make tests.
Run a playbook with serial set and check that each batch only targets its own hosts.
Run a playbook where a host fails with max_fail_pct set. Confirm the play aborts only when the failure share of the original count exceeds the threshold.
grep the file and confirm no remaining callers of _list_available_hosts exist.

name: coerce-injected-interpreter-shebang-to-bytes
negative_constraints: 不要直接把 inject 中的 unicode 值插进 str 模板。
不要用 errors='ignore' 或 'replace' 静默篡改解释器路径。应使用 'strict',让非法路径显式失败。
不要把整个 module_data 转为 unicode 来“统一类型”,后续传输和写文件都依赖 bytes。
不要在没有实际 import 校验的情况下提交新增的 import 行,警惕包名拼写错误(asnible vs ansible)。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_common.py 中 ModuleReplacer.modify_module 末尾重写 lines[0] 的位置。该处用 inject['ansible_<basename>_interpreter'] 拼出新的 shebang。
确认问题根源:inventory/vars 中的 interpreter 值来自 YAML/JSON,可能是 unicode;module_data 是 py2 的 str/bytes。用 '%' 拼接时 shebang 会被提升为 unicode,之后再 join 非 ASCII 的模块内容就会触发 UnicodeDecodeError。
复用 ansible.utils.unicode.to_bytes 做转换,不要自己写 encode 逻辑。在格式化之前先执行 interpreter = to_bytes(inject[interpreter_config], errors='strict'),再执行 "#!%s %s" % (interpreter, ' '.join(args[1:]))。
在文件顶部加入 from ansible.utils.unicode import to_bytes。逐字核对包名拼写:证据 diff 中误写成了 'asnible',这会导致整个模块 ImportError。
检查返回的 (module_data, module_style, shebang) 中 shebang 与 module_data 是否都是 bytes/str 类型,并保持两者一致。
validation: 运行 python -c 'import ansible.module_common',确认 import 路径正确。
运行现有单元测试:make tests,或 nosetests test/units。
手动验证:在 inventory 中以 unicode 形式设置 ansible_python_interpreter,并对一个含非 ASCII 字符的模块执行 ad-hoc 命令,确认不再抛出 UnicodeDecodeError,且生成的 shebang 为 str 类型。

name: consolidate-available-hosts-filter-in-playbook
negative_constraints: 不要在 helper 中顺带加入新的过滤规则(例如 unreachable 以外的状态),这会改变 failed/dark 主机的处理行为。
如果调用点此前没有 restrict_to 保护,不要静默丢掉 play.hosts 这个 pattern 参数。
不要漏掉 serial batch 循环里重新计算 host_list 的那一处。所有副本都必须走同一个函数,否则过滤逻辑仍会分叉。
不要把 helper 做成 public API,也不要挪到 Inventory 类里。它依赖 PlayBook.stats,应保持为 PlayBook 的私有方法。
procedure: 在 lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py 中 grep 'stats.failures' 和 'stats.dark'。找出所有内联的 list comprehension,它们的作用都是过滤掉失败或不可达(dark)的主机。常见位置有 _run_task_internal、_do_setup_step、_run_play,以及 serial batch 循环中的重算点。
在 PlayBook 类中新增一个私有方法 _list_available_hosts(self, ...)。方法写一行 docstring,用分隔注释块与相邻方法隔开,保持文件现有风格。方法体统一写成:inventory.list_hosts(...) 的结果中,排除 self.stats.failures 和 self.stats.dark 里的主机。
把每处内联过滤替换为对 self._list_available_hosts() 的调用。原变量名(hosts、host_list、all_hosts)保持不变,下游的 restrict_to、update_vars_files 和空列表提前退出逻辑都不要动。
逐个核对调用点的语义。原代码有的地方调用 list_hosts(play.hosts),有的调用 list_hosts()。改成无参调用前,先确认此时 inventory 已被 restrict_to 或 play pattern 限定;否则 helper 应接收一个可选 pattern 参数并透传,避免主机集合被扩大。
保持过滤条件的顺序和布尔逻辑完全等价。'not (a or b)' 与 '(not a) and (not b)' 是等价的,可以统一成一种写法,但不要引入新的过滤条件。
validation: 运行现有的 playbook 单元测试(test/TestPlayBook.py 等),确认失败主机和 dark 主机在后续 task、setup 和 vars_files 阶段都被排除。
替换完成后再 grep 'stats.failures',确认只剩 helper 内部和 stats 自身的引用。
用包含多个 play、且 hosts pattern 不同的 playbook 手动验证:第二个 play 不会运行到第一个 play 的 pattern 之外的主机。
用 serial 分批的 playbook 验证:某批出现失败后,后续批次的 host_list 仍然正确,无主机剩余时能正常退出。

name: derive-distribution-major-version-fact
negative_constraints: Do not change how distribution, distribution_version or distribution_release are computed.
Do not cast the major version to int. Facts stay strings, and some versions are non-numeric (e.g. 'testing', 'sid').
Do not add a new import or an external command to obtain a value that is already in dist[1].
Do not leave an empty string. Keep the 'NA' fallback convention.
procedure: Locate the Facts class in lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py. Find the Linux distribution branch (get_distribution_facts) that calls platform.dist() and fills distribution, distribution_version and distribution_release.
Derive the new fact from the existing dist[1] version string: dist[1].split('.')[0]. Do not call platform.dist() again.
Place the assignment right after the distribution_version line. Use the same fallback as its siblings: `or 'NA'`.

Check that later code in the same function also sets the derived key wherever it overrides distribution_version. This includes the OSDIST_DICT loop, /etc/*release parsing and other per-distro handlers. Recompute the major version there too, or the derived fact can drift out of sync with the overridden value.
Keep the fact key in snake_case with the distribution_ prefix (distribution_major_version), consistent with the existing fact names.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for module_utils facts, if present.
Run `ansible localhost -m setup -a 'filter=ansible_distribution*'` and check that distribution_major_version equals the prefix of distribution_version before the first dot.
Check the edge case where dist[1] is '' and the result is 'NA'.
Check that a version with no dot (e.g. '7') returns the whole string.

name: detect-privilege-switch-by-identity-not-env
negative_constraints: Do not detect the privilege switch through environment variables tied to one specific tool (SUDO_USER, SU_USER, etc.). They do not cover all become methods.
Do not evaluate the switch condition separately in each branch. Compute it once and reuse it, so the branches cannot disagree.
Do not remove the os.getuid() != 0 condition. The copy path applies only to a non-root switched user.
Do not change the atomic_move signature or the semantics of the rename fallback.
procedure: Locate the logic in lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py inside AnsibleModule.atomic_move that decides whether the user was switched. The old implementation used os.getenv('SUDO_USER').

Understand the root cause: SUDO_USER is only set by sudo. su, pbrun and other become methods do not set it, so the non-sudo switch path was never taken. Under su the temporary file was left behind and the owner of the newly created file was wrong.

Compute a single local variable near 'creating = not os.path.exists(dest)', before the try block. Write it as switched_user = os.getlogin() != pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid())[0], so it compares the login user with the current effective user.

Replace every SUDO_USER check in that function with switched_user. This covers the branch that copies to the temp file with shutil.copy2 when the user is not root (keep the os.getuid() != 0 condition). It also covers the branch that runs os.chown(dest, os.getuid(), os.getgid()) when creating a new file.
Confirm that pwd is already imported at the top of basic.py. If it is not, add the import.
Keep the existing behavior of the other branches unchanged: optimistic os.rename, mkstemp/NamedTemporaryFile with the .ansible_tmp prefix, umask handling and the selinux context.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for module_utils/basic (test/units) and make sure there are no regressions.
Check manually or in an integration test that copy/template under become_method=su leaves no .ansible_tmp* files in the destination directory.
Check that a newly created file under sudo and under su is owned by the effective user (os.getuid/os.getgid).
Check that without a user switch (plain login, root) behavior is unchanged.

name: distribution-fact-name-vs-match-string
negative_constraints: 不要把带空格的显示名当作 fact 值, 否则会与 OS_FAMILY 映射的键对不上。
不要用全局替换批量改名, 这样会把内容匹配字符串一起改坏。
procedure: 改发行版名称时, 先找出它在 facts.py 中的所有出现点: OSDIST_LIST、`name ==` 比较分支、OS_FAMILY 映射。
确认规范名不含空格, 并与 OS_FAMILY 字典的键一致, 例如 'OracleLinux' -> 'RedHat', 这样 os_family 才能被正确推导。
release 文件内容的子串匹配保持使用该文件中的真实文本。
validation: 运行现有测试。
检查 OS_FAMILY 中存在与新规范名相同的键。

name: django-manage-invoke-via-shebang
negative_constraints: Do not replace 'python' with another hardcoded interpreter such as 'python3' or sys.executable. That breaks projects whose manage.py shebang points somewhere else.
Do not drop the './' prefix. A bare 'manage.py' would be looked up on PATH instead of in app_path.
Do not change how virtualenv activation or PATH is handled in _ensure_virtualenv as part of this fix.
Do not reorder or rebuild the command-flag construction logic.
procedure: Open lib/ansible/modules/web_infrastructure/django_manage.py and find the command string in main() that is built right after _ensure_virtualenv(module).
Change the hardcoded interpreter prefix 'python manage.py %s' to './manage.py %s', so the shebang line in the project's manage.py chooses the interpreter (python2, python3 or the venv python).

Keep the existing behavior around it unchanged: _ensure_virtualenv still sets up PATH, '--noinput' is still appended for noinput_commands, and the other option flags (settings, pythonpath, etc.) are appended exactly as before.
Check that the command still runs with cwd=app_path (module.run_command(..., cwd=app_path)). The relative './manage.py' only resolves when the working directory is the project directory.
Keep the change to this one line in the code surface. This bugfix needs no new options.
validation: Run python -m py_compile on django_manage.py and run the ansible-test sanity checks for the module.
Run the existing unit or integration tests for django_manage, if there are any.
Manually check that cmd starts with './manage.py ' and that noinput commands still end with '--noinput' before the other flags.

name: dual-tree-constants-sync
negative_constraints: 不要只改 lib/ 而遗漏 v2/，否则两套实现的配置面会分叉。
引用仍存在时不要删除常量，否则会在 import 时触发 AttributeError。
procedure: 新增、删除或回退 get_config 常量时，要同时修改 lib/ansible/constants.py 和 v2/ansible/constants.py 两棵树。
常量要放在相同的相对位置（如 PARAMIKO_RECORD_HOST_KEYS 之后、obsolete ZEROMQ 注释之前），参数签名保持一致：section、key、env var、default、类型标志。
删除常量前，在两棵树里都 grep 常量名（如 SSL_PROTOCOL），确认已无引用。
validation: 执行 grep -rn '<CONST_NAME>' lib/ v2/，确认两棵树的结果一致（都为空或都存在）。
执行 python -c 'import ansible.constants'，确认可以正常导入。

name: enforce-failure-thresholds-after-handler-runs
negative_constraints: Do not handle the handler failure check only at the end of the batch. With serial set, later batches would still run after handlers have failed.
Do not use a formula for the max_fail_pct threshold that differs from the one used for regular tasks. Task and handler failure semantics must match.
Do not drop the `fired_names` deduplication or the `notified_by` cleanup when inserting the check.
Do not raise an exception in place of `return False` plus `on_no_hosts_remaining`. Callers and callbacks expect that path.
procedure: Locate the handler-flush loop in lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py (PlayBook._run_play), i.e. `for handler in play.handlers()`, guarded by `if len(handler.notified_by) > 0` and wrapped by `self.inventory.restrict_to(handler.notified_by)`.

Locate the failure check that runs after each regular task in the same method. It uses `_list_available_hosts`, `hosts_count`, `any_errors_fatal` and `max_fail_pct`. Mirror that logic rather than inventing new semantics.
After `self._run_task(play, handler, True)` and the fired_names bookkeeping, recompute `host_list = self._list_available_hosts(play.hosts)`.
If `handler.any_errors_fatal` is set and `len(host_list) < hosts_count`, set `play.max_fail_pct = 0`.
If `(hosts_count - len(host_list)) > int(play.max_fail_pct/100.0 * hosts_count)`, set `host_list = None`.
If `not host_list`, call `self.callbacks.on_no_hosts_remaining()` and `return False` so the serial batch loop stops and the playbook fails.
Run this check per handler and before `self.inventory.lift_restriction()`, so it stays consistent with the per-task check.
validation: Run the existing unit tests (test/units, TestPlayBook).
Run a playbook with `serial: 1` and a handler that fails on the first host. Confirm the play aborts and no further batches run.
Repeat with `max_fail_percentage` set above the actual failure ratio. Confirm the play continues.
Repeat with `any_errors_fatal: true`. Confirm a single handler failure stops the play.

name: exclude-failed-unreachable-hosts-before-play-run
negative_constraints: Do not change Inventory.list_hosts semantics or permanently mutate the inventory to drop hosts. Filtering is a per-run playbook concern, and other callers rely on the full host list.
Do not filter only inside the task loop. vars_files resolution and serial batching happen earlier and would still touch the failed hosts.
Do not reset or clear stats.failures/stats.dark between plays. The final recap depends on them.
Do not exclude hosts that only had 'changed', 'ok' or 'skipped' results. Only failures and dark (unreachable) hosts should be skipped.
procedure: Locate the per-play host list computation in lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py. It is in PlayBook._run_play, where `all_hosts = self.inventory.list_hosts(play.hosts)` is built before `play.update_vars_files` and the serial batching.

Reuse the existing aggregated run stats (`self.stats.failures` and `self.stats.dark`, both keyed by hostname) as the source of truth for hosts already failed or unreachable in earlier plays. Do not add new tracking state.
Filter the inventory result at that single entry point: `[h for h in self.inventory.list_hosts(play.hosts) if not (h in self.stats.failures or h in self.stats.dark)]`.

Make sure the filtered list feeds everything downstream: vars_files templating (update_vars_files), serialized_batch construction, and task/handler execution. Then failed hosts are not re-contacted and their vars_files are not evaluated.
Check that an empty filtered list still makes the play end cleanly, with no crash and no spurious 'no hosts matched' failure that aborts the whole playbook.
validation: Run the existing unit tests (tests/ and test/TestPlayBook.py if present).
Run a manual two-play playbook where host A fails or is unreachable in play 1. Check that play 2 does not run tasks on A and does not try to load per-host vars_files for A.
Confirm the final PLAY RECAP still reports A as failed/unreachable with the correct counts.
With serial set, confirm the batches are computed from the filtered list only.

name: expose-inventory-groups-to-runner-inject
negative_constraints: 不要在 Inventory 上新增实例属性却漏改 __slots__, 否则会在 __init__ 时抛出 AttributeError。
不要把 Host/Group 对象直接放进 inject, 应只暴露名字字符串列表。
不要遗漏祖先组(父组/嵌套组), 否则 groups.parentgroup 会缺失。
不要在 inject 构建前、或在 module_vars/setup_cache update 之前设置这些键, 以免顺序错误导致后续 update 覆盖。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/runner/__init__.py 中构建 inject 字典的位置。inject 依次 update module_vars 和 setup_cache[host], 然后设置 hostvars。新的魔法变量放在这里, 位于 hostvars 之后、with_items 处理之前。
group_names 复用 inventory 已为每个 host 计算好的 host_variables['group_names'], 用 .get('group_names', []) 取值, 缺失时回退为空列表。不要在 runner 中重新计算。

groups 映射在 lib/ansible/inventory/__init__.py 的 Inventory 上新增方法 groups_list()。方法遍历 self.groups 和每个 group 的 get_ancestors(), 生成 {group_name: [host.name for host in group.get_hosts()]}。值只放 host 名字字符串, 便于模板和 with_items 使用。
Inventory 使用 __slots__, 因此新增缓存属性(如 '_groups_list')必须同时加入 __slots__ 列表, 并在 __init__ 中初始化。
groups_list() 采用惰性缓存: 仅当缓存为空时计算, 之后直接返回缓存。这样 runner 每台 host 每次调用都不会重复遍历 inventory。
在 runner 中写入 inject['groups'] = self.inventory.groups_list(), 使 playbook 可以使用 $groups.webservers / ${groups.webservers} 以及 with_items: $groups.x。
validation: 运行现有测试套件(test/ 中的 inventory 和 runner/playbook 测试)。
构造带父子组的 inventory, 断言 Inventory.groups_list() 同时包含子组和祖先组, 且值为主机名列表。
运行一个 playbook, 在模板/命令中引用 $group_names 和 $groups.<name>, 确认渲染正确。

name: extend-linux-distribution-detection-supported-dists
negative_constraints: Do not replace platform._supported_dists with a hand-written list. That drops the stdlib defaults and breaks detection of redhat, debian, SuSE and the rest.
Do not add a separate os.path.isfile('/etc/arch-release') special case when the supported_dists mechanism already covers it.
Do not change get_distribution_version() or the return format of get_distribution() in the same fix unless the issue requires it.
Do not break the try/except around the platform calls. The function must not raise on hosts with unusual release files.
procedure: Open get_distribution() in lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py.

Confirm the cause: platform.linux_distribution() only reads release files listed in platform._supported_dists. A distro whose /etc/<name>-release is not in that tuple (for example /etc/arch-release) comes back as an empty string.

Build an extended tuple from the stdlib default: platform._supported_dists + ('<distname>',). Pass it explicitly through the supported_dists= keyword so the existing default distros are still detected.
Keep the result handling exactly as it was: take [0], then .capitalize(). Downstream code compares against capitalized names such as 'Arch'.

Leave the fallback chain in place. That includes the empty-result check against /etc/system-release (Amazon), the 'OtherLinux' default and the non-Linux branch. A new distro should only change the first lookup.
If several distros are missing, add them all to the same tuple rather than adding extra linux_distribution calls.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for module_utils/basic.
Simulate an Arch host by mocking os.path.isfile and the contents of /etc/arch-release, or run on an Arch system. Check that get_distribution() returns 'Arch'.
Check that a RedHat/Debian host and an Amazon host relying on the /etc/system-release fallback still return the same values as before.
Smoke-test a module that branches on distribution (for example hostname or service) against Arch.

name: facts-branch-attribute-and-control-flow-guard
negative_constraints: Do not merge a facts branch that has never been executed. Latent AttributeError or NameError typos break fact gathering for an entire OS family.
Do not rely on loop fall-through to set defaults for newly detected distributions.
procedure: When adding a branch inside the OSDIST_LIST for/if chain, check that every assignment and lookup uses self.facts[...].
Check that each detection path ends with an explicit break only after its facts are fully set.
Keep external command calls (run_command) local to the branch that needs them, so other platforms do not pay for or fail on them.
Add a minimal unit test that executes the new branch end-to-end. This catches typos that static review missed in the evidence PR.
validation: Run a lint check (pyflakes or pylint) on lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py.
Run a unit test that drives the new branch with mocked file content and command output.

name: facts-distribution-detect-empty-release-file
negative_constraints: 不要直接删除 getsize>0 检查。其他发行版分支会读取文件内容并做 split()/正则,空文件会导致 IndexError 或误判。
不要在空文件分支里读取或解析文件内容,只按路径和名称判断。
不要改动现有发行版分支的匹配顺序和语义,重缩进时不得遗漏或改写任何 elif。
不要用 platform.dist() 的结果去覆盖已通过标识文件确认的值。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 中 Facts.get_distribution_facts 遍历 Facts.OSDIST_LIST 的循环。确认目标发行版的标识文件路径和名称,例如 ('/etc/arch-release', 'Archlinux')。
检查该发行版的标识文件是否本身为空(Arch 的 /etc/arch-release 就是 0 字节)。原条件 `os.path.exists(path) and os.path.getsize(path) > 0` 会直接跳过这类文件,导致 distribution 和 os_family 识别错误。
把复合条件拆成两层嵌套:外层 `if os.path.exists(path):`,内层 `if os.path.getsize(path) > 0:`。原有各发行版分支(Fedora、RedHat、OtherLinux/Amazon、OpenWrt、Alpine、Solaris、SuSE、Debian 等)原样整体缩进到内层,逻辑不变。
在内层 size>0 分支之外加一个 else 分支,专门处理存在但为空的标识文件。按 name 匹配(如 `if name == 'Archlinux': self.facts['distribution'] = name; break`),只依赖文件存在来确定发行版。
确认 OS_FAMILY 映射表中包含新识别出的 distribution 名(如 Archlinux -> Archlinux),保证 os_family 随 distribution 一起修正。
复用已有的 get_file_content 和 break 模式,保持每个分支一旦识别成功就跳出循环。
validation: 对 facts.py 运行 python -m py_compile,确认大段重缩进后语法和缩进层级正确。
在 Arch 环境(存在 0 字节的 /etc/arch-release)执行 `ansible localhost -m setup -a 'filter=ansible_distribution*'`,期望 distribution=Archlinux。同时用 `filter=ansible_os_family` 检查,期望 os_family=Archlinux。
在 RedHat/Debian/SuSE 等环境回归 setup 模块,确认 distribution 输出不变。
运行现有单元测试(test/units 中与 facts 相关的测试)。

name: filter-at-final-sink-not-at-input-parse
negative_constraints: 不要在展开或映射之前做过滤，然后就假设展开后的结果安全。
不要用重试或捕获异常来掩盖随机出现的非法字符问题。
procedure: 判断失败是否偶发、与随机采样相关。如果是，追踪被采样集合的最终形态，而不是用户的原始输入。
列出输入到最终集合之间的所有变换：别名展开、默认值、getattr 映射等。确认非法值可能在哪一步被引入。
把校验或过滤放在最后一次变换之后、真正消费之前，也就是写入、采样或渲染的位置。
移除上游重复或无效的过滤，保持单一的过滤点。
validation: 用大样本循环生成输出，断言其中不出现非法字符。
运行现有单元测试。

name: fix-action-plugin-def-syntax-from-byte-compile-error
negative_constraints: Do not refactor, rename or reorder the parameters of run(). The runner calls every action plugin with this exact interface.
Do not silence the error by excluding the file from byte-compilation or packaging.
Do not add tests, changelog entries or docs for a pure typo fix unless the repository requires them. The gold surface is code only.
Do not use syntax newer than Python 2.6 while fixing the line.
procedure: Parse the SyntaxError tuple from the install log. Its fields are ('invalid syntax', (path, line, col, source_line)). Map the site-packages path back to the source file, for example /usr/lib/python2.6/site-packages/ansible/runner/action_plugins/add_host.py becomes lib/ansible/runner/action_plugins/add_host.py.
Go to the reported line and column. A column pointing at the end of a `def`, `class`, `if`, `for`, `try` or `with` header usually means the trailing colon is missing.

Compare the line with the `run()` signatures in the other files under lib/ansible/runner/action_plugins/. The canonical form is `def run(self, conn, tmp, module_name, module_args, inject, complex_args=None, **kwargs):`.
Make the smallest token-level fix, for example adding the missing ':'. Leave the method body, the signature parameters and the surrounding logic unchanged.

Check that the rest of the recently changed lines in the same file are syntactically sound. Also check that nothing in them is incompatible with Python 2.6, such as dict or set comprehensions, `{}` format fields without indexes, or `with A, B`.
validation: python -m py_compile lib/ansible/runner/action_plugins/add_host.py
python -m compileall -q lib/ansible  # simulate install_lib byte-compile across the package
If a python2.6 interpreter is available, run the byte-compile with it.
Run the existing unit tests that import the plugin, for example the test directory with nosetests or make tests, to confirm the plugin loads.

name: fix-comparison-used-as-assignment-in-flag-setting
negative_constraints: 不要顺手重构 force_handlers 或 host_list 的控制流。修复只针对单个字符。
不要把条件判断中合法的 `==` 改成赋值。只修改作为独立语句、结果被丢弃的比较。
不要改变 force_handlers 关闭时的行为，即 `return False` 路径。
procedure: 定位那些本应设置状态标志、却写成了比较表达式的独立语句。这类语句的结果会被丢弃，例如 `task_errors == True`。
搜索时可以用 `grep -nE '^\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*==\s*(True|False|None)\s*$'`。也可以用 pyflakes 或 pylint 查找 'pointless-statement' 或 'statement seems to have no effect'。
确认该行确实意在赋值，方法是查看变量在后续代码中的用法。以 lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py 为例：task_errors 在 force_handlers 分支里 break 之后才被读取，用来决定运行 handlers 后返回失败。
把 `==` 改成 `=`，做最小修改，不改变周围的控制流，包括 break、return 和 else 分支。
检查同一文件里结构相似的分支，例如其他 `if self.force_handlers:` 块和其他设置 task_errors 的地方，看是否有同样的笔误。
validation: run existing tests (e.g. `make tests` / nosetests under test/units)
对修改后的文件运行 `python -m pyflakes` 或 `pylint --disable=all --enable=pointless-statement`，确认不再报告无效语句。
手动推演或用 playbook 验证：设置 force_handlers=True 并让所有主机失败时，应执行 handlers，且 playbook 最终返回失败。

name: fix-module-examples-list-param-templating
negative_constraints: 不要在 key=value 形式的示例里保留 "{{ play_hosts }}" 这类会渲染成 Python list repr 的模板。
不要为了修文档示例而修改参数解析代码或 argument_spec 的类型。
不要只改一处示例而遗漏同一 EXAMPLES 块中的其他同类示例。
不要使用真实或敏感的主机地址,请用 192.168.x.x 这类示意 IP。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/modules/**/<module>.py 中 EXAMPLES 文档字符串里把 Jinja 列表变量(如 "{{ play_hosts }}"、groups[...])直接传给 list 类型参数的示例。
核对 DOCUMENTATION 和 argument_spec,确认该参数期望的是逗号分隔字符串或列表(例如 gluster_volume 的 cluster 参数)。
使用 key=value 简写时,Jinja 渲染出的 Python 列表会变成字符串,例如 "['h1', 'h2']"。module 不会把它解析成 list,所以要把示例改成显式的逗号分隔字面值,例如 cluster="192.168.1.10,192.168.1.11"。
所有出现同样写法的示例都要一起修改,包括单 brick 和多 brick 等变体,保持格式一致。
只改 EXAMPLES 文本。module 的解析逻辑和 argument_spec 保持不变,除非任务明确要求支持列表输入。
validation: 确认 EXAMPLES 仍是合法 YAML,例如运行 python -c 'import yaml; yaml.safe_load(EXAMPLES)' 或 ansible-doc <module>。
运行 ansible-doc -t module <module>,确认文档能正常渲染。
运行 ansible-test sanity --test validate-modules(如果可用)。
执行 grep,确认 EXAMPLES 中已没有 play_hosts 直接传给逗号分隔参数的写法。

name: fix-nonexistent-stdlib-api-in-module-utils
negative_constraints: Do not rewrite or refactor the distribution detection logic in the same change.
Do not introduce pathlib. module_utils must stay compatible with older Python 2 versions on managed hosts.
Do not widen or remove the existing try/except. That would change error behavior for other platforms.
Do not add new external dependencies.
procedure: Start from the issue. Find the failing branch in lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py, or in the facts / setup code. A good starting point is get_distribution(), whose platform.linux_distribution fallback checks /etc/system-release.
Confirm the root cause is a call to a stdlib function that does not exist. Example: os.path.is_file confused with pathlib.Path.is_file. The correct name is os.path.isfile.

Many of these calls sit inside a broad try/except. There the AttributeError is swallowed, and the result silently falls back to a wrong value, such as distribution being empty or 'Other'. Do not expect a visible traceback.
Make a minimal one-line replacement with the correct stdlib name, such as os.path.isfile, os.path.isdir, os.path.exists or os.path.islink. Keep the surrounding logic unchanged.
Search the whole repo with grep for the same typo (os.path.is_file, os.path.is_dir and similar). Fix every occurrence together, especially in module_utils and library/system/setup.
validation: Run python -c 'import os; os.path.isfile' to confirm the corrected API exists, and check that os.path.is_file raises AttributeError.
Run pyflakes or python -m py_compile on the changed file.

On or simulating a host where linux_distribution()[0] is empty and /etc/system-release exists (Amazon Linux), run `ansible localhost -m setup -a filter=ansible_distribution`. Confirm it returns 'Amazon'.
Run the existing unit tests for module_utils if they are present.

name: fix-regex-on-splitlines-list-in-distro-facts
negative_constraints: 不要把 splitlines 的结果传给 re.search, 也不要在已拆分的行上匹配 '\n'。
不要通过删除 splitlines 并改用整段文本来绕过问题, 除非确认其他分支不依赖逐行语义。保持最小改动。
不要修改 distribution / distribution_version 等其他 fact 的检测逻辑。
不要改变 facts 的键名或返回格式。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 中 Facts 类的发行版检测分支, 找到 get_file_content(path) 之后按 path 分派的那段, 例如 elif path == '/etc/SuSE-release'。
确认变量类型: data = data.splitlines() 之后 data 是 list, 不能再直接传给 re.search/re.match。
改为逐行遍历: for line in data: release = re.search('CODENAME *= *([^\n]+)', line)。
去掉 pattern 里末尾的 '\n' 锚点, 因为 splitlines() 已经把换行符去掉了, 保留它会导致永远匹配不上。
匹配成功后保留原有赋值逻辑: self.facts['distribution_release'] = release.groups()[0].strip()。
注意 break 的作用域: 原代码的 break 会跳出外层 path 循环。改成内层 for line 之后, break 只跳出行循环。核对外层逻辑在找到 release 后不会被后续 path 覆盖。如有需要, 补一个 flag 或者在行循环之后再 break 外层循环。
顺带检查同函数里其他发行版分支 (Debian、Mandriva 等) 是否也存在把 list 传给 regex 的问题。只修复同类缺陷, 不改动其他行为。
validation:
用示例 /etc/SuSE-release 内容 (例如 'openSUSE 13.1 (x86_64)
VERSION = 13.1
CODENAME = Bottle
') 模拟 get_file_content, 断言 distribution_release == 'Bottle', 并且不抛出 TypeError。
测试文件中没有 CODENAME 行的情况: 不应抛出异常, distribution_release 保持默认值。
如果仓库已有 facts 单元测试, 运行现有测试, 确认其他发行版检测不回归。
可行时在 OpenSuSE 主机上运行 ansible -m setup, 检查 ansible_distribution_release。

name: fix-str-find-truthiness-in-boolean-chains
negative_constraints: 不要只修改链中的最后一个子句; 每个 find 子句都必须显式比较 -1。
不要把 `find()` 的返回值直接当布尔值使用。
不要借此机会修改 AnsibleError 的提示文本或异常逻辑, 这是单行 bugfix。
不要删除对任一种 ssh 版本错误消息变体的匹配。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/runner/connection_plugins/ssh.py 等连接插件中解析 stderr/stdout 的子串判断, 搜索 `.find(` 被直接用作布尔值或用 `or`/`and` 串联的表达式。
识别失败模式: `str.find()` 未命中时返回 -1, -1 为真值; 命中位置为 0 时返回 0, 0 为假值。所以 `a.find(x) or a.find(y) != -1` 中第一个子句的判断是反的, 只有最后一个子句带了 `!= -1`。
对 or/and 链中的每个子句单独补上比较 `!= -1`。更推荐改写为 `'msg' in stderr` 形式, 但要保持与周边代码风格一致, 改动保持最小。
确认修正后的布尔值只在原有条件下生效(如 `p.returncode != 0 and controlpersisterror`), 不改变错误消息和抛出的异常类型。
同一文件内用 grep 检查其他 `.find(` 调用, 确认没有同样的隐式真值误用, 例如 'Bad configuration option' 与 'unknown configuration option' 这类并列的版本差异消息。
validation: 运行现有单元测试 (如 test/units 或 make tests), 确认没有回归。
手动验证: stderr 不含任一目标串时 controlpersisterror 为 False; 含 'Bad configuration option: ControlPersist' 时为 True; 含 'unknown configuration option: ControlPersist' 时为 True。
python -m pyflakes 或 py_compile 检查被修改的文件。

name: forward-host-list-to-task-runner
negative_constraints: 不要在 _get_task_runner 内部硬编码或重新读取默认 inventory 文件来代替透传。
不要改变 pattern 的匹配语义, 也不要改变 Runner 的默认 host_list 行为。
不要为了这类修复去重构 PlayBook 的任务执行流程。修改应限于调用点补参。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/playbook.py 中 PlayBook 构造 Runner 的调用点, 包括 _run_task 调用 self._get_task_runner(...) 的位置。
检查调用方作用域里已有的上下文参数, 例如 host_list、pattern、module_name、module_args, 和 _get_task_runner/Runner 构造函数接受的关键字参数, 逐一对比, 找出漏传的参数。
以关键字形式补传缺失的 host_list=host_list, 与 pattern= 等参数放在一起。这里复用调用方已有的变量, 不新建全局状态。
确认 _get_task_runner 的签名里确实有 host_list 参数, 并且它会把这个值继续传给 ansible.runner.Runner。如果签名里没有, 就沿调用链在每一层都补上透传。
顺手清理参数行尾的多余空白, 但不改动其它参数。
validation: run existing tests
用一个自定义 inventory/host_list 文件运行 playbook, 确认任务打在该文件中匹配 pattern 的主机上, 而不是默认 inventory 的主机上。
对 _get_task_runner 及 Runner 的调用做 grep, 确认所有调用点都传了 host_list。

name: galaxy-role-spec-scm-aware-default-version
negative_constraints: 不要在 scm 尚未确定时设置任何默认 version。
不要把 git 的分支名 'master' 用于 hg、tarball 或未知 scm。
不要覆盖用户在 role spec 中显式给出的 version。
不要改动空行和以 '#' 开头的注释行的返回值 (None, None, None, None)。
不要改动 repo_url_to_role_name 的命名推断。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/utils/__init__.py 中的 role_spec_parse。它把 'src,version,name' 形式的 role spec 解析为 dict(scm, src, version, name)。
识别缺陷: 当前代码在确定 scm 之前就无条件设置 role_version='master'(只要 src 不以 .tar.gz 结尾就会这样做)。结果是 hg 角色也拿到了 git 专用的分支名。
删除这段在 scm 解析之前的硬编码默认分支逻辑。
增加一张按 scm 区分的默认版本映射表,例如 default_role_versions = dict(git='master', hg='tip')。
把默认版本的赋值放在 scm、role_url 和 role_name 全部解析完成之后、return 之前,写成: if scm and not role_version: role_version = default_role_versions.get(scm, '')。
保持用户显式指定的 version(tokens[1])优先,默认值只在 version 为空时填充。
保持 tarball 和非 scm 源的 version 为空字符串。github.com 自动推断为 git 的逻辑保持不变,它仍会得到 'master'。
validation: 运行现有的 galaxy 和 utils 单元测试与集成测试。
手工验证 role_spec_parse('hg+https://host/repo') 返回 version='tip'。
手工验证 role_spec_parse('git+https://host/repo') 和 role_spec_parse('https://github.com/u/r') 返回 version='master'。
手工验证 'git+https://host/repo,v1.0' 保留 version='v1.0'。
手工验证 .tar.gz 源返回 version=''。

name: generic-shebang-interpreter-override
negative_constraints: Do not hardcode `python` in the override condition. The whole point of the fix is to support any `ansible_<bin>_interpreter`.
Do not write conditions like `if '#!' and 'python' in line`. The literal `'#!'` is always truthy, so it only tests the second clause. Use `line.startswith('#!')`.
Do not call `_transfer_str` before the shebang rewrite. That ships the stale interpreter to the remote host.
Do not update `module_data` without also updating the returned `shebang`, or the reverse. Execution and the transferred file would diverge.

Do not pass the raw `'#!/path'` string, or a shebang that has arguments, straight to `os.path.basename`. Strip `#!` first. For `#!/usr/bin/env python`, basename returns `env python`, so take the interpreter token instead.
procedure: Locate the module-copy path in Runner (`_copy_module`). Shebang detection happens there: `lines = module_data.split('\n')` and `lines[0].startswith('#!')`. Configurable replacements such as syslog facility are also done there.

Delete the separate, python-only branch (`if 'ansible_python_interpreter' in inject`). Do the interpreter override inside the existing shebang-detection block, so the shebang is parsed in exactly one place.
Build the variable name from the interpreter's basename: `'ansible_%s_interpreter' % os.path.basename(<interpreter path>)`. For example, `#!/usr/bin/ruby` maps to `ansible_ruby_interpreter`.
If that key exists in `inject`, update `lines[0]`, the returned `shebang` variable and `module_data` (via `'\n'.join(lines)`) together.
Call `self._transfer_str(conn, tmp, module_name, module_data)` after the override. The file that is sent must contain the rewritten shebang.
Keep the return signature `(out_path, is_new_style, shebang)` unchanged. Callers build the remote command from the returned shebang, so it must be the overridden value.
validation: Run the existing runner/unit tests (`make tests` or `nosetests test/`).
Run a module with `#!/usr/bin/python` and `ansible_python_interpreter=/opt/py/bin/python`. Verify that both the transferred file and the executed command use the new path.
Run a non-python module, for example `#!/usr/bin/ruby` with `ansible_ruby_interpreter` set. Verify the override is applied.
Run a module whose shebang has no matching variable. Verify that its shebang and contents are byte-identical to the original.

name: guard-chown-in-atomic-move-by-ownership-diff
negative_constraints: Do not wrap os.chown in a blanket try/except that swallows EPERM or ENOSYS. A genuine ownership mismatch should still fail loudly.
Do not remove the chown entirely. Preserving the original owner of dest is required when ownership really differs.
Do not compare against the stat of the original src. Compare the tempfile that will actually be renamed into place, because the tempfile's ownership is what matters.
Do not change Python-2-era syntax such as 'except X, e' in this file unless the task asks for it. module_utils must stay compatible with old target interpreters.
procedure: Locate AnsibleModule.atomic_move in lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py. Find the fallback branch where rename fails: it copies src into a tempfile beside dest (tmp_dest), sets the selinux context, chowns the tempfile to dest_stat's uid/gid, then calls os.rename(tmp_dest.name, dest).
Before the chown, stat the tempfile: tmp_stat = os.stat(tmp_dest.name).
Change the condition to call os.chown only when dest_stat exists and ownership actually differs: tmp_stat.st_uid != dest_stat.st_uid or tmp_stat.st_gid != dest_stat.st_gid.
Keep the existing exception handling unchanged: the (shutil.Error, OSError, IOError) except block and its fail_json. Real ownership changes must still report errors.

Check other chown or chmod call sites in the same move/copy path, such as the direct-rename branch and set_owner_if_different. If they hit the same remote-FS corner case, use the same 'compare stat first, mutate only if different' pattern.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for module_utils basic, if present, plus any atomic_move tests.
Simulate the bug: mock os.chown to raise OSError(EPERM) and mock os.stat so the tempfile and dest have equal uid/gid. Check that atomic_move succeeds and that chown is never called.
Mock different uid/gid values and check that chown is called with dest_stat.st_uid and dest_stat.st_gid.
Mock dest_stat as None (dest does not exist) and check that chown is skipped.

name: guard-chown-on-atomic-move-by-root
negative_constraints: 不要用 try/except 静默吞掉所有 chown 的 OSError 来代替权限判断。这会掩盖 root 场景下真实的 chown 失败。
不要删除 uid/gid 比较本身。root 场景仍需保留原文件属主。
不要假设 System V 风格的 give-away 语义, 也就是普通用户可以 chown 给他人。
不要改动 atomic_move 的函数签名, 也不要改它的 rename 回退逻辑。这次修复只限于条件守卫。
不要用 os.geteuid 之外的环境变量或用户名来判断 root, 应保持与已有实现一致的 os.getuid() == 0 判断。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py 中 AnsibleModule.atomic_move。找到写临时文件 tmp_dest 后、os.rename 前的分支, 这里会对比 tmp_stat 与 dest_stat 的 st_uid/st_gid。
在现有的 uid/gid 不一致判断上追加权限前置条件 `and os.getuid() == 0`。只有 root 调用时才执行 os.chown(tmp_dest.name, dest_stat.st_uid, dest_stat.st_gid)。
保持其余流程不变: selinux context 设置、os.stat、os.rename,以及 except (shutil.Error, OSError, IOError) 的回退和错误处理路径。
确认非 root 时跳过 chown 不破坏语义。非特权用户本来无法把文件转给他人, rename 后文件属主就是调用者; 而用户能替换 dest, 说明他对目标目录有写权限。
检查同一函数或其他 module_utils 中是否还有无条件调用 os.chown/os.lchown 来保留属主的地方。有的话用同样的 getuid()==0 守卫统一处理, 避免在 Linux/BSD 上抛出 EPERM。
validation: run existing tests (test/units 中 module_utils/basic 相关单测)
以非 root 用户对一个属主为其他用户、但目录可写的目标文件执行 copy/template 模块。确认不再报 'Operation not permitted', 且文件成功替换。
以 root 执行同样操作。确认目标文件的 uid/gid 仍被保留为原属主。
用 python -m py_compile 检查 basic.py 语法。该文件需兼容 Python 2 的 `except X, e` 语法, 不要引入仅 py3 可用的语法。

name: guard-conditionally-bound-stat-in-atomic-move
negative_constraints: Do not call os.stat(dest) unconditionally. dest may legitimately not exist, which is the new-file case.
Do not drop the chown in the shutil.move/copy2 fallback. Ownership is not preserved by copy2, so the reset must stay for existing destinations.
Do not broaden the except clauses to hide the bug. Fix the unbound variable at its source.
Keep the Python 2-compatible syntax used in this file (`except X, e`, `07777` octal literals).
procedure: Open lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py. Locate AnsibleModule.atomic_move.

Find each variable that is only assigned inside a conditional block. In this case, `st = os.stat(dest)` runs only under `if os.path.exists(dest)` and only when the try succeeds. Then check whether a later fallback path uses that variable. Here the cross-filesystem path (tempfile + shutil.move + os.chown + os.rename) reads it.
Initialize the variable to None before the conditional, e.g. `dest_stat = None`.
Rename terse names like `st` to something descriptive such as `dest_stat`. Update every use in the chmod/chown block.

Wrap each later use in `if dest_stat:`. This covers both the case where dest did not exist and the case where stat/chown raised EPERM and was swallowed. In those cases, skip the owner reset on tmp_dest.
Keep the existing EPERM tolerance and the existing selinux context handling unchanged.
validation: Check that `python -m py_compile lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py` succeeds.

Manual or unit scenario 1: atomic_move into a non-existent dest on a different filesystem from src (e.g. /tmp to a bind mount) should raise no NameError or UnboundLocalError and should create the file.
Manual or unit scenario 2: atomic_move over an existing dest owned by another user should preserve the original uid/gid, mode and selinux context.
Run the existing module_utils tests (e.g. test/units).
Grep the function for any remaining reference to the old variable name `st`.

name: guard-empty-host-set-before-range-slicing
negative_constraints: 不要在范围计算内部用 try/except IndexError 吞掉异常,应在入口显式判断空集合。
不要对不存在或为空的组抛出新的错误或警告。期望行为是静默返回空主机列表。
不要改动 _enumeration_info 的解析语义或已有的范围 / limit 行为。
不要只修代码而不加回归测试。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/inventory/__init__.py 中处理 `pattern[start:end]` 范围选择的方法(docstring 写着 'given a pattern like foo[0:5]... return the first 6 hosts'),也就是调用 self._enumeration_info(pat) 的那个方法。
在函数开头加一个早返回 `if not hosts: return hosts`,放在解析 pattern 或计算 limits 之前。返回原对象,不要新建空容器,这样调用方拿到的类型保持一致。
加一行简短注释,说明这个 guard 防止对空集合做切片或下标访问,并引用 issue 编号。
保留已有的 `if not limits: return hosts` 分支和切片逻辑不变。修复只做空输入短路,不重写范围计算。
在 test/units/TestInventory.py 中参照现有 subset 测试(如 greek[0-2];norse[0])新增用例:用 self.simple_inventory(),调用 inventory.subset('missing[0]'),再断言 sorted(inventory.list_hosts()) == []。
validation: 运行 test/units/TestInventory.py 中的单元测试(例如 nosetests test/units/TestInventory.py),确认新用例通过。
确认现有的 subset/range 测试仍然通过,例如 greek[0-2];norse[0] 返回 zeus、hera、thor。
手动验证:对一个缺失或为空的组执行 `ansible -i inv 'missing[0]' --list-hosts`,结果应为空列表且没有 traceback。

name: guard-missing-ungrouped-group-on-implicit-localhost
negative_constraints: 不要用 try/except AttributeError 吞掉错误,这会掩盖 localhost 没有被加入任何组的问题。
不要改变 ansible-pull 的调用方式或 inventory 参数来绕过问题,根因在 inventory 假设 ungrouped 组必然存在。
不要移除动态添加 localhost 的特性(94f3b9b 引入的行为)。
不要在 Inventory.__init__ 中无条件重复创建 ungrouped 组,否则会和各类 inventory 解析器已经创建的组冲突、造成重复。
procedure: 从 traceback 定位到 lib/ansible/inventory/__init__.py 中的 Inventory 动态添加 localhost 的路径。该路径在 _hosts_in_unenumerated_pattern 附近,会 new Host('localhost') 并 set_variable ansible_connection=local。
确认触发场景。ansible-pull 这类调用会用 'localhost,' 这种简单 host list 或空 inventory 初始化,此时可能根本没有创建 'ungrouped' 组,所以 self.get_group('ungrouped') 返回 None。
在调用 ungrouped.add_host(new_host) 之前加 None 判断。如果为 None,就执行 self.add_group(Group('ungrouped')),然后重新执行 self.get_group('ungrouped') 取回该组。
复用 Inventory 现有的 add_group/get_group API。不要直接操作 self.groups 列表,这样组的缓存和父子关系(all -> ungrouped)才能保持一致。
确认 Group 已在该模块 import(from ansible.inventory.group import Group)。
保持修改局部化,只补齐缺失的组。原有 localhost 的变量设置和 results.append 逻辑不改动。
validation: 运行现有 inventory 单元测试,例如 test/units/TestInventory.py,确认无回归。
手动复现失败路径:用 Inventory('localhost,') 或空 host list 时执行 list_hosts('localhost') 不再抛 AttributeError,且返回 ['localhost']。
运行 ansible -i 'somehost,' localhost -m ping(或用 ansible-pull 本地运行),确认 localhost 以 local 连接执行。
检查 get_group('ungrouped') 在修复后包含 localhost,且 ungrouped 是 all 组的子组(如适用)。

name: ini-inventory-literal-eval-fallback
negative_constraints: Do not replace ast.literal_eval with eval. Inventory content is untrusted, and eval would allow code execution.
Do not remove literal_eval entirely. Numeric and structured values must keep their types.
Do not wrap the split or the AnsibleError raise inside the new try block, or real syntax errors will be hidden.
Do not strip or alter the raw value in the fallback. Store v exactly as written.
procedure: Open lib/ansible/inventory/ini.py. In InventoryParser, find the host-line parsing loop that splits each token as k=v and calls host.set_variable(k, ast.literal_eval(v)).
Wrap only the ast.literal_eval call in a try/except. When it succeeds, keep the typed value: int, list, dict, quoted string, and so on.
When it fails, fall back to host.set_variable(k, v) so the raw value is kept as a plain string. Bare words like ansible_ssh_host=foo.example.com and paths fail literal_eval.
Prefer catching specific exceptions: ValueError, SyntaxError and TypeError. A bare except also works, as in the upstream fix. Add a comment explaining that the fallback is for unquoted strings.
Leave the existing ValueError handling around t.split('=') untouched. Malformed k=v entries must still raise errors.AnsibleError('Invalid ini entry...').
Check whether any other inventory variable paths, such as group vars sections, call literal_eval directly. Apply the same fallback there so behavior stays consistent.
validation: Run the existing inventory unit tests (test/TestInventory.py or the equivalent).
Parse an ini inventory line such as 'host1 a=1 b=hello c=[1,2] d=/usr/bin/python'. Check that a is the int 1, b is the string 'hello', c is a list and d is the raw string.
Check that a token with no '=' still raises AnsibleError.

name: init-state-in-constructor-not-connect
negative_constraints: 不要在 _connect() 中重置已有的实例属性。
不要依赖 _connect() 已经执行过才可访问某个属性。
procedure: 定位 ssh.py 的 Connection._connect(), 找出其中首次创建的实例属性(例如 self._common_args = [])。
把这些属性的默认值移到 Connection.__init__ 中, 放在 super().__init__ 调用之前。
_connect() 中只追加或填充参数(extra_args、ControlPersist 等), 不再重新赋空值。
validation: run existing tests。
未调用 _connect() 时访问 conn._common_args, 应得到 [] 而不是 AttributeError。

name: inventory-groups-in-host-file-parsing
negative_constraints: 不要只改 parse_hosts 的返回类型而遗漏调用方。旧调用会把元组当作 host 列表,导致对 'hosts' 和 '{}' 去执行任务。
不要把 '[group]' 头行本身加入 host 列表。
不要让空行或纯空白行变成空主机名。旧实现 split('\n') 会产生空字符串 host。
不要在已经拆包过的分支外层再次调用 parse_hosts。要注意 playbook.py 中 if/else 的缩进,避免对已经是 list 的值重复解析,或者在错误的分支上解析。
不要顺手改无关常量,例如 DEFAULT_TIMEOUT。如果必须改,应在 PR 描述中单独说明。
procedure: 先定位 lib/ansible/runner.py 里的 Runner.parse_hosts classmethod。它是 inventory 文件解析的唯一入口。
把 parse_hosts 的返回值改成 (hosts, groups) 二元组。如果传入的已经是 list,直接返回 (host_list, {})。
如果传入的是路径,先用 os.path.expanduser 展开,再按行读取文件。
逐行解析:跳过空行;遇到 '[name]' 行,就把 group_name 切换为 name;其他行是 host,加入 results,同时追加到 groups[group_name]。默认组名用 'ungrouped'。
在 Runner.__init__ 中把解析结果拆包为 self.host_list 和 self.groups,供后续模式匹配使用。
修改模式匹配逻辑(如 _matches 或主机选择函数):如果 pattern 等于某个 group 名,就选中该组内的所有 host;否则保留原有的 fnmatch 主机名匹配。
全仓 grep 'parse_hosts(' 找出所有调用点,逐一改成元组拆包。lib/ansible/playbook.py 至少有两处:play 加载时 'self.host_list, groups = Runner.parse_hosts(host_file)',以及 task 执行时的 host_list 解析。
playbook.py 中 'hosts' 键的值要视为文件路径,先解析再赋给 self.host_list。不要把原始路径字符串继续当作 host 列表传下去。
validation: 构造一个包含 '[web]' 和 '[db]' 分组以及未分组 host 的临时 inventory 文件。确认 parse_hosts 返回的 hosts 是全部主机,groups 中有 'web'、'db'、'ungrouped' 三个键。
用 group 名作为 pattern 运行 Runner(如 ansible -p web -m ping),确认只命中该组内的主机。
用通配 pattern '*' 和具体主机名运行,确认原有的 fnmatch 行为没有回归。
用传入 list 的方式调用 Runner,确认返回 (list, {}) 后仍然可以运行。
运行一个指定 hosts 文件的 playbook,确认 play 和 handler 都能正常解析主机。
执行 grep -n 'parse_hosts(' lib/,确认所有调用点都已按元组处理。

name: keep-shared-util-return-contract-fix-at-caller
negative_constraints: Don't add type-specific coercion like `if type(x) == str: x = 0` inside a shared module_utils helper to fix one module.
Don't use 0 as an 'unknown' value. It can be mistaken for a real version and it discards the real data.
Don't use `type(x) == str` checks to change a public helper's return type without auditing all callers.
procedure: If a bug shows up in one consumer, such as the hostname module failing on a string version, first check whether an earlier fix changed a shared helper in lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py just to suit that consumer.
Revert that helper change, for example coercing a str distribution_version to 0, so the helper again returns the real platform value, normally a string like '6.4'.
When the platform is not Linux, return None as the 'unknown' sentinel. Do not return 0.
Make the consumer handle the type it receives: parse or compare the version string itself and handle None explicitly.
Grep every caller of the helper and confirm each one handles both a str and None.
validation: Run the existing unit and integration tests that touch module_utils/basic.py and the hostname module.
Check that get_distribution_version() returns a string on Linux and None elsewhere.
Grep for get_distribution_version callers and confirm none of them depends on an int return.

name: linux-distro-version-fallback-system-release
negative_constraints: 不要无条件传 supported_dists=['system'],否则会改变 RHEL、CentOS 等已能正确识别的发行版的结果。
不要用发行版名称硬编码判断(例如 if 'amazon'),应以版本为空加文件存在作为触发条件。
不要把回退放到 except 分支里。这里的问题是返回空值,不是抛异常。
不要改动非 Linux 平台的分支,也不要改变函数返回 None 或字符串的约定。
不要在 module_utils 中使用 Python 2.4/2.6 不兼容的语法。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py 中的 get_distribution_version(),找到 platform.system() == 'Linux' 分支里 platform.linux_distribution()[1] 的调用。
确认失败模式:Amazon Linux 这类发行版没有 *-release 文件匹配默认的 supported_dists,所以 linux_distribution() 返回空版本字符串,不会抛异常。
在原有 try 块内、首次调用之后增加回退:仅当 distribution_version 为空且 os.path.isfile('/etc/system-release') 为真时,调用 platform.linux_distribution(supported_dists=['system'])[1] 重新取版本。
复用已有的 try/except 结构。旧 Python 没有 linux_distribution 时,仍由原 except 分支走 platform.dist() 回退,不要另起错误处理。
确认 basic.py 已 import os。module_utils 会被嵌入远程模块执行,不要引入新的第三方依赖。
如果 get_distribution() 等同类函数也有同样的空值问题,用相同的条件回退方式处理,并保持各函数行为对称。
validation: 运行现有的 module_utils 单元测试(例如 test/units/module_utils/ 下的 basic 相关测试)。
mock platform.linux_distribution:第一次调用返回 ('', '', ''),带 supported_dists=['system'] 的调用返回 ('Amazon Linux AMI', '2015.03', ''),同时 mock os.path.isfile('/etc/system-release') 为 True,断言结果是 '2015.03'。
mock 正常发行版(返回非空版本),断言 linux_distribution 只被调用一次,结果不变。
mock /etc/system-release 不存在,断言仍返回原来的空值,不会额外调用。
在 Amazon Linux 实例上运行 ansible -m setup,确认 ansible_distribution_version 不再为空。

name: listhosts-unnamed-play-label-consistency
negative_constraints: 不要修改 Play.get_name() 本身的返回格式。其他调用方(callback 的 banner 输出)依赖它。
不要把哨兵比较串 'PLAY: <no name specified>' 改成别的值,否则未命名检测会失效。
不要在打印端再拼接 'PLAY: ' 前缀,否则会造成重复前缀。
不要改变 play 编号的起始值或 playlist 的 key 名。
procedure: 定位 v2/ansible/executor/playbook_executor.py 中构造 --list-hosts / --list-tasks 输出的 playlist 循环。重点看 pname = play.get_name().strip() 之后对未命名 play 的替换逻辑。
确认 Play.get_name() 的返回格式。命名 play 返回 'PLAY: <name>',未命名 play 返回哨兵串 'PLAY: <no name specified>'。
在替换未命名 play 的 fallback 标签时,沿用 get_name() 的 'PLAY: ' 前缀,例如写成 'PLAY: #%d' % i,不要另起 'play #%d' 这类风格。这样 playlist 中每个条目的 'name' 前缀和大小写都一致。
只做最小替换,只改 fallback 字符串字面量。保留枚举序号 i 和 playlist 字典结构({'name': pname, ...})不变。
全局 grep 'no name specified' 和 'play #',检查 CLI 端(如 v2/ansible/cli 或 bin/ansible-playbook 中打印 playlist 的代码)是否依赖旧字符串或另加了前缀。避免出现 'PLAY: PLAY: #1' 这样的双前缀。
validation: 构造一个包含命名 play 和未命名 play 的 playbook,运行 ansible-playbook --list-hosts。检查每行 play 名都以 'PLAY: ' 开头,且没有重复前缀。
运行 --list-tasks,确认同一处输出的格式同样一致。
运行现有的 v2 单元测试(如 test/units 下 executor 相关测试),确认没有断言旧的 'play #N' 字符串。

name: module-result-keys-align-with-sibling-modules
negative_constraints: 不要发明新的返回键来表达已有语义。
不要反过来修改参考模块去迁就目标模块。
procedure: 当 issue 提到某选项的行为要与其他模块一致时,先找出共享该选项的兄弟模块(如 command、shell、script 共享 creates/removes)。
对比各模块 exit_json/fail_json 返回的键集合,找出目标模块多出或缺少的键。
只做最小修改,使目标模块与参考模块的返回键对齐;优先删除多余的、语义错误的键。
validation: 运行目标模块的现有测试。
对比修改后目标模块与参考模块在相同条件下的返回 JSON 键集合,确认一致。

name: module-utils-no-controller-imports
negative_constraints: 不要在 module_utils/*.py 中 import ansible.constants、ansible.utils 或任何仅存在于控制端的包。
不要用 ansible.cfg 的 [ssl] 段或环境变量去控制远程模块的运行时行为。
回退时不要遗漏 SSLValidationHandler 中代理分支与直连分支两处 wrap_socket 调用中的任何一处。
procedure: 先确认要改的文件是否在 lib/ansible/module_utils/ 下。这里的代码会被打包进模块，在远程目标机上执行。远程机没有 ansible 控制端包，也读不到 ansible.cfg。
检查改动是否新增了 `from ansible import constants as C` 或其他控制端 import。module_utils 里出现这类 import 就是缺陷。修复办法是删除该 import，并把对 C.* 的引用恢复成本地常量或 Python 标准库常量，例如 ssl.PROTOCOL_TLSv1。
需要让用户配置远程侧行为（如 SSL 协议版本）时，不要读控制端配置，应把它做成模块参数，经 module.params 传入。module_utils 的函数通过形参或 module 对象接收这个值。
回退某个 feature 时，要逐个 call site 恢复原值。修改前要分清各调用点原本的参数：CustomHTTPSConnection.connect 原本显式传 ssl_version=ssl.PROTOCOL_TLSv1；SSLValidationHandler 的两处 wrap_socket（代理分支和直连分支）原本不传 ssl_version。不能统一成同一个值。
import 区块要恢复成原样，包括被替换掉的空行，避免引入额外的 diff 噪音。

keywords: from ansible import constants as C

validation: 执行 grep -rn 'from ansible import constants' lib/ansible/module_utils/，结果应为空。
执行 grep -n 'C\.' lib/ansible/module_utils/urls.py，确认没有残留的 C.SSL_PROTOCOL 引用。
在未安装 ansible 的干净 Python 环境中跑一个使用 urls.py 的模块（如 get_url 访问 https），确认不出现 ImportError。
运行现有单元测试和 get_url/uri 集成测试。

name: no-stray-debug-output-in-runner
negative_constraints: Do not add a print statement in Runner.__init__. It runs once for every Runner instance, and the output mixes into module JSON results and callback output.
Do not ship debug statements as part of an error-message tweak.
procedure: Before committing, review every added line in git diff and locate bare print statements in library code (lib/ansible/**).
If diagnostic output is needed, route it through the existing callbacks or verbosity mechanism (e.g. vvv / callbacks.display) instead of printing to stdout directly.
Delete temporary debug lines that were used to inspect values of parameters such as error_on_undefined_vars.
validation: git diff | grep '^+.*print' should be empty, or each hit must be confirmed as intentional user-facing output
run existing tests
Run ansible localhost -m ping and confirm the output contains no extra DEBUG lines

name: normalize-distribution-version-for-platform-subclass
negative_constraints: Do not return None or the raw string from get_distribution_version(). The comparisons made during subclass selection would break on that value.
Do not patch each subclass, for example in hostname.py, to guard its comparison. The failure happens in shared code, so the fix belongs there.
Do not change the try/except fallback order (linux_distribution first, then dist()). Only normalize the final value.
Do not raise an exception on an unparseable version. Degrade to the sentinel so that module loading still succeeds.
procedure: Open lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py and find get_distribution_version(). Inside it, follow the branch that reads the version from platform.linux_distribution() or from the platform.dist() fallback.
After the try/except that sets distribution_version, add a type check. If the value is a non-numeric string such as 'jessie/sid', set it to the sentinel 0.
Replace the `None` returned by the non-Linux else branch with the same sentinel 0. This gives every return path a consistent type.
Leave load_platform_subclass() unchanged. It loops over every subclass and evaluates each version comparison, so the fix belongs in the version-source function and not in each module subclass.
Leave modules that consume this value, such as hostname, unchanged. Normalizing the value at the source fixes all of them at once.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for module_utils/basic, if any are present.
Mock platform.linux_distribution() to return ('debian', 'jessie/sid', '') and assert that get_distribution_version() returns 0.
Mock platform.system() to return a non-Linux value and assert that the return value is 0, not None.
Instantiate the hostname module's platform subclass selection with the mocked string version and confirm that no TypeError or comparison error is raised.

name: normalize-distro-name-keys-in-facts-detection
negative_constraints: Do not change the substring used to inspect release-file content. It must match the vendor's actual text, which includes the space.
Do not add a second OS_FAMILY key for the spaced variant as a workaround. Fix the inconsistent identifier at its source.
Do not change only OSDIST_LIST or only the elif branch. The tuple value and the comparison must be updated together, or the branch silently never matches.
procedure: Locate the distribution-detection logic in lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py. It has three linked parts: OSDIST_LIST (release-file path -> canonical distro name), the per-name branches in the release-file parsing loop (`elif name == '...'`), and the OS_FAMILY mapping (distro name -> family, e.g. 'OracleLinux': 'RedHat').
Use the key in the OS_FAMILY mapping as the canonical identifier. It has no spaces, matching what platform.dist() returns, e.g. 'OracleLinux'.
Grep the file for every spelling variant of the distro name, e.g. 'Oracle Linux' and 'OracleLinux'. Classify each hit as either an identifier or file content.
Identifiers are OSDIST_LIST tuple values, `name ==` comparisons and OS_FAMILY keys. Change all of them to the canonical form so they match exactly.
File-content checks match the human-readable text inside the release file, e.g. `if 'Oracle Linux' in data`. Keep these as the literal marketing string; do not normalize them.
Trace the full path: the release file is matched, then self.facts['distribution'] = name, then the OS_FAMILY lookup sets os_family. Confirm the name assigned is exactly an OS_FAMILY key.
validation: Grep facts.py and confirm the distro identifier has exactly one spelling across OSDIST_LIST, the name comparisons and the OS_FAMILY keys.
Simulate detection: mock /etc/oracle-release containing 'Oracle Linux Server release 7.x' with platform.dist() empty. Assert facts['distribution']=='OracleLinux' and facts['os_family']=='RedHat'.
Run the existing facts/unit tests to check that detection of other distros (RedHat, CentOS, etc.) is unchanged.

name: normalize-list-pattern-in-inventory-get-hosts
negative_constraints: 不要为 list 输入另写一套模式匹配或主机查找逻辑, 应复用已有的字符串解析路径。
不要在 playbook 层逐个调用 get_hosts 再合并结果来绕过问题, 修复点应在 inventory 的 API 边界。
不要改变字符串 pattern 的现有语义 (':' 与 ';' 分隔, '!' 排除)。
测试不要依赖未定义的返回顺序: 比较前先排序, 或用集合比较。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/inventory/__init__.py 中 Inventory.get_hosts 处理 pattern 的入口, 也就是 pattern.replace(';',':').split(':') 这一行之前。
复用已有的字符串模式语法: 如果 pattern 是 list, 用 ';'.join(pattern) 把它归一化为分号分隔的字符串, 让后续正/负模式拆分 ('!' 前缀) 和子集逻辑原样生效。
把归一化放在函数最前面、所有字符串操作之前。这样 positive_patterns 和 negative_patterns 的计算路径对 str 与 list 两种输入保持一致。
在 test/TestInventory.py 中增加 test_hosts_list 用例: 用 self.script_inventory() 构造 inventory, 把多个主机名列表 (如 thor/loki/odin) 传给 get_hosts, 断言返回的 host.name 集合与输入一致。
顺便清理被修改行上的行尾空白 (例如 '# process patterns' 注释), 但不做额外重构。
validation: 运行 test/TestInventory.py 中现有的全部测试, 确认字符串 pattern 行为未回归。
运行新增的 test_hosts_list, 确认 list 输入返回的主机正确。
可选: 用 ['all', '!loki'] 这类混合列表验证排除模式在 list 输入下同样生效。

name: normalize-multiword-linux-distribution-name
negative_constraints: 不要把空格替换成下划线或拼接成新名字(如 'Centos_linux'), 这会破坏现有子类匹配。
不要为单个发行版硬编码特例(如 if distribution == 'Centos linux'), 应采用通用的取首 token 规则。
不要移除或改变 capitalize() 调用, 下游比较依赖这种大小写形式。
不要改动 platform.system() 判断或 /etc/system-release 回退路径。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py 中的 get_distribution(), 找到 Linux 分支里 platform.linux_distribution()[0].capitalize() 的赋值处。
确认失败模式: 发行版字符串带空格(如 'CentOS Linux')时, 返回值与按 distribution 名匹配的平台子类(如 distribution = 'Centos')对不上, 模块类加载失败。
紧跟该赋值增加归一化: 若字符串含空格, 用 split() 取第一个 token, 使结果回到历史上的单词形式。
把归一化放在 'if not distribution' 回退分支(/etc/system-release、Amazon 处理)之前, 不改动回退逻辑。
对照 capitalize() 的效果核对返回值: 'CentOS Linux' -> 'Centos linux' -> 'Centos', 与现有子类 distribution 字符串保持一致。
validation: mock platform.linux_distribution 返回 ('CentOS Linux', '7.0', 'Core'), 断言 get_distribution() 返回 'Centos'。
mock 返回 ('', '', ''), 并让 /etc/system-release 存在, 断言 Amazon 回退路径仍然生效。
mock 返回 ('Ubuntu', ...) 这类单词名, 断言结果不变。
运行现有的 module_utils 单元测试。

name: normalize-play-hosts-before-templating
negative_constraints: 不要在类型规范化 (list->str) 之前调用 utils.template: 模板函数期望字符串, 收到 YAML list 时会出错或输出错误结果
不要在 None 检查之前做模板化或 join; 缺失的 hosts 必须直接报出清晰的 'hosts declaration is required' 错误
不要给 pg.get('hosts', None) 加上会掩盖缺失 hosts 的默认值
不要让 name 的默认值取自规范化之前的 pattern
不要为这个排序问题修改 inventory 的 pattern 解析逻辑, 修复范围应限定在 playbook.py
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/playbook.py 中处理 play 的函数 (_run_play / run a list of tasks for a given pattern), 找到读取 pg.get('hosts') 的位置

按以下顺序重排 hosts pattern 的处理流程: (1) 读取原始值 pg.get('hosts'); (2) 立即判断是否为 None, 若是则抛出 errors.AnsibleError('hosts declaration is required'); (3) 若为 list, 用 ';'.join(pattern) 合并为字符串; (4) 最后再调用 utils.template(pattern, self.extra_vars, {})
在规范化和模板化都完成之后再计算 name = pg.get('name', pattern), 保证默认的 play 名称是最终字符串, 而不是原始的 list 或未展开的模板
复用现有的 utils.template 和 ';' 分隔符约定 (inventory 的多 pattern 语法), 不要另造新的 join 逻辑
排查同文件中其他会把 YAML 值直接传给 utils.template 的字段, 确认它们的输入也已先规范化为字符串
validation: 运行现有测试套件 (如 make tests / nosetests test/)
用 hosts: [web, db] 这种 YAML list 写一个 playbook, 确认它被解析为 'web;db' 并匹配到两组主机
用 hosts: '$group' 加 extra_vars 测试, 确认字符串形式的 hosts 仍能正确模板化
省略 hosts, 确认抛出 AnsibleError('hosts declaration is required')
确认未设置 name 时, 显示的 play 名称是 join 并模板化之后的字符串

name: normalize-yaml-list-host-pattern-at-play-parse
negative_constraints: Do not change inventory._matches or the pattern-parsing semantics to accept lists. Normalize only at the input boundary.
Do not invent a new separator (such as ',' or ':') unless the inventory in this version recognizes it. Use ';' as the existing code does.
Do not change the handling order of override_hosts or of hosts being None.
Do not reject the existing string form. String patterns must pass through unchanged.
procedure: Locate the play-parsing entry point in lib/ansible/playbook.py where the play's 'hosts' value is read, e.g. pattern = pg.get('hosts', None).
Find the downstream consumer (inventory._matches / inventory pattern parsing) and confirm which separator it uses for multiple patterns. In this version it is ';'.
Right after reading 'hosts', normalize a YAML list into the string form inventory already accepts: if isinstance(pattern, list): pattern = ';'.join(pattern).
Keep the normalization before the override_hosts and None checks, so the existing control flow does not change. override still forces 'all', and None still follows the original error branch.
Reuse the separator the inventory already supports. Do not add a new list-handling path inside inventory.
validation: Run the existing test suite (e.g. tests/TestPlayBook.py, tests/TestInventory.py).
Run a play with hosts: [host1, host2] and confirm both hosts match without a crash.
Run a play with hosts: 'host1;host2' and confirm the result matches the list form.
Confirm that with --limit/override_hosts set, the pattern still becomes 'all'.

name: optimistic-rename-first-atomic-move
negative_constraints: 不要对所有 rename 异常都走拷贝后备，只放行 EXDEV 和 EPERM，其他错误必须立即 fail_json。
不要把 selinux context 的修复只放在后备分支里。乐观 rename 成功后也要设置 dest 的 context。
不要把临时文件建在系统 tmp 或 src 目录。它必须放在 dest_dir，否则最后一步 rename 会再次跨设备、失去原子性。
不要删掉 sudo 非 root 情况下的 shutil.copy 分支，否则会破坏 tempdir 的清理权限语义。
确认文件顶部已 import errno；不要用 18/1 这样的魔法数字代替 errno 常量。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_common.py 中 AnsibleModule.atomic_move。先保持开头的 context 计算逻辑不变：dest 已存在时取 dest 的 selinux context 和属性；dest 不存在时取 selinux_default_context(dest)。
第一步直接调用 os.rename(src, dest)。同一文件系统上的 rename 本身是原子的，多数情况下不需要再拷贝到临时文件。
捕获 (IOError, OSError)，并检查 e.errno。只有 errno.EXDEV（跨设备，18）和 errno.EPERM（不允许，1）进入后备路径。其他 errno 直接 self.fail_json(msg='Could not replace file: %s to %s: %s' % (src, dest, e))。
复用原有的后备逻辑：在 dest 所在目录下建临时文件 '%s/.%s.%s.%s' % (dest_dir, dest_file, os.getpid(), time.time())，保证与 dest 同分区。
后备路径中，如果 os.getenv('SUDO_USER') 有值且 os.getuid() != 0，用 shutil.copy；否则用 shutil.move。完成后对 tmp_dest 调用 set_context_if_different，再 os.rename(tmp_dest, dest)。
后备路径出错（shutil.Error/OSError/IOError）时，先 self.cleanup(tmp_dest)，再 fail_json。
两条路径之后，在函数末尾统一执行：if self.selinux_enabled(): self.set_context_if_different(dest, context, False)。rename 不一定保留 context，所以乐观路径和后备路径都要补设。
更新 docstring，说明函数靠 os.rename 保证原子性，其余代码用于处理限制条件、边界情况，并保留 selinux context。
validation: python -c 'import ansible.module_common' 确认语法正确（Python 2 的 except X, e 写法）并且已 import errno。
同分区场景：用 copy/template 模块替换文件，确认走的是直接 rename，且 dest 目录下没有残留 .dest.pid.time 文件。
跨设备场景：src 在 /tmp（tmpfs）、dest 在另一文件系统，确认走后备路径且替换成功。
错误路径：dest 目录不存在时（ENOENT），确认直接返回 'Could not replace file' 失败，不尝试拷贝。
在启用 selinux 的主机上，两条路径都检查 dest 的 context 与原文件或默认 context 一致。
运行现有单元测试和集成测试（如 test/ 下的 copy/file 相关用例）。

name: optional-dependency-with-platform-specific-hard-failure
negative_constraints: 不要因为单个平台的问题,就移除其他平台上可用的标准库回退。
不要让已知错误的平台静默返回结果。
不要新增必选依赖,也不要修改 setup 或 requirements,除非任务明确要求。
procedure: 先识别问题:某个标准库函数(例如 crypt)在特定平台上会静默产生错误结果。
按 Ansible 的惯用写法引入可选的第三方库:try: import X; HAS_X = True / except: HAS_X = False。
让代码优先使用这个可选库。库不可用时,只在已知会出问题的平台(用 sys.platform 判断)上抛出带安装提示的插件专属错误,其他平台继续回退到标准库实现。
把分支逻辑限定在实际计算结果的位置,不改动参数准备和输入校验代码。
validation: 通过 mock 覆盖三条分支:库存在、库缺失且平台有问题、库缺失且平台正常。
运行现有单元测试,确认没有回归。

name: ordered-fallback-table-specific-before-generic
negative_constraints: Do not reorder unrelated existing entries.
Do not broaden the generic matcher to exclude the derivative. Prefer a specific-first entry.
procedure: Identify whether detection iterates an ordered table and stops at the first match.
Check whether the misdetected entity also satisfies a more generic entry's predicate. Example: a derivative distro that ships its parent's marker file.
Add the specific entry ahead of the generic one in the table.
Add a matching handler with an explicit terminating break or return.
Keep the generic entry unchanged so the parent detection still works.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Test both the derivative case and the parent case to confirm there is no regression in the generic detection.

name: per-host-python-interpreter-shebang-rewrite
negative_constraints: Do not write the condition as `'#!' and 'python' in line`. The `and` makes '#!' always truthy, so the condition only checks 'python'. Use `line.startswith('#!') and 'python' in line`.
Do not use '\n'.join(readlines()). It doubles every line ending and corrupts the module (for example docstrings and heredoc arguments).
Do not drop the trailing newline when replacing the shebang. That glues the first and second lines together.
Do not rewrite non-python modules (shell or binary modules without a python shebang).
Do not modify the module file on the control machine. Change only the in-memory content that gets transferred.
Do not change the transfer behaviour or return value for hosts that do not set the variable.
procedure: Locate the module transfer step in lib/ansible/runner/__init__.py. The method copies a module to the remote host with conn.put_file(in_path, out_path) and returns out_path.
Look up the variables for the current host with self.inventory.get_variables(conn.host). Do not invent a new config path. The inventory or host_vars is the source of per-host configuration.
Rewrite only when the host defines 'ansible_python_interpreter'. Otherwise keep the original conn.put_file path unchanged, so default behaviour does not regress.
Read the local module file and check that the first line is really a python shebang. Use line.startswith('#!') and 'python' in line. Replace only that line with '#!' + interpreter + '\n'.

Reassemble the content with ''.join(lines), because readlines keeps the newlines. Send it with the existing helper self._transfer_str(conn, tmp, module, data) so the remote path and permissions match the put_file path.
Keep the return value as out_path (tmp + module). Callers depend on that path when they execute the module.
validation: Run the existing test suite (e.g. make tests / nosetests test/), especially the Runner tests.

Set ansible_python_interpreter=/usr/bin/python2.6 for one host in the inventory. Run a python module and confirm the first line of the remote tmp file is '#!/usr/bin/python2.6' and the rest of the file is byte-identical.
Run a host without the variable and confirm the module still goes through put_file unchanged.
Run a module without a python shebang and confirm its content is not rewritten.

name: platform-detection-empty-result-guarded-fallback
negative_constraints: 不要为修复单个发行版改写整个探测流程。
不要让回退路径影响原本能成功探测的平台。
不要在没有特征文件守卫的情况下执行额外的文件系统探测。
procedure: 定位平台或发行版探测函数(module_utils/basic.py、facts 相关代码),先区分两种失败:API 抛异常,还是返回空值或假值。
空值类失败用最小的条件回退处理,形式为:if not value and <特征文件存在>: value = <替代探测>。
回退要放在原调用之后、同一个 try 作用域内,这样替代探测抛出的异常也能被现有 except 兜住。
替代探测优先复用标准库接口的参数(例如 supported_dists),而不是自己解析文件。
validation: 运行现有单元测试。
用 mock 覆盖三条路径:主路径成功、主路径返回空值且触发回退、主路径抛异常且走 except。
确认回退逻辑能在 module_utils 支持的最低 Python 版本上运行。

name: port-shell-plugin-checksum-quoting-fix-to-v2
negative_constraints: Do not embed the raw path inside python double quotes. Backslashes in filenames become python escape sequences.
Do not hard-code '\n' inside the one-liner. It breaks csh/tcsh remote shells.
Do not fix only one of the two csums variants or only the test string. Every path occurrence must use the shell-escaped value.
Do not copy the whole checksum method into csh.py. Use the class-attribute hook.
Do not change the v1 files when the task is a port to v2.
procedure: Locate the original fix (e.g. #10372) in the v1 tree under lib/ansible/runner/shell_plugins/{sh,csh}.py. Diff it against the matching files under v2/ansible/plugins/shell/.
In the base ShModule (v2/ansible/plugins/shell/sh.py), add a class attribute `_SHELL_EMBEDDED_PY_EOL = '\n'`. It controls how lines end inside the `python -c '...'` one-liner.

In the csh subclass (v2/ansible/plugins/shell/csh.py), override it with `_SHELL_EMBEDDED_PY_EOL = '\\\n'`, which is a backslash followed by a newline. csh rejects bare newlines inside single quotes. Override only the attribute; do not duplicate checksum().

In checksum(), compute `shell_escaped_path = pipes.quote(path)` once. Replace every hand-written `'%s'` or `"%s"` use of path with it: the `[ -r ]`, `[ -f ]` and `[ -d ]` tests, the rc echo, and the final `echo '0  '<path>` fallback.

Inside the single-quoted python one-liner, embed the path by closing the outer single quote, inserting the quoted path, and reopening the quote. The result looks like `open("'{1}'", "rb")`, so the shell does the quoting and python never re-interprets backslashes.
Join the python lines with `{2}` and pass `self._SHELL_EMBEDDED_PY_EOL`, using str.format (positional {0} {1} {2}). Apply this to both the hashlib variant and the python2.4 `sha` variant.
Check that the module already imports pipes, as sh.py does. Leave the rc code semantics (0–4, 'flag') unchanged.
validation: Run the existing unit tests (e.g. v2/test/plugins and test/units for shell plugins).
Run the command generated by ShellModule().checksum('/tmp/a\\b c', 'python') under sh/bash.
Run the command from the csh ShellModule under csh/tcsh, and check that the printed sha1 matches `sha1sum`.
Check that paths with spaces, single quotes and backslashes produce the correct rc codes for missing, unreadable, directory and no-python cases.

name: port-v1-facts-fix-to-v2-tree
negative_constraints: 不要修改 `if 'Oracle Linux' in data` 这类文件内容匹配字符串, 它匹配的是 /etc/oracle-release 的实际内容, 带空格。
不要在 v2 里重写或重构这段探测逻辑, 移植应保持最小 diff。
不要只改 OSDIST_LIST 而漏掉比较分支, 否则该分支永远不会命中, 发行版检测会静默失效。
procedure: 定位已在 v1 落地的修复, 即 lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 中对应的 hunk。
在 v2/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 中找到同名结构, 例如 OSDIST_LIST 元组和 get_distribution_facts 中按文件探测发行版的循环。
逐处对齐修改, 不能只改一处。发行版名称字符串既出现在 OSDIST_LIST 的元组里, 也出现在后续的 `elif name == ...` 分支里, 两处必须同时改。
分清两类字符串: 一类是作为 fact 值输出的规范名, 如 'OracleLinux'; 另一类是用来在 release 文件里匹配内容的原文, 如 'Oracle Linux'。只改规范名, 保留匹配原文。
用 diff 对比 v1 与 v2 中这一段代码, 确认两边语义一致。
validation: 运行现有单元测试, 包括 v2 树下的 facts 相关测试。
在 v1 和 v2 两棵树中分别 grep 'Oracle Linux' 和 'OracleLinux', 确认两边出现的位置和用途一致。
可选: 模拟 /etc/oracle-release 的内容, 确认 distribution fact 的值为 'OracleLinux'。

name: port-v1-facts-fixes-to-v2-module-utils
negative_constraints: Do not modify v1 (lib/ansible) files when the task is porting to v2.
Do not reorder OSDIST_LIST in a way that lets a generic file (redhat-release, system-release) shadow a specific distro.
Do not change the casing of existing OS_FAMILY keys beyond what the v1 fix did. Lookup is a case-sensitive dict lookup.
Do not let a missing binary or file raise out of populate(). Fact gathering must stay best-effort.
Do not silently drop any listed commit. If one is already present in v2, note it explicitly.
procedure: Locate the v1 commits by hash in git log. Locate their target, v2/ansible/module_utils/facts.py. The v1 counterpart is lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py.

For each commit, read the v1 diff and find the matching structure in the v2 Facts class. The usual places are OSDIST_LIST, the OS_FAMILY dict, get_platform_facts, get_distribution_facts and the per-platform Hardware/Virtual subclasses.
Apply the change semantically. Do not paste whole v1 hunks. The v2 code may already differ in surrounding lines, so preserve the v2 structure.

Distribution detection: put more specific release files before generic ones in OSDIST_LIST. Example: /etc/oracle-release must come before /etc/redhat-release, because Oracle Linux also ships redhat-release.

Distribution detection: for each new release file, add a matching elif name == '...' branch. The branch reads the file with get_file_content, checks for the expected marker string, falls back to data.split()[0], and then breaks.
OS_FAMILY: match the exact casing that platform.dist() or os-release returns (for example 'openSUSE', not 'OpenSuSE'). Map derivative distros to their parent family (for example Raspbian -> Debian).
New BSD platforms: add an elif branch next to FreeBSD/OpenBSD. Set distribution, distribution_release from platform.release() and distribution_version from platform.version().
Wrap external command calls (bootinfo, lsblk and similar) in try/except or rc checks. On failure, degrade to 'Not Available' or skip the fact rather than crashing fact gathering.
New facts (uptime_seconds, machine_id, oVirt virtualization detection): add them in the same per-platform class the v1 commit used. Reuse the v2 helpers get_file_content and module.get_bin_path.
Go through the commit list in the task one item at a time. Check that each hash has a corresponding v2 change before finishing.
validation: Run python -m py_compile v2/ansible/module_utils/facts.py.
Diff the v1 and v2 facts.py for the touched sections and confirm parity for each listed commit.
Run the v2 setup module locally (or exercise Facts() in a Python shell) and check that ansible_distribution, ansible_os_family and the new facts are populated without exceptions.
Run the existing v2 unit tests if present (make tests or nosetests v2/test).

name: port-v1-subsystem-into-v2-package
negative_constraints: Do not import from v1-only modules (ansible.utils v1 helpers, ansible.callbacks) inside v2/ansible.
Do not hard-code server URIs or supported-SCM lists in the subsystem code. Read them from C.* constants.
Do not modify the v1 tree during an initial v2 port. Keep the change additive under v2/.
Do not let configuration add SCM types that the code cannot handle. Treat the config value as a blacklist or whitelist subset only.
procedure: Locate the v1 implementation (e.g. bin/ansible-galaxy and its helpers). List the responsibilities it mixes together: global state, remote API calls, and role objects.
Create a new package under v2/ansible/<subsystem>/. Put the core state class in __init__.py, for example Galaxy(options, display=None).
Make the core class keep options, the expanded paths (os.path.expanduser(options.roles_path)) and a registry dict.
Give the core class small add_role and remove_role style methods.
Split network access into its own module (api.py, class GalaxyAPI). Keep the v1 urllib2/urlparse and json handling.
Switch imports to v2 modules: ansible.errors.AnsibleError, and ansible.utils.display.Display for output.
Do not use the v1 utils or callbacks. Accept display as an injectable argument and fall back to Display() when it is None.
Move hard-coded settings into v2/ansible/constants.py with get_config(p, '<section>', '<key>', 'ANSIBLE_<ENV>', default).
Group the new settings under a comment block. For galaxy, add DEFAULT_GALAXY_URI and GALAXY_SCMS.
Declare list settings (such as GALAXY_SCMS) with islist=True and a list default.
For a list setting that acts as a whitelist, add a comment saying config can only restrict the values. Adding new values requires code changes.
Keep the GPL header and the original copyright attribution in every ported file, including files copied from v1 authors.
validation: Run python -c 'import ansible.galaxy, ansible.galaxy.api' with v2 on PYTHONPATH and confirm it imports cleanly.
Check that ansible.constants exposes DEFAULT_GALAXY_URI and GALAXY_SCMS.
Check that ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SERVER_URI and ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SCMS env vars override the defaults.
Instantiate Galaxy with a stub options object that has roles_path='~/roles'. Verify the tilde is expanded and add_role/remove_role update the dict.
Run the existing v2 unit tests (v2/test) to confirm constants loading did not regress.

name: prefer-passlib-over-crypt-with-platform-guard
negative_constraints: 不要把 passlib 改成硬依赖,不要在模块顶层无保护地 import passlib。
不要在 Darwin 上回退到 crypt.crypt,因为它会生成错误的弱哈希且不报错。
不要改变 salt 的生成方式和 hashtype 校验逻辑,也不要改变不支持的 hashtype 返回 None 的现有行为。
不要手写 hashtype 到 passlib 类的映射表,应复用 '%s_crypt' 这一命名约定。
不要直接抛裸异常,要抛 AnsibleFilterError,让用户看到清晰的 filter 错误。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/plugins/filter/core.py 中的 get_encrypted_password(password, hashtype, salt),也就是 |password_hash 过滤器的实现。
在模块顶部用 try/except 包住 import passlib.hash,并设置模块级 HAS_PASSLIB 标志。passlib 必须是可选依赖,缺失时模块仍能正常导入。
保留原有的 hashtype 校验和 salt 生成逻辑:salt 由 SystemRandom 从 ascii_letters 和 digits 中取 16 个字符。只替换真正计算哈希的那一步。
当 HAS_PASSLIB 为真时,用 getattr(passlib.hash, '%s_crypt' % hashtype) 取得对应的类,再调用 cls.encrypt(password, salt=salt)。这样 hashtype 名称(sha512、sha256、md5)可以直接映射到 passlib 的类。
当 HAS_PASSLIB 为假时,先检查 sys.platform.startswith('darwin')。如果是 Darwin,抛出 errors.AnsibleFilterError,错误信息里明确说明需要安装 passlib。原因是 Darwin 的 crypt 会静默忽略 $6$ 等前缀,只返回 DES 哈希。
非 Darwin 平台在缺少 passlib 时,沿用原有的 "$%s$%s" % (cryptmethod[hashtype], salt) 加 crypt.crypt 的回退路径,保持向后兼容。
确认 sys 已经导入,并确认 errors 引用的是 ansible.errors。
validation: 运行现有的 filter 单元测试,例如 test/units/plugins/filter。
在安装了 passlib 的环境中,验证 password_hash('secret','sha512','saltsalt') 返回以 $6$saltsalt$ 开头的字符串,且结果与 Linux 上 crypt 的输出一致。
模拟 HAS_PASSLIB=False 且 sys.platform='darwin',确认会抛出 AnsibleFilterError。
模拟 HAS_PASSLIB=False 且平台为 linux,确认仍走 crypt 路径并得到正确前缀。

name: preserve-none-in-single-var-template-shortcut
negative_constraints: 不要只改 v2 的 Templar 而遗漏 v1/ansible/utils/template.py, 两条模板路径必须同时修改。
不要在 _do_template 或 finalize 中对所有 None 做全局替换。只在整个字符串恰好是单个变量引用时保留原类型, 'foo {{ x }}' 这类拼接仍应得到字符串。
