不要在 get_config 中让 isnone 分支干扰 boolean/integer/floating/islist 等已有分支的顺序和语义。
`from types import NoneType` 只在 Python 2 中可用。若代码需兼容 Python 3, 应改用 type(None) 或 `is None`。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/template/__init__.py 中 Templar.template 的单变量快捷路径。这条路径匹配 '{{ var }}' 形式, 并直接返回 self._available_variables[var_name] 的原始值。
在快捷路径中, 紧接 isinstance(resolved_val, NON_TEMPLATED_TYPES) 分支之后, 增加对 None 的判断(isinstance NoneType 或 `is None`)。命中时直接返回 None 或可配置的空值表示, 不再进入 _do_template, 避免 Jinja2 把它渲染成字符串 'None'。

如需让空值表示可配置: 在 lib/ansible/constants.py 的 get_config 中新增 isnone 参数, 把字符串 'None' 转回 Python None。再按现有命名约定定义常量 DEFAULT_NULL_REPRESENTATION, 配置键为 null_representation, 环境变量为 ANSIBLE_NULL_REPRESENTATION, 默认值 None。Templar 中引用 C.DEFAULT_NULL_REPRESENTATION。
同步修改 v1/ansible/utils/template.py 的 template_from_string。把快捷返回的类型元组 (bool, Number) 扩展为 (bool, Number, NoneType), 使 v1 与 v2 的行为一致。
validation: 运行现有模板单测: test/units/template。
构造变量 x=None, 断言 Templar.template('{{ x }}') 返回 None, 而不是 'None'。
构造嵌套 dict, 其中某个值为 '{{ x }}', 断言模板化后该值仍为 None, 并能输出为 JSON null。
断言 'prefix {{ x }}' 仍返回字符串。

name: preserve-setup-cache-when-loading-vars-files
negative_constraints: 不要在加载 vars_files 之前把 SETUP_CACHE[host] 重置为空字典,这会抹掉 setup 模块收集到的 facts。
不要把 SETUP_CACHE[host] 替换成新的字典实例而只更新局部副本,要保持引用一致。
不要借这个修复顺手重构整个 vars 加载流程,只做最小改动。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/playbook.py 中处理 vars_files 的逐主机循环(for host in host_list),也就是读取 SETUP_CACHE 的位置。
检查是否有『先取出 cache_vars,再把 SETUP_CACHE[host] 重置为 {}』的写法。重置后,后续写入的 vars_files 变量会落到一个新字典,与 cache_vars 脱钩,setup/facts 数据就丢了。
改为复用同一个字典对象:cache_vars = SETUP_CACHE.get(host, {}),然后 SETUP_CACHE[host] = cache_vars。这样之后对 cache_vars 的 update 会原地生效,已有 facts 得以保留。
顺着该函数检查所有写回 SETUP_CACHE 的路径(按列表择一加载的 vars_files、单文件 vars_files),确认它们都更新同一个 cache_vars 对象,而不是新建字典覆盖。
如果相关改动(例如 command 模块参数解析改为 shlex posix=False)会让变量模板或参数传递依赖 facts/vars 持续存在,要确认 setup 缓存在多 play、多 vars_files 之间依然连续。
validation: 运行现有测试套件(test/ 下的 playbook 相关测试),确认通过。
写一个 playbook:先 gather facts,再用 vars_files 引用 facts 变量(例如 $ansible_hostname 风格的路径),确认变量能正确解析,facts 没有丢失。
跑多个 play 或多个 vars_files 条目,确认前一个文件加载的变量在后续步骤仍然可见。

name: quiet-doc-generator-print-only-on-error
negative_constraints: Do not remove the filename context from error reports. Move it into the error path instead of deleting it.
Do not make missing documentation fatal (sys.exit) as part of a noise-reduction change.
Do not change the options.type branches (js/json handling) or the template rendering logic.
Do not add new CLI flags unless asked. The fix is to reduce the default output, not to add a verbosity option.
procedure: Open hacking/module_formatter.py and find the per-file loop in main(). It skips .swp/.orig/.rej files and then calls ansible.utils.module_docs.get_docstring.
Find the unconditional progress print (' processing module source ---> %s'). Silence it by commenting it out or removing it, so a successful run prints nothing for each module.

Keep the filename in the output, but print it only inside the error branch (doc is None and module not in BLACKLIST_MODULES). Emit it just before the existing stderr 'CORE MODULE MISSING DOCUMENTATION' message, so the user knows which file failed.
Leave the error branch behavior as it is. It writes to stderr and does not exit; the sys.exit(1) stays commented out. Leave the BLACKLIST_MODULES exemption unchanged too.
Match the file's existing Python 2 print-statement style. Do not convert this one line to print() calls.
validation: Run `make webdocs` or `hacking/module_formatter.py` against the library directory. Confirm that no per-module 'processing' lines appear for documented modules.
Temporarily strip DOCUMENTATION from a non-blacklisted module. Confirm that the 'while processing module source ---> <file>' line and the stderr error both appear and that the run continues.
Run `python -m py_compile hacking/module_formatter.py` to check syntax.

name: raise-ansibleerror-for-user-input-errors
negative_constraints: 不要把内部编程错误 (真正的 bug、断言失败) 也改成 AnsibleError。只转换由用户输入或配置导致的错误。
不要用 try/except 吞掉异常或改成返回 None 或空列表。用户需要看到明确的错误信息。
不要更改错误消息语义或现有的合法输入解析行为。
不要引入新的异常子类层次。直接复用 ansible.errors 中现有的 AnsibleError。
不要用 `from ansible.errors import *` 之类的通配导入。
procedure: 定位: 找出把用户写错的输入 (inventory 行、host range、配置值) 报成 ValueError、TypeError、KeyError 或裸 Exception 的 raise 点。例如 lib/ansible/inventory/expand_hosts.py 中的 expand_hostname_range。
确认调用链: 检查这些异常是否一路冒泡到 CLI。CLI 只捕获 AnsibleError 并打印友好信息。其他异常类型会打出完整 traceback。
复用: 在模块顶部加 `from ansible import errors`, 沿用该时期代码库的写法。然后把用户输入校验失败的 raise 改为 `raise errors.AnsibleError("<原有消息>")`。
保留原有错误消息文本, 只改异常类型。消息里可以补充出错的输入值 (如 line), 方便用户定位。
一次替换同一函数或模块内所有同类校验点, 不要只改一处。本例同时替换了三处: bounds 数量错误、end 缺失、零填充长度不匹配。
检查调用方有没有显式 `except ValueError` 依赖旧的异常类型。如果有, 同步改为捕获 AnsibleError 或其子类。
validation: 运行现有 inventory 相关单元测试 (如 test/TestInventory.py 或 tests/units/inventory), 确认合法 range 展开结果不变。
构造非法 inventory 行, 如 `web[1:]`、`web[1:2:3]`、`web[01:100]`, 运行 ansible 或 ansible-playbook。确认输出为单行 `ERROR: ...` 而不是 Python traceback。
grep 被修改模块, 确认用户输入校验分支中已无残留的 `raise ValueError`。
确认模块 import 没有引入循环导入: 能执行 `python -c 'import ansible.inventory.expand_hosts'`。

name: rebrand-org-name-across-repo-surfaces
negative_constraints: 不要用全局 sed 把 'AnsibleWorks' 机械替换成 'Ansible', 否则公司名会丢掉 ', Inc', 文档路径也会变成 ansible.com/docs/ 这种失效链接。
不要改动 deprecated()/warning() 的版本号、removed 标志或控制流逻辑。
不要修改作者姓名、版权年份或 GPL 许可证文本。
不要在同一次改动中顺带修复无关拼写(如 'unneccessary'), 以保持 diff 聚焦。
不要替换 changelog 或历史 release notes 中的旧品牌名, 那些是历史记录。
procedure: 先全仓 grep 旧品牌字符串, 大小写不敏感, 例如 `grep -rni 'ansibleworks'`。覆盖 lib/、setup.py、docsite/conf.py 和 plugin 文件头。

按语义类别分开处理, 不要做一刀切的 sed 替换: (a) 法律实体名, 如 AUTHOR、copyright 字符串, 改用正式公司名 'Ansible, Inc'; (b) 邮箱域名, 如 [REDACTED_EMAIL] 改为 [REDACTED_EMAIL]; (c) 网站 URL, 如 http://ansibleworks.com/ 改为 http://ansible.com/; (d) 用户可见消息中的文档链接, 如 ansibleworks.com/docs/ 改为 docs.ansible.com。新地址要指向当前真实的文档站点, 不能只换域名。
替换用户可见的 warning/deprecation 消息时, 只改动 URL 和配套介词(例如 'in ... /docs/' 改为 'on docs.ansible.com')。函数调用参数保持不变, 包括版本号 '1.5' 和 removed=True。
更新 setup.py 打包元数据中的 author_email 和 url, 保持 author 继续引用 __author__ 变量。
更新 docsite/conf.py 中的 AUTHOR 和 copyright。版权年份保持原值, 不要顺手改。
只改源文件头注释里的邮箱域名。人名和版权年份范围(如 2013-2014)保留原样。
validation: 运行 `grep -rni ansibleworks lib/ setup.py docsite/conf.py`, 确认除有意保留的历史记录外不再有残留。
运行 `python setup.py --author-email --url`, 确认打包元数据输出新值。
对改动文件执行 `python -m py_compile`, 确认替换没有破坏字符串引号。
运行现有单元测试(如 `make tests`), 确认 task.py 的 deprecation 路径仍能正常工作。
可选: 构建 docsite(sphinx), 检查页脚的 copyright 和 author 显示。

name: register-modules-dir-as-plugin-package
negative_constraints: 不要写 files = files.extend(files2)。list.extend 原地修改列表并返回 None,随后 for file in files 会抛 TypeError。应写 files.extend(files2) 或 files = files + files2。
不要只加 __init__.py 而不改 PluginLoader 的 package 参数,反过来也不行。两者缺一,包路径都无法解析。
不要把其他 loader(action/connection/shell 等)的 package 参数一并改掉。只调整 module_finder。
不要在 modules/__init__.py 中放任何导入或逻辑。它必须保持为空,避免加载时产生副作用。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/utils/plugins.py 中的 PluginLoader 构造参数,顺序为 (class_name, package, config, subdir)。确认 module_finder 当前的 package 参数是否为空字符串。
让被加载的目录成为可导入的 Python 包:在 lib/ansible/modules/ 下新增空的 __init__.py。
把 module_finder 的 package 参数设为 'ansible.modules'。这样 PluginLoader 会通过包的 __file__ 解析出内置模块目录,不再只依赖 C.DEFAULT_MODULE_PATH 和 'library'。
如果模块按类别放在子目录里(例如 modules/<category>/<name>),在 _get_paths 中扫描 basedir/subdir 下的两层:先 glob '%s/*',再 glob '%s/*/*',合并结果。只把目录追加到 ret,并去重。
复用已有的 _basedirs 和 realpath 逻辑,以及 'file not in ret' 去重方式,不要另写一套路径搜索。
validation: 运行现有单元测试,至少包括 test/units 中涉及 PluginLoader 和 module_finder 的用例。
运行 python -c 'import ansible.modules' 确认可以导入。
检查 module_finder._get_paths() 返回值:应包含 ansible/modules 目录及其一级子目录,且不抛异常。
对一个位于子目录中的内置模块调用 module_finder.find_plugin('<name>'),确认能找到。

name: relax-ansible-module-option-choices
negative_constraints: 不要只改 argument_spec 而漏掉 DOCUMENTATION 的 choices。两者不一致会导致文档校验 (validate-modules) 失败, 也会误导用户。
不要把 choices 换成另一份扩充后的白名单。这个修复的意图是取消限制, 不是追加枚举值。
不要改动同一模块中其他选项的 choices (例如 body_format、follow_redirects), 它们仍然是合法的有限枚举。
不要修改 default 值或 required 语义, 以保持向后兼容。
procedure: 定位模块文件 (例如 lib/ansible/modules/network/basics/uri.py), 找到受限的选项。该选项在两处声明: DOCUMENTATION YAML 的 options 段, 以及 main() 里 AnsibleModule argument_spec 的 dict(...)。
在 argument_spec 中只删除该选项的 choices=[...] 参数。保留 required 和 default 等其他属性不变, 例如 method = dict(required=False, default='GET')。
同步删除 DOCUMENTATION 中该选项的 choices: [...] 行。保留 description、required、default, 让文档与 argument_spec 一致。
检查模块后续代码有没有依赖这个白名单的逻辑。比如按 method 判断是否发送 body, 或对 HEAD 做特殊处理。确认任意字符串 (例如 WebDAV 的 PROPFIND/MKCOL, 或自定义动词) 能直接透传给底层请求函数 (fetch_url/open_url), 不会在别处被拒绝。
如果底层对大小写敏感, 考虑在文档 description 中说明值会原样传递, 或保持现有的大小写处理方式。不要在这次改动里引入新的规范化行为。

keywords: value of X must be one of

validation: 运行 ansible-test sanity --test validate-modules 或仓库对应的模块文档校验, 确认 DOCUMENTATION 与 argument_spec 一致。
运行现有的 uri 集成测试或单元测试 (test/integration/targets/uri), 确认 GET/POST 等原有方法的行为不变。
手动或在测试中用一个非标准方法 (例如 method=PROPFIND) 调用模块, 确认不再报 'value of method must be one of' 错误, 并且请求实际发出了该方法。

name: relax-dict-isinstance-to-mutablemapping-in-vars
negative_constraints: 不要直接删除类型检查或断言, 要放宽检查条件, 而不是去掉校验。
不要使用 Mapping 代替 MutableMapping, 因为下游合并逻辑会修改或复制这些映射, 只读映射会破坏这一点。
不要修改 AnsibleError 的错误信息或对外的报错行为, 该信息保持原文 ("expected dicts")。
不要把整个代码库里所有的 isinstance(x, dict) 都改掉, 只修改阻碍 dict-like 变量的那几处检查。
不要在没有对应需求的情况下顺便加 changelog 或改动测试, 本次维护面只涉及 code。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/vars/__init__.py 中 VariableManager 的类型检查: set_extra_vars 里的 assert isinstance(value, dict), 以及 _validate_both_dicts 里的 isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict)。
确认失败的原因: 传入的是 dict-like 映射对象 (自定义 Mapping 或包装类), 它不是 dict 子类, 所以被这些检查拒绝。
在模块顶部导入 MutableMapping, 方式与该文件现有写法一致 (from collections import MutableMapping, 和 defaultdict 的导入放在一起)。
把这些检查里的 dict 替换为 MutableMapping, 让所有实现了可变映射协议的对象都能通过检查。
检查通过检查之后代码用到了哪些方法 (例如 value.copy()), 确认目标映射类型提供这些方法。MutableMapping 本身不定义 copy, 如果调用方的类型可能缺少它, 要记录这个前提或增加保护。
在同一模块里搜索其他用来保护变量合并或校验路径的 isinstance(x, dict) 检查, 只有它们处在同一条失败路径上时才一并统一修改。
validation: 运行现有单元测试: test/units/vars 以及 VariableManager 相关测试。
手动检查: 构造一个实现了 copy() 的 MutableMapping 子类 (非 dict), 传给 VariableManager.set_extra_vars, 确认不再触发 AssertionError。
手动检查: 用 dict-like 参数调用 _validate_both_dicts / _combine_vars, 确认不会抛出 AnsibleError; 传入非映射类型 (如 list) 时仍然抛出 AnsibleError。
确认 MutableMapping 的导入在本仓库支持的 Python 版本下可用。

name: remote-python-snippet-py24-compat
negative_constraints: 不要在远端执行的 Python 片段或模块里用 with 语句及其他 2.5+ 语法，即使注释写着 'Python > 2.4' 也不行。这些字符串会交给任意版本的远端解释器去跑。
不要只改 lib/ansible/runner 或只改 v2 其中一份，重复的 shell 插件必须同步修改。
不要删掉 2.4 的 `import sha` 回退分支，也不要改变 csums 列表的顺序和 `2>/dev/null` 的静默失败语义。
不要往 single-quoted shell 字符串里加入未转义的单引号。
procedure: 先定位要在 managed node 上用 `python -c` 执行的内联 Python 代码。重点看 lib/ansible/runner/shell_plugins/sh.py 和 v2/ansible/plugins/shell/sh.py 里 checksum() 的 csums 列表。
逐项检查这些内联代码用到的语法和库，确认 Python 2.4 都支持。远端解释器可能是 2.4，所以下面这些都不能出现：with 语句（2.5 起要 __future__，2.6 才默认）、条件表达式 `x if c else y`、try/except/finally 合并写法、`except E as e`、新式 format、b'' 字面量。
把 `with open(...) as f:` 改成显式写法：先 `f = open(...)`，然后顺序读取，最后 `f.close()`。内联代码要压平成顶层语句，这样缩进层级最少。

核对 `
` 和 `	` 转义后的缩进。while 循环体里只能有一层 `	`，而且不能留下多余的空行（原来的 `


` 已经去掉）。
代码必须同时能在 Python 3 下运行。保留 hashlib 分支作为首选（适用于 >2.4 和 py3），保留 `import sha` 分支作为 2.4 的回退。
把同样的修改同步到 v1 runner 和 v2 plugins 两份重复的 sh.py，两份要保持字节一致。
validation: 在本地展开格式化后的命令字符串，分别用 python2.4（或 2.4 语法检查）、python2.7、python3 执行，确认输出的 sha1 一致，并且与 `sha1sum` 的结果相同。
用 diff 比较 lib/ansible/runner/shell_plugins/sh.py 和 v2/ansible/plugins/shell/sh.py，确认 csums 部分完全一致。
运行现有单元测试，以及涉及 checksum/stat/copy 的集成测试。

name: remove-inventoryless-host-override-path
negative_constraints: Do not keep a code path that creates Host objects outside the inventory parsers. Such hosts silently lose group membership and host variables.
Do not change the order of parser selection (script, then YAML '---', then INI).
Do not mix tabs and spaces in the edited methods. The original diff introduced tabs in restrict_to, which is a Python indentation hazard. Use 4-space indentation consistently.
Do not leave a dangling --override-hosts CLI flag that now raises the 'host list must be a path' exception.
procedure: Locate Inventory.__init__ in lib/ansible/inventory.py. Find every branch that builds hosts from a raw Python list instead of from an inventory source. In this case that is the `type(host_list) == list` branch and the `_groups_from_override_hosts` helper.

Make the constructor accept only a path. Add a type check (str or unicode) and raise a clear exception for anything else, such as a list. This keeps hosts without inventory variables from appearing in the 'all' group.

Keep the existing source dispatch and only flatten it. If the path is executable, use InventoryScript. If the file content starts with '---', use InventoryParserYaml. Otherwise use InventoryParser. Every branch sets self.groups = parser.groups.values().

Delete the override helper (_groups_from_override_hosts). Then grep playbook.py and the CLI entrypoints (bin/ansible-playbook) for the --override-hosts option and for callers that pass a host list. Remove those or reroute them.

Re-express the 'run against a subset' need through the restriction API on real inventory hosts. Callers use restrict_to(list) and lift_restriction(). Add a get_restriction() accessor so playbook code can read the current restriction, instead of rebuilding the inventory with fake hosts.
Check that get_hosts pattern matching still respects self._restriction after the change.
validation: Run the existing test suite (e.g. `make tests` / nosetests over test/), especially the inventory and playbook tests.
Construct Inventory with an INI file, a YAML file and an executable script. Assert that list_groups() and list_hosts() work for each.
Assert that Inventory(['host1']) raises an exception.
Call restrict_to(['host1']), then check get_hosts('all') and get_restriction(). Call lift_restriction() and confirm all hosts are returned again.
Grep for 'override_hosts' and '_groups_from_override_hosts' and confirm there are no remaining references.

name: resolve-play-hosts-through-inventory-before-task-run
negative_constraints: Do not pass the raw _play_hosts pattern directly to restrict_to or _trim_unavailable_hosts. Unresolved patterns can expand to all inventory hosts.
Do not special-case handlers in the Runner as the fix. Fix host resolution at the shared _run_task_internal entry point.
Do not change the inventory.restrict_to semantics globally just to handle this bug.
procedure: Locate PlayBook._run_task_internal in lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py. This is the shared path for normal tasks and handlers.
Check the type of task.play._play_hosts. It can be a pattern or a raw host list. It is not always a resolved list of host names.
Before passing play hosts to _trim_unavailable_hosts or inventory.restrict_to, resolve them with self.inventory.list_hosts(...). This keeps the restriction on concrete host names.
Keep the existing order: resolve, then trim unavailable or failed hosts, then restrict the inventory, then construct the Runner.
For handler code paths, confirm that each handler's host set still matches the hosts that notified it. The restriction must not widen to the whole inventory.
If you add a regression check, use an inventory with hosts outside the play. Notify a handler on a subset of hosts and assert it ran only on those hosts.
validation: Run the existing unit tests (test/units) for playbook and inventory.
Run an integration playbook with hosts outside the play pattern. Notify a handler from a subset of hosts and verify through output or created files that it ran only on those hosts.
Verify that ordinary tasks still run on every host in the play and skip failed or unreachable hosts.

name: restore-missing-referenced-module-file
negative_constraints: 不要为了消除 ImportError 去改调用方的 import 或删掉调用代码。要补的是缺失的文件本身。
不要擅自改变已有调用方依赖的常量字符串，例如 '#<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_COMMON>>' 这类占位标记。模块文件里写的就是这些字面量。
不要在新文件里引入与仓库约定不一致的依赖或 import 风格。
不要把半成品选项静默接受后又不起作用，未实现的参数要显式标 TODO。
procedure: 从 ImportError、traceback 或最近提交里的 import 语句入手，确认缺的是哪个模块。本例中，runner 等调用方引用了 ansible.module_common.ModuleReplacer，但对应文件没有提交。
用 grep 找出所有引用点，例如 'from ansible.module_common import' 和 'ModuleReplacer('，列出调用方实际用到的类名、方法名、常量名（REPLACER、REPLACER_ARGS、REPLACER_LANG、REPLACER_COMPLEX）以及它们的签名。
在调用方期望的路径新建文件，这里是 lib/ansible/module_common.py。文件头沿用仓库统一的 GPLv3 版权模板。import 顺序与其他文件保持一致：先 python/第三方依赖，再 ansible 内部的 errors、utils、constants。
实现时只提供调用方需要的公开接口，保证名字、参数和返回值与引用处完全一致。例如：构造函数 strip_comments=False；_find_snippet_imports(module_data, module_path) 返回模板化后的输出和 module_style（old / new / non_native_want_json）。
如果新文件要按相对自身的路径定位资源目录（如 module_utils/ 下的 snippet），用 os.path.dirname(inspect.getfile(...)) 计算路径，不要依赖当前工作目录。
对不支持的用法给出明确报错，统一抛 errors.AnsibleError，消息里写清期望格式。例如 import 必须写成 'from ansible.module_utils.basic import *'。
确认打包配置（setup.py 的 packages/package_data、MANIFEST.in）能包含新文件和它依赖的资源目录。
validation: 运行 python -c 'import ansible.module_common'，确认可以正常导入。
运行现有测试套件（如 make tests / nosetests test/），确认原先因缺文件失败的 runner 和模块传输相关测试已通过。
执行一个 ad-hoc 命令（如 ansible localhost -m ping -c local），验证 new-style 模块的 snippet 注入和参数替换端到端可用。
用 git status 确认新文件已被跟踪并包含在提交中。

name: restore-module-replacer-after-accidental-revert
negative_constraints: Do not reintroduce the monolithic BSD snippet into module_common.py; it belongs in module_utils.
Do not drop the quote characters from the REPLACER_* argument placeholders.
Do not force modules back to the old '#<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_COMMON>>' style only. Keep supporting the pythonic import style while leaving REPLACER available for backwards compatibility.
Do not fix this by reverting unrelated template changes. Restore only the clobbered file or hunks.
procedure: Open lib/ansible/module_common.py and check its current content. Look for these signs that an old version came back during a template or merge change: the file is again the BSD-licensed embedded snippet (a large module boilerplate block), and the ModuleReplacer class plus its imports (StringIO, inspect, os, shlex, ansible.errors/utils/constants) are gone.
Use git log -p on the file to find the last good revision, meaning the one that contains ModuleReplacer. Restore that whole file content. Do not rewrite it by hand.

Make sure the REPLACER_ARGS, REPLACER_LANG and REPLACER_COMPLEX constants contain the embedded double quotes, e.g. "\"<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_ARGS>>\"". Module source carries these placeholders as quoted string literals, so a constant without the quotes leaves stray quotes behind after substitution.

Keep the GPL header for module_common.py. The BSD-licensed shared code belongs in lib/ansible/module_utils/*.py. Those files are what gets inlined when a module does 'from ansible.module_utils.basic import *'.
Confirm that module_utils/basic.py (and any other module_utils files) still exist and hold the shared AnsibleModule code. Without them, the replacer has nothing to inline.
Grep the callers (runner/__init__.py and similar) for references to module_common symbols such as ModuleReplacer and modify_module. Check that each referenced symbol exists in the restored file.
validation: Run the existing unit tests (e.g. make tests / nosetests test/).

Run a module that uses 'from ansible.module_utils.basic import *' (e.g. ansible localhost -m ping or -m command -a 'echo hi'). Check that the transferred module has the code inlined and the arguments substituted.
Run a legacy module that still uses '#<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_COMMON>>' and check that it still works.
Run python -c 'import ansible.module_common' to confirm the restored imports load.

name: restrict-permissions-on-lookup-secret-files
negative_constraints: 不要只修首次创建的分支而漏掉 salt 补加和移除时的重写分支,每个写文件的地方都必须 chmod。
不要把 chmod 放在 write 之后,否则会留下一个文件内容已写入但权限仍宽松的窗口。
不要用 0644/0755 这类宽松权限,也不要依赖进程 umask。
不要静默吞掉 makedirs 的错误,必须转换成 AnsibleError 并给出可读的错误信息。
不要顺带改动密码生成逻辑、字符集或文件内容格式。
procedure: 在 lib/ansible/runner/lookup_plugins/password.py(或其他会把密钥、密码写到本地磁盘的 lookup/plugin)中,找出所有创建目录和写文件的代码路径。要覆盖每一个 open(path,'w') 分支:首次生成、重新生成时补加 salt、移除 salt 时的重写。
调用 os.makedirs(pathdir, mode=0700) 创建父目录,让新目录只有属主能访问。
用 try/except OSError 包住 makedirs,出错时抛出 errors.AnsibleError,错误信息要写明失败的路径和原始错误文本,不要让原始 traceback 直接冒出来。
在每个 open(path,'w') 块里、写入密钥内容之前,调用 os.chmod(path, 0600)。更早写出密钥的只有初次生成那一个分支,但所有重写分支都要统一处理,确保旧文件也会被收紧权限。
沿用仓库现有的 Python2 写法(八进制字面量 0700/0600,'except OSError, e' 语法)和 errors.AnsibleError 的风格。
可选:在 password lookup 的集成测试里加上断言,检查生成文件的权限是 0600、父目录是 0700。
validation: 运行现有的 lookup 单元测试和集成测试(test/integration 中 lookups 相关的 role)。
手动执行 lookup('password', '/tmp/newdir/pw'),然后 stat 检查:目录应为 0700,文件应为 0600。
先删掉 salt 再用 encrypt 参数调用,触发重写分支后确认文件仍是 0600。
在不可写的位置运行,确认抛出的是带路径信息的 AnsibleError,而不是原始 OSError。

name: revert-distribution-name-normalization-in-get-distribution
negative_constraints: Do not truncate or split distribution names inside get_distribution(). Downstream subclass dispatch and fact consumers depend on the full capitalized name.
Do not touch the /etc/system-release or Amazon fallback logic while reverting.
Do not add a different normalization in the same revert commit. Propose any alternative fix separately, scoped to the specific platform.
Do not change the get_distribution_version() or platform.system() branching.
procedure: Locate get_distribution() in lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py. Find the Linux branch that calls platform.linux_distribution()[0].capitalize().

Identify the normalization that was added after the capitalize() call, for example `if " " in distribution: distribution = distribution.split()[0]`. Remove only those lines and restore the original assignment.
Keep the fallback chain after it unchanged. This covers the /etc/system-release check with supported_dists=['system'] and the 'Amazon' special-case.

Check what reads the distribution string. Callers such as the facts and service/user/hostname platform subclasses match on distribution names. Multi-word names (e.g. 'Red hat enterprise linux', 'Linuxmint'-style values) must keep the form those callers expect.
Make the revert a single, minimal change that mirrors the original commit exactly, with a 'This reverts commit <sha>' message.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for module_utils/basic (e.g. test/units/module_utils) and confirm they pass.
Mock platform.linux_distribution to return a multi-word name (e.g. ('Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server','7','')). Confirm get_distribution() returns the full capitalized string.
Mock an empty linux_distribution together with a present /etc/system-release. Confirm the Amazon fallback still returns 'Amazon'.
Grep the code for comparisons against distribution names and confirm that none of them rely on first-word truncation.

name: revert-signature-change-across-all-callers
negative_constraints: Do not change only the function definition and miss any callers. A leftover old/new mismatch causes a TypeError or a shifted argument at runtime, with vars being treated as the text.
Do not simply take one side of the conflict blocks wholesale. That can lose unrelated fixes from later commits.
Do not keep tests that depend on the reverted feature, and do not keep tests that call with the wrong number of arguments.
Do not change the order of basedir handling in path_dwim. It remains a separate step that runs after templating.
procedure: Locate the target commit (here bf47bb47) and list every function whose signature it changed. In this case utils.template gained a leading `basedir` parameter.

Run `grep -rn "utils.template(\|template(" lib/ test/` across the whole repository to enumerate every call site. Do not rely on the files listed in the original diff, because commits made after the target may have added new callers that use the new signature.
Restore the old signature `template(text, vars)` in lib/ansible/utils.py. Remove the include-through-variable logic that depended on basedir.

Change every caller back to the old form, removing the basedir argument. The callers to check are playbook/__init__.py (handler notify), play.py (hosts, user, include tokens and include_file, vars_files with and without host / SETUP_CACHE), and the runner/module_vars paths.
Resolve the conflicts in utils.py and test/TestUtils.py by hand. Keep unrelated changes that later commits introduced, and roll back only the semantics of the target commit.
Update the tests in test/TestUtils.py to match: remove the basedir argument from the template calls, and delete the test cases that cover the reverted feature.
validation: Run the existing tests, e.g. `nosetests test/TestUtils.py test/TestPlayBook.py`.
Grep to confirm that no `template(self.basedir` / `template(basedir` / `template(play.basedir` calls remain.
Run a playbook that contains include, vars_files and notify, and confirm that variable substitution in paths still works.

name: safe-chmod-on-symlinks-without-lchmod
negative_constraints: Do not call os.chmod on a symlink path without restoring the target's mode. That silently changes the permissions of the target file.
Do not swallow all OSErrors. Only EPERM (on links), ENOENT and ELOOP may be ignored.
Do not use the raw st_mode when restoring. Pass it through stat.S_IMODE.
procedure: In set_mode_if_different, test for lchmod with `hasattr(os, 'lchmod')` rather than `'lchmod' in dir(os)`. If it exists, call os.lchmod(path, mode).
If lchmod is missing and the path is not a link (os.path.islink is false), call os.chmod as before.
If lchmod is missing and the path is a symlink, follow these steps:
- Record the underlying stat with os.stat(path).
- Attempt os.chmod(path, mode).
- Re-stat the path.
- If st_mode changed, restore it with os.chmod(path, stat.S_IMODE(old.st_mode)) so the target file is not modified.
Widen the OSError handler: ignore EPERM on links, and ignore errno.ENOENT and errno.ELOOP, which come from broken or looping symlinks. Re-raise every other error.
validation: Create a file at mode 0644 and a symlink to it. On a platform without lchmod, run set_mode_if_different on the link with mode 0600, then check that the target is still 0644.
Create a broken symlink and a self-referencing symlink. Confirm that neither raises an error.
Run the existing module_utils tests.

name: sanitize-password-charset-after-expansion
negative_constraints: 不要只在用户输入 token 上做字符过滤；getattr(string, ...) 展开的命名字符类会重新引入被禁字符。
不要改变 ',,' 表示字面逗号的转义语义。
不要把引号过滤扩大到其他标点，避免无谓降低密码熵或改变既有行为。
不要改动已存在密码文件的读取逻辑；过滤只作用于新生成的密码。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/runner/lookup_plugins/password.py。分两段看：一段解析 'chars=' 参数，生成 use_chars 列表；另一段用 getattr(string, c, c) 把这些名字展开成最终字符集 chars。
找出有问题的字符从哪里来。错误是随机出现的，说明坏字符在展开之后才进入字符集。例如 string.punctuation 自带 " 和 '，所以在解析参数时去引号拦不住它们。
把清理逻辑移到最终字符集拼接之后，例如：chars = ''.join(getattr(string, c, c) for c in use_chars).replace('"', '').replace("'", '')。这样无论字符来自字面值还是命名字符类，都会被过滤。
删除解析阶段原有的引号替换，让参数解析只负责拆分 token：保留 ',,' 转义为字面逗号的处理，再按 ',' split。
确认 random.choice(chars) 之前 chars 不会变成空串。如果用户只给了引号字符，应当给出明确报错。
validation: 运行现有测试：test/units 中与 lookup 或 password 相关的用例。
手动执行 lookup('password', '/tmp/x chars=ascii_letters,digits,punctuation length=200') 多次，确认生成的密码不含 " 和 '。
验证 chars=',,' 仍会生成含逗号的字符集，chars=digits 仍只产生数字。
验证 encrypt 路径仍能正常生成 salt 和加密值。

name: scope-available-hosts-to-play-pattern
negative_constraints: 不要只修 setup 步骤而漏掉 vars_files 导入和 task 循环中的调用点。三处不一致会让 facts、vars 和 tasks 作用于不同的主机集合。
不要在 helper 内部硬编码 play 引用或改变它的默认无参语义,其他调用方可能依赖全量列表。
不要绕过 inventory.list_hosts 自己做 pattern 匹配,否则 --limit、restriction 和 subset 语义会丢失。
不要移除对 stats.failures 和 stats.dark 的过滤。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py 中的 PlayBook._list_available_hosts。它会从 inventory 里过滤掉 failed 和 dark 主机。
确认回归点:inventory.list_hosts() 不带参数时返回全部主机。如果早先有提交(如 9070875)把 restriction 或 pattern 逻辑移出了 inventory,调用方又没传 pattern,play 就会作用到所有主机。
让 helper 透传参数:_list_available_hosts(self, *args) 调用 self.inventory.list_hosts(*args)。不带参数的调用行为保持不变,向后兼容。

复用 play.hosts 作为 pattern。在每个按 play 计算主机的位置都改为 self._list_available_hosts(play.hosts),包括 _do_setup_step(fact gathering)、_run_play 中传给 play.update_vars_files 的 all_hosts,以及每个 serial batch/task 循环里重新计算的 host_list。
全局 grep _list_available_hosts 和 list_hosts( 的所有调用点,逐个判断语义是"整个 inventory"还是"当前 play"。只有当前 play 范围的调用点才传 play.hosts。
validation: 运行现有 playbook 和 inventory 单元测试(test/TestPlayBook.py、TestInventory.py)。
构造一个含多组主机的 inventory,让 play 的 hosts 只匹配其中一组。确认 setup、vars_files 和 tasks 只在该组上执行。
带 --limit 运行,确认 limit 与 play pattern 取交集。
在 serial 模式下让某主机失败,确认后续 batch 仍只包含 play 范围内且未失败的主机。

name: solaris-derivative-distribution-detection
negative_constraints: Do not write self.fact. The dict attribute is self.facts. The accepted diff contains this typo, which raises AttributeError on every non-Oracle Solaris host. Always re-read attribute names in new branches.
Do not index uname output or use it as the version without checking the run_command return code.
Do not break the loop before the derivative checks. Do not let the derivative block run on Oracle Solaris, which already broke out earlier.
Do not invent a new file-reading or command helper. Reuse get_file_content and module.run_command.
Do not change platform.dist()-based detection for Linux distributions while touching this block.
procedure: Locate the Solaris branch of Facts.get_distribution_facts in lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py. It is the OSDIST_LIST entry for /etc/release, where name == 'Solaris'.
Read the release text once with the existing get_file_content(path) helper. Keep the existing Oracle Solaris prefix handling ('Oracle Solaris') and its break unchanged, and leave it first.
After the Oracle check, add substring checks on the release data. Map 'SmartOS' to SmartOS, 'OpenIndiana' to OpenIndiana and 'OmniOS' to OmniOS.
Some derivatives are only identifiable from the kernel. Call module.run_command(['uname','-v']), check rc == 0, then look for markers in stdout such as 'NexentaOS_' for NexentaStor.
For the recognized derivatives, set distribution_release to the stripped first line of /etc/release.
Set distribution_version from the first line of uname -v output, but only when rc == 0.
Break out of the OSDIST_LIST loop only after setting facts, so later entries do not overwrite them.

When adding architecture normalization, extend the existing class-level regex (_I386RE) rather than adding new branches. For example, i([3456]86|86pc) maps the Solaris 'i86pc' machine type to the i386 family. Add a comment explaining the platform-specific value.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for module_utils facts (test/units).
Mock /etc/release content for SmartOS, OpenIndiana and OmniOS.
Mock uname -v returning a 'NexentaOS_...' string, and also a non-zero rc.
For each case, assert the distribution, distribution_release and distribution_version facts.
Assert that Oracle Solaris release text still yields the original version and release values.
Run python -m pyflakes or compile the file to catch attribute or name typos such as self.fact.
Verify that machine 'i86pc' normalizes to the i386 architecture fact.

name: solaris-variant-distribution-version-parsing
negative_constraints: 不要删除 uname -v 回退路径, 未覆盖的变体(如 OpenIndiana)仍依赖它。
不要在 /etc/product 不存在或缺少 Image 键时抛异常, 必须用存在性检查保护。
不要修改 distribution_release 的语义, 它仍是 /etc/release 的 strip 内容。
不要把变体专有逻辑扩散到 Oracle Solaris 原生分支或其他 OS 分支。
不要用 split(':') 解析 /etc/product, 值中可能含冒号, 应使用 split(': ', 1)。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py 中 Facts 类的 distribution 检测循环, 找到解析 /etc/release 的 Solaris 分支。该分支已有 data(release 文件内容)和 uname -v 的结果(uname_rc/uname_out)。
在各变体的 if/elif 判断之前, 先初始化局部变量 distribution_version = None。
在每个变体分支内按该变体的实际版本来源取值, 只在能可靠拿到时才赋值:
SmartOS: 当 os.path.exists('/etc/product') 为真时, 用 get_file_content 读取它。按 ': ' 做 split(': ', 1) 解析成 dict, 只处理包含 ': ' 的行。如果存在 'Image' 键, 取其值 split() 后的最后一个 token 作为版本。
OmniOS: 取 data.split()[-1] 作为版本。
Nexenta: 在 uname_rc == 0 且 uname_out 含 'NexentaOS_' 的分支中, 取 data.split()[-1].lstrip('v') 作为版本。
OpenIndiana: 无可靠的专有来源, 保持 None, 走回退逻辑。
在统一的赋值块中, distribution_release 仍设为 data.strip()。distribution_version 优先使用变体专有值; 只有它为 None 且 uname_rc == 0 时, 才回退到 uname_out.split('\n')[0].strip()。
顺手检查并修正同一代码块中 self.fact 与 self.facts 的属性名笔误。该笔误会让这个分支在运行时抛出 AttributeError。
validation: 运行 python -m py_compile lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py, 确认语法正确。
用 mock 提供 SmartOS、OmniOS、Nexenta、OpenIndiana 各自的 /etc/release 样本, 以及 SmartOS 的 /etc/product 样本, 断言 distribution 和 distribution_version 符合预期。
验证 /etc/product 缺失时, SmartOS 回退到 uname -v 的结果。
确认已经没有 self.fact[ 这种拼写残留。
运行现有的 facts 单元测试(test/units 下 facts 相关), 确保无回归。

name: split-compound-bailout-condition-in-playbook-loop
negative_constraints: Do not change the bail-out semantics. The rewritten code must set host_list=None in exactly the same cases as the original OR-condition.
Do not add new helper modules or config options for a formatting fix. Keep the change local to the loop.
Do not keep backslash continuations or deeply nested parentheses with odd indentation. Prefer sequential simple ifs.
Do not change the int() truncation or the /100.0 float division in the threshold formula.
procedure: Locate the multi-line `if ( ... or ... ):` in `PlayBook._run_play`, in the per-task loop after `host_list = self._list_available_hosts(play.hosts)`. Its parenthesized conditions are hard to read and badly indented.
Identify each disjunct of the condition. Here they are `task.any_errors_fatal and len(host_list) < hosts_count` and the max-fail-percentage threshold check.

Check whether one disjunct is a special case of the other. any_errors_fatal means a 0% failure tolerance, so `(hosts_count - len(host_list)) > int(0/100.0 * hosts_count)` reduces to `len(host_list) < hosts_count`.
Rewrite the special case as its own short `if` that normalizes the parameter (`play.max_fail_pct = 0`). Give it a comment explaining the intent.
Keep a single one-line threshold `if` that performs the shared action (`host_list = None`). The downstream `if not host_list` drop-out logic stays unchanged.
Keep the original side effect and its order: decide `host_list = None` before the 'no hosts remain' check.
validation: Run the existing unit tests (e.g. test/units for playbook) and confirm they pass.

Manually reason or table-test the cases: any_errors_fatal true with one failed host means bail; any_errors_fatal false with failures under max_fail_pct means continue; failures over max_fail_pct means bail.
Run pyflakes/pep8 on lib/ansible/playbook/__init__.py to confirm the formatting is clean.

name: ssh-become-password-error-detection-per-method
negative_constraints: 不要只针对 sudo 硬编码失败字符串,su、pbrun 等方法的失败消息各不相同。
不要在 prompt 为空时执行 endswith(prompt) 判断,空串匹配会恒为真并导致误报。
不要在 BECOME_METHODS 里加入方法却不在 BECOME_ERROR_STRINGS 里加对应键。
procedure: 定位 ssh.py 中 _communicate/exec 循环里 'fail early if the become password is wrong' 的分支。
在 constants.py 里保留 BECOME_METHODS 列表,并在它旁边增加或复用 BECOME_ERROR_STRINGS 字典。字典按 become_method 映射各方法的认证失败消息,例如 sudo 为 'Sorry, try again.',su 为 'Authentication failure'。没有已知消息的方法映射为空串。
检测时调用 gettext.dgettext(self.runner.become_method, C.BECOME_ERROR_STRINGS[self.runner.become_method]) 取得本地化后的失败字符串。gettext domain 用实际的 become_method,不要硬编码成 'Privilege Escalation'。
把检测逻辑嵌套在 `if prompt:` 之内。这样 prompt 为空时,不会把以 '\r\n' 结尾的输出误判为失败。
在 prompt 分支内先处理已提供 become_pass 的情况:stdout 以 '<err>\r\n<prompt>' 结尾时,抛出 'Incorrect become password'。
其余情况的判断顺序:stdout 以 prompt 结尾时抛出 'Missing become password';以 err+prompt 结尾时抛出 'Incorrect become password'。顺手修正错误消息中的拼写(例如 'becom')。
新增 become 方法时,必须同步在 BECOME_METHODS 和 BECOME_ERROR_STRINGS 中加入对应键,否则查字典会抛 KeyError。
validation: 运行 test/units 下的现有单元测试(make tests 或 nosetests test/units)。
手动或用 mock 验证三种情况:sudo 密码错误报 Incorrect,未提供密码报 Missing,prompt 为空时不报错。
确认 BECOME_METHODS 中的每个方法在 BECOME_ERROR_STRINGS 中都有对应键。

name: ssh-plugin-conditional-user-option
negative_constraints: 不要删除 User 选项的传递。当 remote_user 与本地用户不同时,仍必须用 -o User= 传给 ssh,否则会破坏现有功能。
不要用 os.getlogin() 或 USER/LOGNAME 环境变量代替 pwd.getpwuid(os.geteuid())。前者在无 tty、sudo 或 cron 下不可靠,而且要和 ssh 实际以哪个有效用户运行保持一致。
不要改 paramiko 等其他连接插件,也不要改 constants 里 DEFAULT_REMOTE_USER 的默认值。本修复只针对 ssh 插件的参数组装。
不要自己解析 ~/.ssh/config 来判断是否覆盖,直接把决定权交给 ssh 本身。
procedure: 打开 lib/ansible/runner/connection_plugins/ssh.py,找到 Connection.connect() 里组装 self.common_args 的位置(在 ControlMaster/KbdInteractive 等 '-o' 选项之后、ConnectTimeout 之前)。
确认无条件追加 ['-o', 'User='+self.user] 的那一行就是根因。ssh 的命令行 -o 优先级高于 ~/.ssh/config,所以这行会盖掉用户在 config 里为该 Host 设置的 User。
在文件顶部加 'import pwd',与现有的 os、pipes、random、select、fcntl 等 stdlib import 放在一起。
用 pwd.getpwuid(os.geteuid())[0] 取当前有效用户名。只在 self.user 与它不同时追加 ['-o', 'User='+self.user];相同时省略,交给 ssh 用默认用户或 .ssh/config 里的值。
其余 common_args 的顺序和内容保持不变,尤其是 ConnectTimeout 必须照常追加。这样显式指定了非本地用户的现有调用行为不变。
validation: 运行现有测试套件(如 make tests / nosetests test/),确认 ssh 插件可以正常导入,没有 NameError(比如漏了 import pwd 或 os)。
手动验证:remote_user 等于本地用户时,用 -vvv 查看生成的 ssh 命令,确认不含 'User='。此时 ~/.ssh/config 里为该 Host 配置的 User 应该生效。
手动验证:remote_user 与本地用户不同时,ssh 命令仍包含 '-o User=<remote_user>',且 ConnectTimeout 仍然存在。

name: suppress-old-module-version-added-in-doc-formatter
negative_constraints: Do not drop or relax the hard error when a module has no version_added at all.
Do not apply the threshold to option-level version_added fields. The task covers only the top-level module attribution.
Do not compare version strings lexically, and do not call float() on the raw value. A value like '1.2.3' fails float(), and string comparison misorders versions such as '10.0' and '9.0'.
Do not edit individual module DOCUMENTATION blocks to remove version_added. Do the filtering in the formatter so the source metadata stays accurate.
Do not change the template files. Deleting the key is enough because the templates already render conditionally.
procedure: Open hacking/module_formatter.py. Find the main() loop that loads each module's doc through ansible.utils.module_docs. The check that errors out when version_added is missing is in this loop.

Add a named module-level constant near the imports, for example TO_OLD_TO_BE_NOTABLE = 1.0. Put a comment above it explaining that modules added before this version are assumed to be present in every installation people still run.
Keep the existing missing-version_added error and exit as they are. Keep the 'historical' handling as well: when the value is 'historical', delete doc['version_added'].

For any other value, capture the raw value. Normalize it to major.minor with str(value).split('.') and join the first two tokens. This turns the YAML float 0.9 and strings like '1.2.3' into '0.9' and '1.2'.
Convert the normalized major.minor to float and compare it with the threshold. If it is below the threshold, delete doc['version_added'] so the templates render no 'added in' line.
Change only the top-level doc['version_added']. Leave per-option version_added entries in doc['options'] untouched.
validation: Run hacking/module_formatter.py for each template type (e.g. rst, man) against library/. Confirm it finishes without errors.
Check that a module with version_added 0.x shows no 'added in' line, and that a module with version_added >= 1.0 still shows it.
Check that a module marked 'historical' still renders without the line.
Check that a three-part version such as '1.2.1' does not crash the float conversion.
Check that a module with no version_added still triggers the existing error exit.

name: suse-distribution-facts-line-anchored-parsing
negative_constraints: Do not take the first line of os-release with split('=')[1] as the distribution name. Line order is not guaranteed, and the value keeps its quotes.
Do not apply the openSUSE PRETTY_NAME codename regex to SLES. SLES has no codename, so distribution_release would come out wrong or be left unset.
Do not use unanchored regexes on the whole file content. NAME= also matches PRETTY_NAME= and CPE_NAME=.
Do not change detection logic for non-SUSE distributions in the same patch.
procedure: Locate the SUSE branch of distribution detection in lib/ansible/module_utils/facts.py. It is the path loop where `'suse' in data.lower()` is checked separately for /etc/os-release and /etc/SuSE-release.

For /etc/os-release, split the file with data.splitlines() and match each line with an anchored regex. Read NAME from `^NAME=(.*)` and call strip('"') to remove the quotes. Read the version from `^VERSION_ID="?([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)"?`, which must accept the forms 13, 13.0 and 13.04.
Branch on variant before computing distribution_release.
openSUSE ('open' in data.lower()): take the codename from the parenthesized part of `^PRETTY_NAME=`.
SLES ('enterprise' in data.lower()): use the minor number of VERSION_ID (the service pack). When there is no minor number, set release to "0".
For /etc/SuSE-release, apply the same open/enterprise split. Keep the CODENAME parsing for openSUSE. For SLES, derive the release from the PATCHLEVEL line, parsed line by line.
Keep the existing break/loop control of the outer path loop, so other distributions' detection order is unchanged.
validation: Run the existing facts unit tests (test/units/module_utils/*facts*).

Feed sample /etc/os-release contents for openSUSE 13.2, SLES 12 and SLES 12 SP1. Assert that distribution, distribution_version and distribution_release are 'openSUSE'/'13.2'/'Harlequin', 'SLES'/'12'/'0' and 'SLES'/'12.1'/'1'.
Feed a SuSE-release sample for SLES 11 SP3 (VERSION/PATCHLEVEL) and check that release is '3'.
Run python -m py_compile on facts.py and check indentation consistency, since the patch mixes indent widths.

name: thread-setup-cache-into-all-template-calls
negative_constraints: 不要把其他主机的 facts 直接合并进当前主机的 inject。必须放在 hostvars 命名空间下, 否则会覆盖当前主机的变量。
不要漏改 double_template 和 template_from_file。conditional 和 template 模块走的是这两条路径。
不要把新参数设为必填, 否则未改到的调用点和外部调用会报错。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/utils.py 中的 template / double_template / template_from_file。给它们增加一个可选的第三参数 setup_cache(默认 None 或 {}, 保证旧调用仍可用)。
在渲染前把 setup_cache 以 'hostvars' 键加入模板变量字典, 让模板可以写 {{ hostvars['host']['fact'] }}。复制一份变量字典再加, 不要改写传入的 inject。
全仓 grep 'utils.template(' 和 'double_template(', 逐个调用点补上全局缓存参数, 不要只改一两处。
runner.py 中的调用点(conditional 求值、args 模板化、copy 的 source、fetch 的 source、template 模块渲染 source_data)都传 self.setup_cache。
playbook.py 中的调用点(with_items 展开时的 action / name / only_if, vars_files 路径的单文件和列表两个分支)都传模块级的 SETUP_CACHE。
保持 inject = self.setup_cache.get(conn.host, {}) 作为当前主机的变量, 全局 cache 只用来提供 hostvars。
validation: 运行现有测试套件。
用 grep 确认所有 template / double_template / template_from_file 调用都已传入 cache 参数。
在 playbook 里先对 A、B 两台主机执行 setup, 然后在 B 的 template 或 action 中引用 {{ hostvars['A']['ansible_eth0']['ipv4']['address'] }}, 确认能渲染出正确的值。

name: tolerate-template-errors-on-secret-values
negative_constraints: Do not remove templating of passwords entirely. Users legitimately set ansible_ssh_pass or become_pass to '{{ vault_var }}'.
Do not swallow template errors for non-secret fields such as the user, host or port. Those errors should still surface.
Do not log or print the raw password value in any error or debug message while handling the exception.
Do not change the template.template signature or global templating behavior just to fix the secret case.
procedure: Locate the place in lib/ansible/runner/__init__.py (Runner._executor_internal / connection setup) where actual_user, actual_pass and self.become_pass get a late template.template(self.basedir, value, inject) pass after inject is built.
Keep templating the user unguarded, because usernames are expected to be valid template input.
Wrap only the password templating calls (actual_pass and become_pass) in a try/except. On failure, keep the original raw value so the password still reaches the connection literally.
Add a comment that references the issue number. The comment should say that password characters such as '{{', '{%' or '{#' that appear in generated or random secrets can be misread as Jinja syntax.
Template each password field in its own try block. With one shared block, a failure on actual_pass would skip templating become_pass, or the reverse.
Prefer catching ansible.errors.AnsibleError, or the specific template/undefined error, over a bare except. A bare except would also hide KeyboardInterrupt and real bugs.
validation: Run the existing unit tests: make tests / nosetests test/units.
Manually run ansible with -k or --ask-become-pass using a password that contains '{{' or '{%'. Confirm there is no template exception and that authentication receives the literal string.
Confirm that a password given as '{{ some_var }}' still resolves to the variable's value.

name: treat-ansible-undefined-like-jinja2-undefined-in-templating
negative_constraints: Do not catch a broad Exception or AnsibleError. That would mask real plugin errors such as file-not-found or connection failures.
Do not convert AnsibleUndefinedVariable into UndefinedError, or the reverse, at the raise site in the lookup plugin. Fix it at the handler.
Do not change fail_on_undefined behavior. Strict mode must still propagate the original exception unchanged.
Do not add a separate except block with duplicated logic. Use a tuple on the existing handler.
procedure: Locate the exception handler in lib/ansible/utils/template.py's template_from_string that wraps the jinja2 render (root_render_func / jinja2.utils.concat).

Confirm the failure path: inside a template, a lookup plugin (or another Ansible-side helper) raises errors.AnsibleUndefinedVariable instead of jinja2.exceptions.UndefinedError, so the existing handler does not catch it.
Widen the existing except clause to a tuple: except (jinja2.exceptions.UndefinedError, errors.AnsibleUndefinedVariable).
Keep the branch semantics unchanged. When fail_on_undefined is True, use a bare raise. When it is False, return the original untemplated data, as the existing UndefinedError path already does.

Check whether sibling templating entry points (template_from_file, varReplace/lookup handling) have similar handlers that only catch the jinja2 exception, and align them with the same tuple if the same bug exists there.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for utils/template (test/units/TestUtils.py or the equivalent).

Template a string containing a lookup that references an undefined var. With fail_on_undefined=False it should return the raw string without raising. With fail_on_undefined=True it should raise AnsibleUndefinedVariable.
Verify that a plain jinja2 undefined variable still behaves as before.

name: utf8-encode-before-base64-module-args
negative_constraints: Do not use `str()` to force-convert unicode. It still uses the ascii codec and raises the same error.
Do not use `encode('ascii', 'ignore')` or strip the non-ASCII characters. That silently corrupts the user's arguments.
Do not change the template engine's return type globally. Only encode at the point where bytes are needed, to keep the fix small.

Do not encode on a value that is already a byte str. In Python 2, calling `.encode` on a str containing non-ASCII bytes triggers an implicit decode error. If the type is uncertain, check `isinstance(x, unicode)` first.
procedure: Find where Runner._transfer_module / module transfer builds the module payload. Look for the `base64.b64encode(utils.template(self.module_args, inject))` pattern and the `module_common.REPLACER_ARGS` replacement.
Confirm that `utils.template` can return a unicode object. With non-ASCII args (Chinese, accented characters, etc.), base64 implicitly encodes with ascii and fails.
At the boundary point, explicitly call `.encode('utf-8')` on the templated result, then pass it to b64encode. This turns the text into a byte string before the binary/text conversion happens.
Check that the module side decodes the base64 args as UTF-8 (MODULE_COMMON args parsing). Keep the encoding symmetric on both sides.
Look for other places that write templated strings into bytes, such as module_data replacement, file writes, or ssh transfer. Apply the same explicit encode where those paths are affected.
validation: Run the existing test suite (`make tests` / `nosetests test/`).

Manually run a command module with non-ASCII args, e.g. `ansible localhost -m command -a 'echo 中文'` or `ping data=é`. Confirm it does not raise UnicodeEncodeError and the module receives the correct characters.
Regression-check that pure ASCII args still transfer and parse normally.

name: v2-per-host-dynamic-include-task-injection
negative_constraints: Do not insert included tasks into the play-level shared _blocks or _task_list. That makes every host run tasks another host included.
Do not maintain a global offset counter like _tasks_added. Use each host state's current task index.
Do not modify s._blocks[s.cur_block] in place without copying first. Blocks are shared between host states.
Do not change the add_tasks signature while leaving old call sites that do not pass host.
procedure: Locate v2/ansible/executor/play_iterator.py. Check whether add_tasks / get_original_task still read play-level shared state: self._blocks, self._run_state, self._cur_task_pos or self._tasks_added.
Change the signature to add_tasks(self, host, task_list). Get the host's own state with s = self.get_host_state(host).
Copy the current block: target_block = s._blocks[s.cur_block].copy(). Do not mutate the original Block shared by other hosts.

Branch on s.run_state (ITERATING_TASKS / ITERATING_RESCUE / ITERATING_ALWAYS). Split the list at the matching index (s.cur_regular_task / s.cur_rescue_task / s.cur_always_task), then join before + task_list + after.
Write the result back: s._blocks[s.cur_block] = target_block, then self._host_states[host.name] = s.
In get_original_task(host, task), search s._blocks of the same host state. Do not search self._blocks. Included tasks exist only in that host's block copy.

Update every add_tasks call site in the v2/ansible/plugins/strategies strategy plugins (the diff is truncated there; confirm by grep). Pass the host the include result belongs to. Inject the loaded included tasks only into that host.
If host objects get compared or used as lookup keys after serialization or crossing processes, add __eq__ to v2/ansible/inventory/host.py that compares by name.
For debugging, add a __repr__ to HostState that prints block, task, rescue, always, role, run_state, fail_state and pending_setup.
validation: Run grep -rn 'add_tasks(' v2/ to confirm every call site passes host.
Run the existing v2 unit tests (e.g. v2/test/executor, if present).
Write a two-host playbook where only one host triggers an include via when. The included tasks should run only on that host.
Put an include inside rescue and inside always. The included tasks should be inserted at the current position and run in order.
Check that results of included tasks map back to the original task through get_original_task without returning None.

name: v2-port-bytes-safe-shebang-handling
negative_constraints: Do not mix str literals with the bytes module_data. That breaks split, startswith and join under py3.
Do not enable commented-out inject code when v2 has no inject mechanism yet.
Do not change module_style detection or the return tuple (module_data, module_style, shebang).
Do not alter the ENCODING_STRING insertion position: line 1 when a shebang exists, line 0 otherwise.
procedure: Find the v1 fix in the referenced upstream PR (ansible/ansible#8564). Identify the logic it changes (shebang rewrite, interpreter substitution, encoding line insertion).
Locate the matching function in the v2 tree at v2/ansible/executor/module_common.py:modify_module. Do not edit the v1 lib/ansible tree.
Treat module_data as a byte string. Change every literal that operates on it to bytes. This covers split(b"\n", 1), startswith(b"#!") and b"\n".join(lines). This keeps py2/py3 behavior consistent.

Wrap values that come from inventory or variables in to_bytes(..., errors='strict') from ansible.utils.unicode before you interpolate them into the shebang. This applies to values such as inject[interpreter_config].
Build the new shebang with a bytes format, for example b"#!{0} {1}".format(interpreter, b" ".join(args[1:])).

Check whether the v2 dependency (inject or variable lookup) already exists. If it does not, port the change as an updated FIXME or commented block that records the fix. Do not invent the missing plumbing.
validation: Run the existing v2 unit tests for executor/module_common, if any exist.
Run the python modules through modify_module both with and without a shebang. Confirm the output is bytes and that the encoding line is placed correctly.
Confirm that a python -m py_compile pass on v2/ansible/executor/module_common.py succeeds.

name: validate-parse-result-before-indexing
negative_constraints: 不要用 try/except TypeError 吞掉异常来掩盖问题。应通过 fail_json 给出明确错误信息。
不要修改 parsekey 或 parseoptions 的返回约定。现有调用方依赖 None 表示解析失败。
不要顺带改动 key_options 的合并语义或元组结构。
procedure: 定位 module 中调用解析函数 (如 parsekey) 的位置。确认它在输入无效时是否返回 None 或 falsy 值。
检查同一结果是否在校验之前就被下标访问或重组。例如 parsed_new_key[0] 在构造 key_options 元组时被访问。
调整执行顺序:先执行 `if not parsed: module.fail_json(msg="invalid ... specified: %s" % raw)`,再对结果做任何索引、解包或合并。
把依赖解析结果的后续增强逻辑(如合并 parseoptions 结果)移到校验之后。只改顺序,不改原有语义。
对 module 内其他使用该解析函数结果的地方逐一排查,看是否有同类的先用后验问题。
validation: 运行现有 authorized_key 单元测试和集成测试。
手动复现:传入 key 为文件路径(无效 key 字符串)并同时设置 key_options,期望得到 failed 和 'invalid key specified',不再出现 traceback。
确认有效 key 加 key_options 的路径行为不变。

name: validate-parsed-vars-file-is-dict
negative_constraints: Do not write a format string whose number of placeholders differs from its arguments. `"%s must be stored as dictonary/hash: %s" % filename4` has two %s and one argument, so it raises TypeError instead of AnsibleError and hides the real message.
Do not introduce typos in user-facing messages (for example 'dictonary').
Do not raise on empty or None YAML results where the existing code tolerates them.
Do not place the type check after the data has already been merged into vars or setup_cache.
Do not silently coerce lists or strings into dicts. Fail loudly with the filename.
procedure: Locate every call to utils.parse_yaml_from_file in lib/ansible/playbook/play.py whose result is merged as variables. These sit in the vars_files handling in Play: the alternative-list branch that loops over candidate files (filename4 inside the os.path.exists check) and the single-file branch (new_vars).

Right after each parse, add a type guard before the data is used in update() or the setup_cache merge: `if type(data) != dict: raise errors.AnsibleError("%s must be stored as a dictionary/hash" % filename4)`.
In the single-file branch, keep the existing `if new_vars:` truthiness check before the type check, so empty files still pass silently.
Reuse errors.AnsibleError, which is already imported in play.py. Do not add a new exception class.
Use one error wording across all branches and always include the offending resolved file path (filename4, after templating), not the raw template string.

Grep the rest of the repository for other parse_yaml_from_file consumers that expect a dict, such as group_vars/host_vars loading in inventory. Apply the same guard there only if the task scope covers them.
validation: Run the existing test suite (for example `make tests` or `nosetests test/`) to confirm there are no regressions.
Manually run a playbook whose vars_files points to a YAML list. It should fail with AnsibleError naming the file, not with TypeError or AttributeError.
Repeat with a vars_files alternative list (`[file_a, file_b]`) where the first existing file is a list, to exercise the filename4 branch.
Check that an empty vars file still loads without error.
Grep the added lines for `%` formatting and count placeholders against arguments.

name: with-items-use-varlookup-for-nested-vars
negative_constraints: 不要用 str.replace('$', '') 加顶层 dict 查找来解析变量, 这种方式无法支持 a.b 形式的嵌套变量。
不要删除 with_items 的 list 类型检查。
procedure: 定位 runner 中处理 module_vars['items'] 的分支, 即字符串以 '$' 开头的情况。
将原先手写的逻辑(先 replace('$', ''), 再用 inject 顶层 key 查找)替换为 utils.varLookup(items, inject)。varLookup 能解析点号路径和嵌套结构, 例如 $groups.webservers。
保留后续的类型校验 type(items) != list -> AnsibleError, 确保非列表结果仍然给出清晰错误。
validation: 运行现有 playbook/runner 测试。
编写一个使用 with_items: $groups.somegroup 的 playbook, 确认会遍历该组的各个主机名。
确认 with_items: $undefined 和非列表变量仍会产生错误, 而不会静默通过。

name: wrap-inventory-script-exec-in-ansible-error
negative_constraints: 不要让异常从 Popen/communicate 原样冒泡成 traceback。
不要吞掉异常后静默回退到把文件当静态 hosts 解析。这会掩盖权限配置错误, 原修复选择的是明确报错。
不要改成 shell=True 来绕过执行失败。
不要丢失原始异常信息; 错误消息中必须包含文件路径和 str(e)。
保持与仓库当时的 Python 2 语法风格一致(except Exception, e), 不要引入与代码库不兼容的语法。
procedure: 定位 lib/ansible/inventory.py 中 Inventory 类对可执行 inventory_file 的处理路径, 即构造 cmd = [self.inventory_file, '--list'] 后调用 subprocess.Popen 的位置。
用 try/except 同时包住 subprocess.Popen(...) 和 cmd.communicate()。被误设为可执行的静态 hosts 文件(没有 shebang)或解释器缺失时, 会在这里抛出 OSError 等异常。
在 except 中把原始异常转换为 errors.AnsibleError。消息里要带上 self.inventory_file 和 str(e), 例如 'Failure executing %s to produce host list:\n %s'。这样 CLI 输出的是可读错误, 而不是 Python traceback。
复用模块中已导入的 ansible errors 模块, 不新增异常类型。保持 shell=False 和现有的 stdout/stderr PIPE 参数不变。
保留 try 块之后原有的 returncode 检查逻辑。脚本能执行但返回非零时, 仍由这段逻辑报错。
顺手检查 returncode 分支的格式化: "%s: %s" % self.inventory_file, err 写法有误, 应改为 % (self.inventory_file, err), 否则会再次抛出 TypeError 并产生 traceback。
validation: 运行现有 inventory 相关测试(例如 test/TestInventory.py), 确认可执行脚本和静态 hosts 两种路径都不回归。
手动验证: 把一个无 shebang 的静态 hosts 文件 chmod +x, 再执行 ansible all -i <file> --list-hosts 或等价命令。预期得到 'Failure executing ... to produce host list' 形式的 AnsibleError, 不出现 traceback。
手动验证: 用一个 exit 1 的可执行脚本作为 inventory, 确认非零返回码分支同样给出可读错误。

name: wrap-play-ds-coercion-in-ansibleerror
negative_constraints: 不要用裸的 except 或 except Exception，以免把真正的程序 bug 也吞掉。
不要偷偷把非法值强转成字符串（比如 map(str, hosts)）让它通过，这会改变已有 playbook 的语义，也会掩盖用户的配置错误。
不要把它重构成完整的 schema 校验，也不要调整 Play 里其他字段的处理逻辑，修改只限于出错的那一行。
不要抛出新的自定义异常类型，统一使用 errors.AnsibleError，这样 CLI 会显示友好的错误信息，而不是 traceback。
procedure: 从 issue 里的 traceback 找到出错的地方。通常在 lib/ansible/playbook/play.py 的 Play.__init__ 里，是对 ds 中某个字段做类型转换的那一行，比如对 hosts 列表调用 ';'.join(hosts)。
弄清楚用户写错 YAML 时实际会传进来什么值。例如 hosts 列表里出现 int、dict 或嵌套 list，join 就会抛出 TypeError。
保留原来的分支结构，比如 `if hosts is None` 和 `elif isinstance(hosts, list)`。只给那一行会出问题的转换代码套上 try/except，并且只捕获该操作会抛出的具体异常类型（这里是 TypeError）。
在 except 里改为抛出 errors.AnsibleError。错误信息要指明是哪个字段写错了，并带上原始异常文本，例如 'improper host declaration: %s' % str(e)。
沿用文件里已有的 Python 2 写法（如 `except TypeError, e:`）和 errors 模块的导入方式，不要新增依赖。
validation: 写一个最小 playbook 复现问题：`hosts: [1, {a: b}]`。运行 ansible-playbook --syntax-check，确认输出的是 'improper host declaration' 错误，而不是 Python traceback。
确认 `hosts: all`、`hosts: [web, db]` 这类正常写法的行为不变，self.hosts 仍然是用 ';' 拼接的结果。
确认缺少 hosts 时仍然报 'hosts declaration is required'。
运行已有的 playbook 单元测试（test/units），确保没有回归。
